**进气**：活塞下行，吸入空气和汽油的混合气。**压缩**：活塞上行，把混合气: **Intake**: The piston moves down, drawing in a mixture of air and gasoline. **Compression**: The piston moves up, compressing the mixture to about one-tenth of its original volume. **Power stroke**: The spark plug ignites the mixture, causing an explosion that forcefully pushes the piston down; this is the only stroke that produces power. **Exhaust**: The piston moves up, expelling exhaust gases.
多个气缸轮流做功，通过曲轴把往复运动变成平稳的旋转。和蒸汽机相比，它省掉了锅炉，: Multiple cylinders perform work in turn. Through the crankshaft, the reciprocating motion is converted into smooth rotation. Compared to steam engines, it eliminates the boiler as fuel burns directly inside the cylinder, making it smaller, lighter, and faster to start.
1860 年法国的勒努瓦（Étienne Lenoir）造出第一台商用内燃机，但: In 1860, Frenchman Étienne Lenoir built the first commercial internal combustion engine, but its efficiency was very low. Between 1885 and 1886, Karl Benz mounted it on a three-wheeled vehicle to build the first practical [[automobile|Automobile]].
汽车发动机的效率通常只有 25%–40%，其余的能量变成了废热。这不是工程师不努: The efficiency of automobile engines is typically only 25%–40%; the remaining energy is lost as waste heat. This is not due to a lack of effort by engineers but is determined by the Carnot limit along with friction and heat dissipation; this is also one reason why electric motors (with efficiencies over 90%) have surpassed them.
四冲程循环：进气、压缩、做功、排气。曲轴每转两圈，活塞只有一次被燃气推动。: Four-stroke cycle: intake, compression, power stroke, exhaust. The crankshaft must rotate two full revolutions for the piston to be pushed by the gas only once.

At this point, the fuel injector atomizes and sprays diesel into the cylinder; the fuel ignites spontaneously upon contact with the hot air, pushing the piston. Due to the high compression ratio, diesel engines have significantly higher efficiency than gasoline engines. They offer high torque and durability but are heavier, and their nitrogen oxide and particulate emissions are more difficult to treat.
德国工程师狄塞尔（Rudolf Diesel）1892 年申请专利，1897 年: German engineer Rudolf Diesel applied for a patent in 1892 and built the first working prototype in 1897, achieving an efficiency far superior to steam engines of that time.

When used for power generation, excess turbine power drives a generator; when used in aircraft, it becomes a [[jet-engine|Jet engine]]. The higher the inlet temperature of the turbine, the higher the efficiency. 1939 年瑞士布朗勃法瑞（Brown Boveri）公司在纳沙泰尔建成世界上第: In 1939, the Swiss Brown Boveri company built the world's first gas turbine for power generation in Neuchâtel, with a power output of 4 megawatts. In the same year, Germany's He 178 made its maiden flight using a jet engine.
燃气轮机能在十几分钟内从冷态启动到满功率，是电网调峰的主力，也是 [[combi: Gas turbines can start from cold to full power in just a few minutes, making them the main force for peak load regulation in the grid and the "first stage" of a [[combined-cycle|Combined-cycle power plant]].
外部加热、内部气体循环的热机，安静但功率密度低。: A heat engine that is externally heated with an internal gas cycle; it is quiet but has low power density.
气体受热膨胀、遇冷收缩；只要一头加热、一头冷却，封闭在里面的气体来回流动就能推动: Gas expands when heated and contracts when cooled; as long as one end is heated and the other cooled, the gas flowing back and forth inside can push a piston to do work. The heat source can be anything (subject to the [[p:carnot|Carnot efficiency limit]]).
斯特林发动机的工作气体（空气、氦或氢）一直封闭在机器内部，热量从外面通过缸壁传进: The working gas of a Stirling engine (air, helium, or hydrogen) remains sealed inside the machine, with heat transferred in from the outside through the cylinder walls. It has no detonation, so it is very quiet, and its theoretical efficiency can approach the Carnot limit. The disadvantages are low power density, slow response to load changes, and high cost.

它没能成为主流动力，但在需要安静和\"什么热都能用\"的地方找到了位置，例如瑞典: It did not become a mainstream power source but found a niche where quiet operation and "use of any heat" are needed, such as in Swedish AIP submarines, dish solar thermal power plants, and some refrigerators.
把水流的势能变成旋转动能，是水电站的心脏。: Converts the potential energy of flowing water into rotational kinetic energy; it is the heart of a hydroelectric plant.
高处的水具有势能，流下来变成动能；让水流推动叶轮旋转，再带动发电机，就把重力做的: Water at high elevation possesses potential energy that becomes kinetic energy as it flows down; by letting the water flow to rotate an impeller, which then drives a generator, the work done by gravity is converted into electricity (Conservation of energy [[p:energy|Conservation of energy]]).
按水头高低分三大类：中等水头用**混流式**（Francis），水从四周流入、从: Categorized into three types based on head height: medium heads use **Francis turbines** (mixed-flow), where water enters from all sides and exits from the center; high heads use **Pelton turbines** (impulse), where a high-speed jet from a nozzle strikes spoon-shaped buckets; low heads with large flow rates use **Kaplan turbines** (propeller-type), where blade angles are adjustable. Large turbine efficiencies can exceed 90%.
1849 年美国工程师弗朗西斯（James B. Francis）改进出混流式水: In 1849, American engineer James B. Francis improved the mixed-flow turbine, which remains the most widely used type of water turbine in the world today.
它是 [[hydropower|水力发电]] 的心脏，三峡电站单机 70 万千瓦: It is the heart of [[hydropower|Hydropower]]; for example, the giant single unit of the Three Gorges Power Station with a capacity of 7 million kilowatts is a mixed-flow turbine.
用少量电把热从冷处\"搬\"到热处，供暖效率可达电暖器的 3–4 倍。: Uses a small amount of electricity to "move" heat from a cold place to a hot place; heating efficiency can be 3–4 times that of an electric heater.
热量自发从热处流向冷处，要让它倒着走就得付出功（[[p:entropy|热力学第: Heat spontaneously flows from hot to cold; to make it flow in reverse, work must be done (Second Law of Thermodynamics [[p:entropy|Entropy & the second law]]); however, "moving" heat is much cheaper than "making" heat. For heating, each unit of electricity used typically delivers 3–4 units of heat energy; this ratio is called the **Coefficient of Performance (COP)**. The COP of an electric heater can be at most 1.

热泵让供暖可以完全电气化，再配上低碳电力，是建筑减排最主要的手段之一（见 [[e: Heat pumps enable full electrification of heating; combined with low-carbon electricity, they are one of the most important means for building emission reduction (see [[energy-transition|Energy transition]]).

1834 年在英国工作的美国发明家珀金斯（Jacob Perkins）取得第一台: American inventor Jacob Perkins working in Britain obtained the first patent for a vapor-compression refrigeration machine in 1834. In the 1870s, German Carl von Linde improved it to create reliable ammonia refrigeration machines used in breweries.
人工制冷让食物可以长期保存和远距离运输，催生了 [[cold-chain|冷链]: Artificial refrigeration allows food to be stored for long periods and transported over long distances, giving rise to [[cold-chain|Cold chain]], [[home-refrigerator|Domestic refrigerator]], and [[air-conditioning|Air conditioning]]; vaccines, blood, and many medicines also depend on it.
蒸气压缩制冷循环：制冷剂在蒸发器里吸热、在冷凝器里放热，压缩机提供\"搬运热量\: The vapor-compression refrigeration cycle: the refrigerant absorbs heat in the evaporator and releases heat in the condenser, while the compressor provides the work needed to "transport" the heat.
同时控制温度和湿度的制冷系统，让热带城市和数据中心得以运转。: Refrigeration systems that simultaneously control temperature and humidity enable tropical cities and data centers to operate.

1902 年美国工程师开利（Willis Carrier）为纽约布鲁克林的一家印: In 1902, American engineer Willis Carrier designed the first modern air conditioning system for a printing plant in Brooklyn, New York; its original purpose was to control humidity and prevent paper deformation, not to make people comfortable.

According to the International Energy Agency, electricity used for refrigeration accounts for about one-tenth of global electricity consumption and is growing rapidly.

热机无论多先进，都有相当一部分热量必须排给低温端（[[p:carnot|卡诺效率: Regardless of how advanced a heat engine is, a significant portion of its heat must be rejected to a low-temperature sink (the [[p:carnot|Carnot efficiency limit]]); instead of rejecting this waste heat into cooling towers, it can be used for heating or to supply steam for factories, greatly improving overall energy utilization (via [[p:energy|Conservation of energy]]).
普通火电厂只把燃料能量的三到四成变成电，其余随冷却水散掉。热电联产电厂在汽轮机中: A conventional thermal power plant converts only about one-third to one-fourth of the fuel's energy into electricity, with the rest dissipated via cooling water. 北欧和中国北方城市的集中供暖大量依靠热电联产。: Centralized heating in northern European cities and northern China relies heavily on combined heat and power.

Modern power plants also install desulfurization, denitrification, and dust removal equipment. The most advanced ultra-supercritical units have an efficiency of about 45%, while older units achieve only slightly over 30%.

It is also the largest single source of carbon dioxide emissions and therefore the primary target for emission reductions by countries (see [[carbon-capture]]).
打井到地下油层把原油抽出来，现代石油工业由此开始。: Drilling down to underground oil reservoirs to extract crude oil marks the beginning of the modern petroleum industry.

19 世纪 50 年代起，人们蒸馏原油主要为了得到点灯用的煤油。1913 年美国: Since the 1850s, people distilled crude oil mainly to obtain kerosene for lighting. Engineers first drill a vertical well, then after reaching the shale layer switch to horizontal drilling, boring horizontally along the rock layer for one or two kilometers. Then, water, sand, and small amounts of chemical additives are pumped into the well in sections at high pressure, fracturing the surrounding rock into countless tiny cracks; once pressure is released, the sand particles hold the cracks open, allowing oil and gas to flow into the wellbore along these fractures.

以甲烷为主的化石燃料，燃烧比煤干净，是调峰发电和供暖主力。: Fossil fuels dominated by methane burn cleaner than coal, serving as the main force for peak-load power generation and heating.
中国四川自汉代起就用竹管输送天然气煮盐；1821 年美国纽约州弗雷多尼亚打出第一: Since the Han Dynasty, China used bamboo pipes in Sichuan to transport natural gas for salt boiling; in 1821, Fredonia in New York State drilled the first dedicated natural gas well. 天然气提供了全球约四分之一的一次能源。它常被称为\"过渡燃料\"，但甲烷本身是强: Natural gas provides about one-quarter of global primary energy. It is often called a "transition fuel," but methane itself is a potent greenhouse gas; leaks during extraction and transport can offset most of its advantages over coal.
把天然气冷到约 −162°C 变成液体，体积缩小约 600 倍，可以装船跨洋运输: Cooling natural gas to approximately −162°C turns it into liquid, reducing volume by about 600 times, allowing it to be loaded onto ships for cross-ocean transport.

1959 年\"甲烷先锋号\"完成首次跨大西洋试运；1964 年起阿尔及利亚向英: In 1959, "Methane Pioneer" completed its first trans-Atlantic trial run; starting in 1964, Algeria began regular LNG exports to Britain, launching commercial trade.
LNG 让天然气摆脱了管道的束缚，变成可以跨洋买卖的全球商品，日本、韩国和欧洲都: LNG freed natural gas from the constraints of pipelines, turning it into a global commodity that can be traded across oceans; Japan, Korea, and Europe rely on it to secure energy supplies.
燃气轮机发电后，再用它的高温排气烧蒸汽带动汽轮机，效率可超过 60%。: After gas turbine power generation, the high-temperature exhaust is used to heat steam driving a steam turbine, achieving efficiencies exceeding 60%.
燃气轮机排出的废气仍有约 600°C，直接排掉太可惜；用它再烧一锅蒸汽去推汽轮机: Exhaust gases from a gas turbine still remain at approximately 600°C; discarding them directly would be a waste. 联合循环电厂分两段：天然气先在 [[gas-turbine|燃气轮机]] 中燃烧: Combined-cycle power plants consist of two stages: natural gas is first burned in a [[gas-turbine|gas turbine]] to generate electricity; the hot exhaust enters a heat recovery steam generator (HRSG) where water is heated into steam, which then drives a [[steam-turbine|steam turbine]] to generate power. The gas turbine generates approximately two-thirds of the electricity, while the steam turbine utilizes the 'waste heat' to generate another third. The most advanced units have achieved efficiencies exceeding 60%, significantly higher than standalone coal or gas-fired plants. They start up faster than coal-fired plants, occupy less space, and emit less pollution.
联合循环在 20 世纪 60–70 年代开始商用，随着燃气轮机耐温能力提高，在: Combined-cycle technology began commercialization in the 1960s–70s; as the temperature tolerance of gas turbines improved, it became the mainstream solution for new gas-fired power plants during the 1990s.
它是目前把化石燃料变成电最高效的方式，在美国、欧洲和中东的电力系统中占重要地位。: It is currently the most efficient method for converting fossil fuels into electricity and holds a significant position within power systems in the United States, Europe, and the Middle East.
联合循环：燃气轮机发电后，排气的余热再烧蒸汽推动汽轮机，两段加起来效率超过 60: Combined-cycle: After the gas turbine generates electricity, the residual heat from the exhaust is used to generate steam driving a steam turbine; together, the two stages achieve an efficiency exceeding 60%.
煤、石油、天然气是远古生物遗骸在地下封存亿万年形成的\"化学电池\"，至今仍提供: Coal, oil, and natural gas are "chemical batteries" formed from ancient biological remains sealed underground over millions of years, still providing approximately eighty percent of global primary energy today.
远古植物和浮游生物通过光合作用把阳光储存在有机物里，被埋到地下后在高温高压下经过: Ancient plants and phytoplankton stored sunlight in organic matter through photosynthesis; after being buried underground, they underwent millions of years of transformation under high temperature and pressure to become coal, oil, and natural gas. 煤主要由古代陆地植物形成，石油和天然气主要由海洋浮游生物形成。它们的共同点是能量: Coal is primarily formed from ancient terrestrial plants, while oil and natural gas are mainly formed from marine phytoplankton. 工业革命以煤开始，20 世纪石油登顶，天然气在 20 世纪后半叶快速崛起。: The Industrial Revolution began with coal; oil reached the top in the 20th century; natural gas rose rapidly in the second half of the 20th century.
化石燃料至今仍提供全球约八成的一次能源，是现代文明的物质基础，也是气候变化的主要: Fossil fuels still provide approximately eighty percent of global primary energy, serving as the material foundation for modern civilization and a major cause of climate change (see [[energy-transition]]).
把发电厂、输电线和千家万户连成一张实时平衡的网，发多少就要用多少。: Connect power plants, transmission lines, and thousands of households into a real-time balanced network; generation must equal consumption.
电很难大量储存，所以电网必须时时刻刻让\"发多少\"等于\"用多少\"（[[p:: Electricity is difficult to store in large quantities, so the grid must constantly ensure that "generation" equals "consumption" ([[p:energy|Conservation of energy]]); transmission losses are proportional to the square of the current. 整张网就像一台巨大的同步机器：所有发电机以同一频率（中国和欧洲 50 赫兹，北美: The entire network acts like a massive synchronous machine: all generators rotate at the same frequency (50 Hz in China and Europe, 60 Hz in North America). If electricity usage suddenly increases, generators are "dragged down," causing frequency to drop; dispatch centers and automatic control systems must increase output within seconds to minutes to restore frequency (see [[load-balancing]]). If the imbalance is too great, protection devices will cut off part of the load or units; improper handling can lead to cascading failures and major blackouts.
1882 年爱迪生（Thomas Edison）在纽约珍珠街建成第一座商业中心电: In 1882, Edison (Thomas Edison) built the first commercial power station in Pearl Street, New York, using direct current to supply users within approximately one square mile. After the [[war-of-currents|War of the currents]] between alternating and direct current in the 1880s–90s, the AC grid won. In the 20th century, grids across regions gradually interconnected, forming today's synchronous grids covering entire nations or even crossing borders.
电网让电变成\"打开开关就有\"的公共服务，支撑了 [[electrificat: The grid turned electricity into a public service that is available "upon turning on a switch," supporting everything brought by [[electrification|Electrification]]. Today, the grid is connecting increasingly more wind and solar power that fluctuate with weather, requiring more energy storage, cross-region transmission, and [[smart-grid|Smart grid]] intelligent dispatching.
电网的三段：发电、升压输电、降压配电。电压越高，同样功率下电流越小，线路损耗越低: The three stages of the grid: generation, step-up transmission, and step-down distribution. Higher voltage means lower current for the same power, resulting in lower line losses.
爱迪生的直流电与威斯汀豪斯/特斯拉的交流电之争，交流电因能变压远距离输电而胜出。: Edison's direct current versus Westinghouse/Tesla's alternating current; AC won because it could be stepped up/down via transformers for long-distance transmission.
交流电可以用变压器方便地升压降压（[[p:induction|电磁感应]]）；而: Alternating current can be easily stepped up or down using transformers ([[p:induction|Electromagnetic induction]]); since transmission losses are proportional to the square of the current, high voltage and low current are necessary to send electricity far ([[p:ohm|Ohm's law & circuits]]). This physical fact determined the outcome.
爱迪生的直流系统电压低，电站只能供应方圆一两公里的用户，城市里得每隔几个街区建一: Edison's DC system had low voltage; power stations could only supply users within one or two kilometers, requiring a new station every few blocks in cities. Westinghouse (George Westinghouse) bought Tesla's (Nikola Tesla) AC motor patents, used transformers to raise voltage for long-distance transmission, then stepped it down at the user end; one large power station could supply a large area. 1888 年特斯拉取得交流感应电动机等专利；1893 年威斯汀豪斯赢得芝加哥世界: In 1888, Tesla obtained patents for AC induction motors; in 1893, Westinghouse won the lighting contract for the Chicago World's Fair; in 1896, the Niagara Falls hydroelectric station began using AC to transmit power approximately 40 km to Buffalo, sealing the fate of AC.
交流电成为全世界电网的标准。讽刺的是，随着电力电子技术进步，直流在超远距离输电和: Alternating current became the standard for grids worldwide. Ironically, with advances in power electronics, DC has risen again for ultra-long-distance transmission and data centers (see [[hvdc]]).
超远距离或海底输电时改用直流，损耗更小，也能连接频率不同的电网。: For ultra-long-distance or submarine transmission, switching to DC reduces losses and allows connection of grids with different frequencies.
交流电在长线路和海底电缆里会因电容和电感产生额外损耗，直流电没有这个问题，只剩导: In long lines and submarine cables, AC suffers additional losses due to capacitance and inductance; DC has no such issue, retaining only wire resistance losses ([[p:ohm|Ohm's law & circuits]]); the longer the transmission distance, the more economical DC becomes.
高压直流输电在两端各建一座换流站：送端用大功率半导体阀（过去是汞弧阀，现在是晶闸: High-voltage direct current transmission builds a converter station at each end: the sending end uses high-power semiconductor valves (formerly mercury arc valves, now thyristors and [[igbt]]) to convert alternating current to direct current, sends it through lines to distant locations, and the receiving end converts it back to alternating current. 1954 年瑞典 ASEA 公司（工程师拉姆 Uno Lamm 主导）建成从瑞典: In 1954, the Swedish ASEA company (led by engineer Uno Lamm) completed a submarine direct current line from mainland Sweden to Gotland, which was the first commercial high-voltage direct current transmission project. 用 1000 kV 交流或 ±800 kV 以上直流把西部电力送往东部，电压越高: Using 1000 kV alternating current or ±800 kV or higher direct current to send western electricity to the east; the higher the voltage, the smaller the losses.
输电损耗与电流的平方成正比，电压提高一倍、电流减半，损耗就降到四分之一（[[p:: Transmission losses are proportional to the square of the current; doubling the voltage halves the current, reducing losses to one-quarter ([[p:ohm|Ohm's law]]); the higher the voltage, the more and farther power a single line can deliver.
特高压指交流 1000 千伏、直流 ±800 千伏及以上的输电。一条 ±800: Ultra-high voltage refers to alternating current at 1000 kV and direct current at ±800 kV or above. 2009 年中国晋东南—南阳—荆门 1000 千伏交流示范工程投运；此后中国建成: In 2009, China's Jinshijian-Nanyang-Jingmen 1000 kV alternating current demonstration project went into operation; since then, China has built dozens of ultra-high voltage lines to send western coal-fired power, hydropower, and wind and solar power to the east.
它让能源资源和用电负荷远隔千里的大国也能高效配置电力（见 [[hvdc]]）。: It enables efficient allocation of electricity across a large nation where energy resources and load centers are thousands of miles apart (see [[hvdc]]).
给电网加上传感、通信和自动控制，让分布式光伏、电动车和储能能被统一调度。: Adding sensors, communication, and automatic control to the grid allows distributed photovoltaic systems, electric vehicles, and energy storage to be uniformly dispatched.
控制一个系统，先要能实时测量它，再用测量结果修正动作（[[p:feedback|: To control a system, one must first be able to measure it in real time, then use measurement results to correct actions ([[p:feedback|Feedback & control]]); equipping the grid with sensors and communication networks transforms dispatch from "roughly estimated" to "visible and controllable".
智能电网在发电、输电、配电和用户端都加上智能电表、传感器和自动开关，数据实时汇总: The smart grid adds smart meters, sensors, and automatic switches at generation, transmission, distribution, and user ends; data is aggregated in real time to the dispatch system. When a distribution network fault occurs, it can automatically isolate and restore power within minutes; rooftop photovoltaic systems, electric vehicles, and energy storage can also be uniformly coordinated.
这一概念在 2000 年代流行起来，2007 年美国《能源独立与安全法》把\"智: This concept became popular in the 2000s; in 2007, the U.S. Energy Independence and Security Act incorporated "smart grid" as a legal goal.
随着风光发电和电动车越来越多，智能化已成为电网能否接纳它们的关键（见 [[vir: With increasing shares of wind and solar generation and electric vehicles, intelligence has become critical for whether the grid can accept them (see [[virtual-power-plant]], [[iot]]).
电网每秒都要让发电等于用电；用快速启停的电源和储能填补高峰低谷。: The grid must ensure generation equals load every second; using sources with fast start-stop capabilities and energy storage to fill peak and valley periods.
电网把电源分成几类：核电、大型煤电等适合稳定运行，承担\"基荷\"；燃气轮机、水: The grid categorizes power sources into several types: nuclear power and large coal-fired plants suitable for stable operation, bearing the "base load"; gas turbines, hydropower, pumped storage, and batteries capable of rapid up/down adjustments, responsible for "peak shaving" and second-level frequency regulation. During a day, electricity consumption has morning and evening peaks with a deep valley at night; in regions with abundant photovoltaic generation, midday sees excess power while sunset requires large amounts of power to be rapidly added, forming the so-called "duck curve".
调峰调频是电网自诞生起就有的任务；进入 21 世纪，随着风光比例上升，\"灵活性: Peak shaving and frequency regulation are tasks inherent since the grid's birth; entering the 21st century, with rising shares of wind and solar, "flexibility" has become a core subject for power systems.
平衡能力决定了电网能接纳多少风光电（见 [[grid-storage]]、[[p: Balancing capability determines how much wind and solar power the grid can accept (see [[grid-storage]], [[pumped-storage]]).
可以脱离大电网独立运行的小型电力系统，常用于海岛、园区和应急。: Small power systems capable of independent operation without the main grid are commonly used for islands, industrial parks, and emergency situations.
微电网把本地的光伏、风机、柴油机、储能和用电设备连在一起，有自己的控制器。平时可: A microgrid connects local photovoltaic systems, wind turbines, diesel generators, energy storage, and load equipment together with its own controller. 2000 年代初美国学者提出系统化的微电网概念；如今海岛、偏远矿区和工业园区大量: In the early 2000s, U.S. scholars proposed a systematic concept of microgrids; today, islands, remote mining areas, and industrial parks widely adopt them.
微电网让没有大电网覆盖的地方也能用上稳定的电，并提高了城市应对灾害停电的韧性（见: Microgrids enable stable electricity access in areas without main grid coverage and improve urban resilience against disaster-related power outages (see [[smart-grid]], [[solar-pv]]).
用软件把成千上万个屋顶光伏、电池、空调聚合起来，像一座电厂一样参与调度。: Using software to aggregate tens of thousands of rooftop photovoltaic systems, batteries, air conditioners, etc., allowing them to participate in dispatch like a single power plant.
虚拟电厂没有厂房和烟囱，而是一套软件平台：它连接成千上万户的家用电池、屋顶光伏、: A virtual power plant has no physical plant or smokestack, but rather a software platform: it connects thousands of household batteries, rooftop photovoltaics, electric vehicle charging stations, air conditioners, and factory equipment. 2010 年代在德国、澳大利亚、美国加州等地兴起，例如澳大利亚南部由数千户家用电: It emerged in the 2010s in Germany, Australia, California, and other locations; for example, a virtual power plant in southern Australia composed of thousands of household batteries.
把电站一生的建设和运行成本摊到每度电上，是比较不同电源便宜程度的通用尺子。: The levelized cost of electricity (LCOE) is a general metric for comparing the relative cost-effectiveness of different power sources, calculated by spreading the total construction and operation costs of a power plant over its lifetime into each kilowatt-hour produced.
平准化度电成本（LCOE）= 电站全生命周期总成本（建设、燃料、运维、拆除，并按: Levelized cost of electricity (LCOE) = Total lifecycle cost of the power plant (construction, fuel, operations and maintenance, decommissioning, discounted at an interest rate) ÷ Total lifecycle energy generation (also discounted). Wind and photovoltaic power have negligible fuel costs, with costs primarily in early-stage construction, making them highly sensitive to interest rates; gas-fired power plants are the opposite, where fuel prices determine everything.
局限是它不反映\"什么时候发电\"：午间的一度光伏电和傍晚急需的一度电价值不同。: The limitation is that it does not reflect 'when' electricity is generated: a kilowatt-hour of solar power produced at noon differs in value from a kilowatt-hour needed urgently in the evening.
这一方法在 20 世纪后期被能源机构普遍采用。据国际可再生能源署（IRENA），: This method was widely adopted by energy agencies in the late 20th century. 用电价或补贴引导用户在高峰时少用电、低谷时多用电，把\"用电\"也变成可调度资源: Electricity prices or subsidies guide users to consume less during peak hours and more during off-peak hours, turning 'consumption' itself into a dispatchable resource.

峰谷电价早在 20 世纪中叶就已出现；智能电表普及后，自动化的需求响应在 201: Peak-valley electricity pricing dates back to the mid-20th century; after the widespread adoption of smart meters, automated demand response developed rapidly in the 2010s.
发电企业竞价上网、按边际成本排序调度，价格每小时甚至每 5 分钟变化一次。: Power generation companies bid for grid access; dispatch is scheduled based on marginal cost ranking, with prices changing once every hour or even every five minutes.
电力不能大量储存，所以市场分很多层：提前几年签的中长期合同、提前一天的日前市场、: Electricity cannot be stored in large quantities, so the market is divided into many layers: long-term contracts signed years in advance, the day-ahead market one day prior, the real-time market for the current day, and auxiliary service markets specifically for frequency regulation and spinning reserve. The marginal cost of wind and solar power approaches zero; when they are dispatched in large volumes, it can drive electricity prices down, even resulting in negative electricity prices.
1982 年智利率先进行电力市场化改革，1990 年英国建立电力库（Pool），: Chile led electricity market liberalization reforms in 1982; the UK established an electricity pool in 1990. Subsequently, Europe and America, as well as Australia, successively established wholesale electricity markets; China has advanced a new round of electricity system reform since 2015.
电站一年实际发电量占\"满功率运行全年\"发电量的比例：核电约九成，光伏通常一到: The ratio of a power plant's actual annual energy generation to its 'full-power operation for a full year' theoretical generation: nuclear power plants achieve about 90%, while photovoltaic typically achieves one to two times ten percent or more.
容量因子 = 实际年发电量 ÷（装机容量 × 8760 小时）。核电几乎全年满功: Capacity factor = Actual annual energy generation ÷ (Installed capacity × 8760 hours). Nuclear power plants operate at full power almost year-round; US nuclear power plant capacity factors exceed 90%. Coal and gas-fired power plants vary with dispatch. Onshore wind averages about 30%–40%, while offshore wind can reach 40%–50%. Photovoltaic generation is affected by day-night cycles and weather; the global average is about 15%, though it can exceed 25% in sun-rich regions.
这是电力行业的通用统计指标，各国能源统计机构每年发布。: This is a universal statistical indicator for the electricity industry, published annually by national energy statistics agencies.
读懂它就不会被\"装机量\"迷惑：1 吉瓦光伏一年的发电量大约只有 1 吉瓦核电: Understanding it prevents being misled by "installed capacity": 1 gigawatt of photovoltaic power generates electricity for only about one-fifth of what 1 gigawatt of nuclear power does in a year (see [[lcoe]]).
同样 1 吉瓦装机，一年能发多少电：核电约是光伏的五倍。: For the same 1 gigawatt of installed capacity, how much electricity can be generated in a year: Nuclear power is about five times that of photovoltaics.
获取一份能源要先投入多少能源；回报率太低的能源在经济上撑不起社会运转。: To obtain an energy source, one must first invest energy; energy sources with too low a return rate cannot sustain societal operations economically.
能源投资回报率（EROI）= 获得的能量 ÷ 获取过程中投入的能量。早期的大油田: Energy Return on Investment (EROI) = Energy Obtained ÷ Energy Invested in Acquisition. Early large oil fields had very high return rates; one unit of energy could be exchanged for dozens of units. Oil sands, deep-sea oil, and some biofuels have much lower return rates. The EROI of wind and photovoltaics increases continuously with technological progress, but specific values are highly sensitive to calculation boundaries (whether including energy storage, power grids), leading to large differences between studies.
1970 年代美国生态学家霍尔（Charles Hall）提出并推广这一概念。: In the 1970s, American ecologist Charles Hall proposed and promoted this concept.
EROI 提醒人们：能源转型不仅要看价格，还要看能量本身的\"净收益\"（见 [: EROI reminds people: Energy transition must look not only at price but also at the "net gain" of the energy itself (see [[lcoe]], [[biofuel]]).
让铀-235 等重核在可控的链式反应中裂变放热，用来烧水发电。: Make heavy nuclei such as Uranium-235 fission and release heat in a controlled chain reaction to boil water and generate electricity.
反应堆的关键是让链式反应**恰好**维持平衡——平均每次裂变正好引发一次新裂变（: The key of a reactor is to let the chain reaction **exactly** maintain balance—on average, each fission triggers exactly one new fission (critical state):
**燃料**：铀被做成陶瓷芯块，装进金属包壳组成燃料棒。**慢化剂**（水或石墨: **Fuel**: Uranium is made into ceramic fuel pellets and loaded into metal cladding to form fuel rods. **Moderator** (water or graphite): Slows down fast neutrons; slow neutrons are more easily captured by Uranium-235. **Control Rods**: Absorb neutrons; inserting them reduces power, withdrawing them increases power; in emergencies, all are inserted to shut down the reactor. **Coolant**: Carries heat out of the core to produce steam that drives a turbine for electricity generation.
1938 年底德国化学家哈恩（Otto Hahn）和施特拉斯曼发现铀核裂变，迈特: At the end of December 1938, German chemists Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann discovered nuclear fission; Lise Meitner and Otto Frisch subsequently provided the physical explanation. On December 2, 1942, a team led by Enrico Fermi built the first reactor CP-1 at the University of Chicago, achieving the first controlled chain reaction.
截至 2025 年底，全球约有 410 多座核电机组在运行，2025 年提供了约: As of the end of 2025, there are about 410+ nuclear power units operating globally, providing about 9% of electricity in 2025. Nuclear energy is a low-carbon stable power source, but it is always accompanied by concerns over nuclear accidents, spent fuel, and nuclear proliferation (see [[nuclear-safety]], [[nuclear-fuel-cycle]]).
核电站不可能像原子弹那样爆炸：燃料中铀-235 只占 3%–5%，武器需要约 9: A nuclear power plant cannot explode like an atomic bomb: Uranium-235 in the fuel accounts for only 3%–5%, while weapons require about 90%. Chernobyl and Fukushima were steam and hydrogen explosions with core melting, not nuclear explosions.
核裂变链式反应与反应堆：慢化剂让中子减速，控制棒吸收多余中子，把反应维持在\"每: Nuclear fission chain reaction and reactor: The moderator slows neutrons, control rods absorb excess neutrons, keeping the reaction in the critical state where "each fission triggers exactly one new fission".
用高压水同时做冷却剂和慢化剂的反应堆，是全球最常见的核电堆型。: A reactor using high-pressure water as both coolant and moderator is the most common nuclear power reactor type globally.
压水堆有两个互不相通的回路：**一回路**的高压水流过堆芯，被加热到约 320°: Pressurized Water Reactors (PWRs) have two mutually isolated circuits: **Primary Circuit**: High-pressure water flows through the core, heated to about 320°C, enters a steam generator to transfer heat to **Secondary Circuit** water, causing it to boil into steam that drives a turbine. The radioactive primary circuit water remains sealed within a thick containment structure; the secondary circuit steam is "clean". PWRs also have an inherent safety feature: as water temperature rises, moderation effect worsens, and power automatically decreases.
美国海军上将里科弗（Hyman Rickover）主导把压水堆用于核潜艇，195: American Admiral Hyman Rickover led the use of Pressurized Water Reactors for nuclear submarines; the USS Nautilus (N-57) was launched in 1954. In 1957, the Shippingport Atomic Power Station in Pennsylvania, USA, went online as the first full-scale commercial PWR power station. China's "Hualong One", America's AP1000, and France's EPR all belong to Pressurized Water Reactors.
压水堆约占全球在运核电机组的三分之二，是最成熟的堆型（见 [[smr]]、[[s: Pressurized Water Reactors account for about two-thirds of globally operating nuclear units and are the most mature reactor type (see [[smr]], [[submarine]]).
用快中子把不能裂变的铀-238 转化为钚-239，\"烧\"出比消耗更多的燃料。: Use fast neutrons to convert non-fissile Uranium-238 into Plutonium-239, "burning" out more fuel than consumed.
快堆不用慢化剂，让快中子直接引发裂变，冷却剂通常是液态钠或铅。堆芯外围包一层铀-: Fast reactors do not use moderators, allowing fast neutrons to directly trigger fission; coolants are typically liquid sodium or lead. A layer of Uranium-238 "breeding blanket" surrounds the core, absorbing excess neutrons to convert them into plutonium. Theoretically, this can increase uranium resource utilization by dozens of times. The challenge is that liquid sodium reacts violently with water and air, while handling plutonium involves nuclear proliferation risks.
1951 年 12 月，美国爱达荷州的实验增殖堆 EBR-I 点亮了 4 只灯泡: In December 1951, the Experimental Breeder Reactor-I (EBR-I) in Idaho, USA, lit four light bulbs, marking humanity's first generation of electricity from nuclear power. Russia's BN-600 and BN-800 reactors remain in commercial operation to this day.
快堆是\"闭式燃料循环\"的关键（见 [[nuclear-fuel-cycle]: Fast reactors are key to the 'closed fuel cycle' (see [[nuclear-fuel-cycle]]).
燃料溶在高温熔盐里循环的反应堆，可用钍作燃料，常压运行更安全。: A reactor where fuel circulates as a hot molten salt can use thorium as fuel; operation at atmospheric pressure is safer.
把核燃料直接溶解在高温熔融的盐里，燃料本身就是冷却剂（[[p:massenerg: Dissolving nuclear fuel directly into hot molten salt makes the fuel itself the coolant ([[p:massenergy|Mass–energy equivalence]]); molten salts remain liquid above 1000°C at atmospheric pressure, eliminating the need for high-pressure vessels.
含铀或钍的氟化物熔盐在反应堆和换热器之间循环流动，把热量带出。温度过高时熔盐膨胀: Fluoride melts containing uranium or thorium circulate between the reactor and heat exchangers to carry away heat. When temperatures become too high, the salt expands, automatically reducing reactivity; in emergency situations, a 'freeze plug' at the bottom of the core melts, allowing the molten salt to flow into lower tanks for automatic shutdown. It is also well-suited for thorium, which is abundant: Thorium-232 absorbs neutrons and converts into fissile Uranium-233. The challenge is that hot molten salts can corrode metals.
1965–1969 年美国橡树岭国家实验室运行了熔盐实验堆（MSRE）。2023: The US Oak Ridge National Laboratory operated the Molten Salt Experimental Reactor (MSRE) from 1965 to 1969. In 2023, China's 2-MW thorium-based molten salt experimental reactor in Wuwei, Gansu, reached criticality for the first time.
它仍处于实验阶段，被视为第四代核能的候选之一（见 [[smr]]）。: It remains in the experimental stage and is considered one of the candidates for fourth-generation nuclear energy (see [[smr]]).
功率较小、在工厂批量制造再运到现场组装的核电站，想用\"量产\"降低核电成本。: Power plants with smaller power outputs that are mass-produced in factories and assembled on-site aim to use 'mass production' to reduce nuclear power costs.
大型核电站造价高、工期长，常常超支；如果把反应堆做小、在工厂里像造飞机一样批量生: Large power plants have high construction costs and long timelines, often resulting in budget overruns; by making reactors smaller and mass-producing them in factories like aircraft manufacturing, it is possible to reduce costs using [[p:scale|Economies of scale & learning curves]] ([[p:massenergy|Mass–energy equivalence]]).
国际原子能机构把电功率 30 万千瓦以下的反应堆称为小型堆。它们大多在工厂预制成: The International Atomic Energy Agency classifies reactors with electric power output below 300 MW as small reactors. Most are pre-fabricated as modules in factories and transported to sites via truck, train, or ship for assembly; their small size means less core heat, allowing greater reliance on 'passive' cooling methods such as natural circulation and gravity, which do not require external power during accidents.
2020 年俄罗斯浮动核电站\"罗蒙诺索夫院士号\"投入商业运行；2023 年底: In 2020, Russia's floating nuclear power plant 'Academician Lomonosov' entered commercial operation; by the end of 2023, China's High-Temperature Gas-cooled Reactor demonstration project at Shidao Bay entered commercial operation. China's 'Linglong No.1' (ACP100) is a land-based commercial pressurized water small reactor; as of October 2026, it is undergoing hot-state functional testing. Starting in 2024, technology companies such as Google and Amazon have signed contracts with small reactor firms to supply power for [[data-center|Data centers]].
小堆能否兑现\"便宜\"的承诺尚未被证明：第一批机组造价仍然很高，批量化效应需要: Whether small reactors can deliver on the promise of 'low cost' has not yet been proven: initial unit costs remain high, and mass production effects require large order volumes to achieve (see [[pwr]]).
从采铀、浓缩、制燃料、发电到乏燃料后处理和地质处置的全过程。: The entire process from uranium mining, enrichment, fuel fabrication, power generation, spent fuel reprocessing, to geological disposal.
放射性同位素按固定的半衰期衰变，有些只需几天，有些长达数万年（[[p:decay: Radioactive isotopes decay with fixed half-lives; some last only a few days, while others can last tens of thousands of years ([[p:decay|Radioactive decay]]); the danger of spent fuel decreases gradually over time, and the core of disposal is isolating it from the human environment for a sufficiently long duration.
燃料循环从**前端**到**后端**：开采铀矿 → 提纯并转化 → [[uran: The fuel cycle runs from **front-end** to **back-end**: mining uranium ore → purification and conversion → [[uranium-enrichment|Enrichment]] → fabrication into fuel assemblies → burning in a reactor for 3–5 years → spent fuel removed is cooled in pools for many years before being transferred to dry storage casks. There are two paths thereafter: **once-through**, where spent fuel is directly buried deep underground; or **closed cycle**, where reprocessing extracts remaining usable uranium and plutonium to make new fuel, with only high-level waste glassified for disposal.
法国拉阿格后处理厂自 1960 年代运行至今。芬兰的翁加洛（Onkalo）是世界: France's La Hague reprocessing plant has operated since the 1960s. Finland's Onkalo is the world's first spent fuel deep geological repository, built about 400 meters into granite; as of October 2026, the Finnish Nuclear Safety Authority has issued a safety assessment supporting operational licensing, while government approval remains under review.
核废料\"放到哪里\"是核能最大的社会难题之一，体积其实不大，难在需要可信的万年: Where to place nuclear waste is one of the largest social challenges in nuclear energy; the volume is actually not large, but the difficulty lies in providing credible safety commitments spanning ten thousand years (see [[breeder-reactor]]).
用高速离心机把铀-235 的比例从 0.7% 提到约 3–5%（核电）或 90%: Using high-speed centrifuges to raise the proportion of Uranium-235 from 0.7% to about 3–5% (for nuclear power) or 90% (for weapons).
铀-235 和铀-238 化学性质几乎一样，只是重了 3 个中子；把铀变成气体高: Uranium-235 and Uranium-238 have almost identical chemical properties, differing only by three neutrons in mass; by converting uranium into gas and spinning it at high speed, heavier molecules are flung to the outside while lighter ones remain in the center, allowing separation with minimal effort ([[p:diffusion|Diffusion & membranes]], [[p:massenergy|Mass–energy equivalence]]).
铀先被转化为六氟化铀（UF₆），这种物质在稍高于室温时就能变成气体。气体进入每分: Uranium is first converted into uranium hexafluoride (UF₆), which becomes a gas at temperatures slightly above room temperature. This gas enters slender centrifuges spinning at tens of thousands of revolutions per minute; each unit can only increase the Uranium-235 proportion by a small amount, so hundreds or thousands must be linked in series as a 'cascade' for stepwise purification. Natural uranium contains about 0.7% Uranium-235; nuclear power fuel requires 3%–5%, while weapons-grade material needs approximately 90%.
1945 年美国\"曼哈顿计划\"在橡树岭用气体扩散法和电磁分离法生产出第一批武: In 1945, the US 'Manhattan Project' produced the first weapons-grade uranium in Oak Ridge using gas diffusion and electromagnetic separation methods. In the 1950s, German scientist Gernot Zippe and others perfected gas centrifuges in the Soviet Union; it consumes only a fraction of the electricity required by diffusion methods, becoming the mainstream technology today.
浓缩技术是\"两用\"的：同一套设备既能造核电燃料，也能造核武器原料，所以它是国: Enrichment technology is 'dual-use': the same equipment can produce nuclear power fuel or weapons-grade material, making it a key focus of international non-proliferation supervision (see [[nuclear-weapon]]).
三里岛、切尔诺贝利、福岛事故推动了多重屏障和非能动安全设计。: Accidents at Three Mile Island, Chernobyl, and Fukushima drove the development of multiple barriers and passive safety designs.
反应堆停堆后，裂变产物的衰变仍会持续放热，一开始约为满功率的 6%–7%（[[p: After reactor shutdown, decay heat from fission products continues to be released; initially it is about 6%–7% of full power ([[p:decay|Radioactive decay]]); if cooling is interrupted, the core may melt. Safety design ensures that 'cooling' never fails under any circumstances ([[p:feedback|Feedback & control]]).
核安全的核心思想是**纵深防御**：燃料芯块、包壳、压力容器、安全壳层层阻挡放射: The core concept of nuclear safety is **defense in depth**: fuel pellets, cladding, pressure vessels, and the safety shell form layered barriers against the release of radioactive materials, with multiple sets of cooling and power supply systems serving as backups. New designs emphasize **passive safety** even more: relying on gravity and natural convection for cooling, without dependence on electrical power.
1979 年美国三里岛事故发生部分堆芯熔化，泄漏很少；1986 年苏联切尔诺贝利: The 1979 Three Mile Island accident in the United States resulted in partial core melting with minimal leakage; the 1986 Chernobyl nuclear power plant explosion in the Soviet Union occurred during testing; the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster in Japan was caused by a tsunami-induced power loss, leading to core meltdowns in all three units. The latter two were classified as Level 7 accidents, the highest severity.
每一次事故都推动了更严格的监管和设计改进（见 [[pwr]]）。: Each accident has driven stricter regulation and design improvements (see [[pwr]]).
把氢的同位素加热到上亿度让原子核聚合放能，燃料几乎无穷但仍未商业化。: Heating isotopes of hydrogen to over one hundred million degrees allows atomic nuclei to fuse and release energy; the fuel is virtually inexhaustible but remains uncommercialized.
两个很轻的原子核（例如氢的同位素氘和氚）聚合成一个氦核时，总质量减少，少掉的质量: When two very light atomic nuclei (such as deuterium and tritium, isotopes of hydrogen) fuse into a helium nucleus, total mass decreases; the missing mass converts into enormous energy ([[p:massenergy|Mass–energy equivalence]]); the Sun shines this way. The challenge lies in the fact that all atomic nuclei carry positive charge and repel each other; they must be heated to over one hundred million degrees so they collide at extremely high speeds.
最容易实现的是**氘—氚聚变**：氘核和氚核聚合成一个氦核和一个高能中子，放出: The easiest to achieve is **deuterium-tritium fusion**: a deuterium nucleus and a tritium nucleus fuse into a helium nucleus and a high-energy neutron, releasing 17.6 MeV of energy. By mass, the energy released is several times that of fission and millions of times that of burning fossil fuels.
要持续放能，温度（约 1 亿至 1.5 亿°C）、密度和约束时间三者的乘积必须超: To sustain energy release, the product of temperature (approximately 100 to 150 million °C), density, and confinement time must exceed a threshold (the Lawson criterion). Since no container can withstand one hundred million degrees, there are two paths: using strong magnetic fields to suspend and confine the plasma (see [[tokamak]]), or using strong lasers to compress and ignite fuel in an instant (see [[inertial-confinement-fusion]]).
1950 年代美苏开始研究受控聚变。2022 年 12 月，美国国家点火装置（N: The United States and Soviet Union began research into controlled fusion in the 1950s. In December 2022, the National Ignition Facility (NIF) in the United States achieved "ignition" for the first time: fusion output was 3.15 MJ, exceeding the 2.05 MJ of laser energy delivered to the target; in April 2025, the record was raised to 8.6 MJ. The International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER) under construction in France, according to the new plan announced in 2024, is scheduled to begin scientific operations in 2034 and deuterium-tritium experiments in 2039.
聚变至今还没有一座电站发出净电力。如果成功，它将提供几乎取之不尽、不排碳、没有长: To date, no fusion power station has issued net electricity. If successful, it will provide an energy source that is virtually inexhaustible, carbon-free, and produces no long-lived high-level radioactive waste; when commercialization will occur remains **speculative**.
\"点火\"只是相对射到靶上的激光能量而言，激光器从电网取用的电能还要多出百倍左: "Ignition" refers only to the ratio relative to laser energy delivered to the target; the electrical power consumed by the lasers from the grid is still about one hundred times greater.
氘—氚聚变：两个轻核聚合成氦核并放出一个高能中子；右侧是两条约束路线——磁约束与: Deuterium-tritium fusion: two light nuclei fuse into a helium nucleus and release a high-energy neutron; on the right are the two confinement routes—magnetic confinement and inertial confinement.
用环形强磁场把上亿度的等离子体悬空约束住的聚变装置。: A fusion device that suspends and confines plasma at over one hundred million degrees using circular strong magnetic fields.
带电粒子在磁场中会受力绕着磁力线做螺旋运动，跑不出去（[[p:lorentz|电: Charged particles experience force in a magnetic field, spiraling around magnetic field lines without escaping ([[p:lorentz|Lorentz force]]); by bending the magnetic field lines into a closed loop, the over-one-hundred-million-degree plasma can be suspended and confined within a "magnetic cage" without touching any vessel wall.
托卡马克是一个甜甜圈形状的真空室，外面绕着巨大的线圈：环向线圈产生沿圆环方向的强: A Tokamak is a vacuum chamber shaped like a donut, surrounded by massive coils: toroidal coils generate strong magnetic fields along the circular direction, and the central solenoid induces millions of amperes of current within the plasma; the current's own magnetic field twists the field lines into spirals, thereby stabilizing confinement. Modern devices mostly use superconducting magnets to enable long-duration operation.
托卡马克由苏联物理学家塔姆（Igor Tamm）和萨哈罗夫（Andrei Sak: The Tokamak was proposed by Soviet physicists Igor Tamm and Andrei Sakharov in the early 1950s; the first T-1 unit was completed at the Kurchatov Institute in Moscow in 1958; its outstanding performance in 1968 made it the international mainstream. In January 2025, China's EAST achieved high-confinement operation for 1066 seconds; in February of the same year, France's WEST sustained plasma for 1337 seconds.
ITER 和大多数商业聚变公司都采用托卡马克或其变体（见 [[fusion-po: ITER and most commercial fusion companies adopt the Tokamak or its variants (see [[fusion-power]], [[superconductivity]]).
用强激光瞬间压缩燃料小球引发聚变；美国 NIF 于 2022 年首次实现\"点火: Using strong lasers to instantly compress a fuel pellet to trigger fusion; the US NIF achieved "ignition" for the first time in 2022.
不去长时间关住燃料，而是在极短的瞬间把它压到极高的密度和温度，在燃料还来不及飞散: Without confining fuel for long durations, it is compressed to extremely high density and temperature in an instant; fusion completes before the fuel has time to disperse—relying on the fuel's own inertia ([[p:massenergy|Mass–energy equivalence]]).
美国国家点火装置（NIF）用 192 束强激光同时射入一个米粒大小的金属圆筒，圆: The National Ignition Facility (NIF) at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory used 192 beams of strong lasers simultaneously to strike a metal cylinder the size of a grain of rice; the inner wall was heated, emitting X-rays that uniformly baked a deuterium-tritium fuel pellet the size of a peppercorn in the center. The outer shell instantly evaporated and ejected outward; the reaction force compressed the fuel inward to extremely high density, with central temperatures exceeding one hundred million degrees, triggering fusion.
NIF 位于劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室，2022 年 12 月首次实现聚变输出超过: The NIF is located at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory; in December 2022, it achieved "ignition" for the first time, where fusion output exceeded laser input.
它首次证明了实验室聚变可以\"产出大于投入\"，但离发电还需要提高激光效率和每秒: It proved for the first time that laboratory fusion can produce more than input, but further improvements in laser efficiency and repetition frequency (multiple times per second) are needed before power generation (see [[fusion-power]], [[laser]]).

高处的水具有重力势能，流下来时变成动能，推动水轮机发电（[[p:energy|能: Water at high altitude possesses gravitational potential energy; as it flows down, it becomes kinetic energy, driving a water turbine to generate electricity ([[p:energy|Conservation of energy]], [[p:gravity|Gravitation & orbital mechanics]]); the higher the head and the greater the flow, the greater the power.

Batteries store not electricity but this kind of "wants to react but is blocked" chemical energy.
任何电池都有四个部件：**负极**（放电时失去电子）、**正极**（得到电子）、: Any battery has four components: **negative electrode** (loses electrons during discharge), **positive electrode** (gains electrons), **electrolyte** (allows only ions to pass, not electrons), and **separator** (prevents short circuits). During discharge, electrons flow from the negative electrode through the external circuit to the positive electrode doing work, while ions traverse the electrolyte internally to maintain charge balance. Rechargeable batteries reverse the reaction by pushing electrons and ions back via an external power source during charging.
电压由两种电极材料\"抢电子能力\"的差决定，容量由电极材料的多少决定。: Voltage is determined by the difference in "electron-grabbing ability" between the two electrode materials, while capacity is determined by the amount of electrode material.
1780 年代意大利的伽伐尼（Luigi Galvani）发现青蛙腿接触两种金属: In the 1780s, Luigi Galvani in Italy discovered that frog legs twitch when touching two metals. In 1800, Alessandro Volta stacked zinc plates, copper plates, and cloth soaked with salt water layer by layer to make a "voltaic pile," obtaining continuous current for the first time; the voltage unit "volt" is thus named. In 1859, rechargeable [[lead-acid-battery|Lead–acid battery]] appeared, and in 1886, dry cells emerged.
电池让电可以随身携带。它也让电学研究第一次有了稳定电源，催生了电解、电磁学等一系: Batteries allow electricity to be carried around. They also gave electrochemistry its first stable power source, spawning a series of discoveries including electrolysis and electromagnetism (see [[electrolysis]], [[lithium-ion]]).
电池的\"毫安时\"只是电量，能量还要乘以电压。同样 5000 毫安时，3.7: The battery's "ampere-hour" rating is merely charge; energy must be multiplied by voltage. Similarly, a 5000 ampere-hour lithium-ion battery at 3.7 volts stores about three times the energy of a 1.2-volt nickel-hydrogen battery.
电池的基本结构：电子从负极经外电路流向正极做功，离子在内部穿过电解质保持电荷平衡: The basic structure of a battery: electrons flow from the negative terminal through the external circuit to the positive terminal to do work, while ions traverse the electrolyte internally to maintain charge balance.
第一种可充电电池，便宜可靠，至今用于汽车启动和备用电源。: The first rechargeable battery; cheap and reliable, still used today for automobile starting and backup power.
铅和二氧化铅在硫酸中发生氧化还原反应，放电时两极都变成硫酸铅，充电时又能变回去（: Lead and lead dioxide undergo a redox reaction in sulfuric acid; during discharge both electrodes become lead sulfate, and they revert during charging (see [[p:redox|Redox & electrochemistry]]).
每个单格电压约 2 伏，汽车用的 12 伏电池由 6 格串联。它能在瞬间输出几百: Each cell has a voltage of about 2 volts; the 12-volt automobile battery consists of six cells in series. The disadvantages are weight, low energy density, and lead toxicity.

一个半世纪后，几乎每辆燃油车里仍有一块铅酸电池，它也广泛用于电动自行车、通信基站: Half a century later, almost every fuel-powered car still has a lead-acid battery; it is also widely used in electric bicycles, communication base stations, and uninterruptible power supplies (see [[battery]], [[automobile]]).

锂是最轻的金属，也最爱丢电子，所以能做出电压高、重量轻的电池（[[p:redox: Lithium is the lightest metal and loves to lose electrons, so it can create batteries with high voltage and low weight (see [[p:redox|Redox & electrochemistry]], [[p:energydensity|Energy density]]). 负极通常是石墨，层与层之间能塞进锂离子；正极是钴酸锂、三元材料（镍钴锰）或磷酸铁: The negative terminal is usually graphite, with layers capable of accommodating lithium ions; the positive terminal consists of lithium cobalt oxide, ternary materials (nickel-cobalt-manganese), or lithium iron phosphate and other lithium-containing compounds. 电池管理系统（BMS）时刻监测每个电芯的电压和温度：过充、过热或刺穿可能引发\": The Battery Management System (BMS) constantly monitors the voltage and temperature of each cell: overcharging, overheating, or puncturing can trigger "thermal runaway," causing the electrolyte to catch fire; this is the primary safety risk of lithium batteries.

Stanley Whittingham) proposed embedded electrodes; in 1980, American Goodenough (John Goodenough) discovered the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode, raising voltage to about 4 volts; in 1985, Japanese Yoshino (Akira Yoshino) used carbon materials for the negative terminal to create a safe prototype. 它撑起了笔记本电脑、手机和 [[electric-vehicle|电动车]]，也: It supports laptops, mobile phones, and [[electric-vehicle|Electric vehicle (EV)]], and is also becoming the main force for grid energy storage. Battery pack prices have dropped significantly (see [[p:scale|Economies of scale & learning curves]]): according to Bloomberg New Energy Finance, the global average in 2025 fell to $108 per kilowatt-hour, a 93% drop from 2010; energy storage battery packs are about $70.
\"摇椅电池\"：充电时锂离子从正极搬进石墨负极，放电时搬回来，电子则走外电路做: "Swing-chair battery": during charging, lithium ions move from the positive terminal into the graphite negative terminal; during discharge, they return, while electrons travel through the external circuit to do work.
用磷酸铁锂做正极，不含钴镍，更便宜更安全，能量密度稍低。: Using lithium iron phosphate as the positive terminal eliminates cobalt and nickel, making it cheaper and safer, though with slightly lower energy density.
磷酸铁锂的橄榄石晶体结构里，磷和氧结合得非常牢固，即使过热也不容易释放氧气助燃（: In the olivine crystal structure of lithium iron phosphate, phosphorus and oxygen are bound very firmly; even under overheating conditions, they do not easily release oxygen to aid combustion (see [[p:structure|Structure determines properties]], [[p:redox|Redox & electrochemistry]]).
它用磷酸铁锂（LiFePO₄）代替含镍钴的三元材料做正极，原料是储量丰富的铁和磷: It uses lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO₄) instead of nickel-cobalt-containing ternary materials as the positive terminal; raw materials are abundant iron and phosphorus, eliminating expensive cobalt and nickel with supply risks. BYD's "Blade Battery" and other structural innovations place cells directly into the battery pack, compensating for insufficient energy density.
1997 年古迪纳夫团队发表磷酸铁锂正极论文。: In 1997, Goodenough's team published a paper on lithium iron phosphate positive electrodes.
它已成为电动车和储能的主流：据国际能源署，2025 年新增电网电池储能中约九成采: It has become mainstream for electric vehicles and energy storage: according to the International Energy Agency, about 90% of new grid battery storage in 2025 used lithium iron phosphate (see [[lithium-ion]], [[grid-storage]]).
用固体电解质代替易燃液体，有望更安全、能量更高，量产仍在攻关。: Replacing flammable liquids with solid electrolytes promises higher safety and energy; mass production is still under development.
电池里离子必须能穿过电解质（[[p:redox|电化学]]）；如果用能导锂离子的: Ions must be able to pass through the electrolyte in a battery (see [[p:redox|Electrochemistry]]); replacing flammable liquid electrolytes with lithium-ion-conducting solids could eliminate fire risks and allow lithium metal as the negative terminal for higher energy.
固体电解质主要有硫化物、氧化物和聚合物三条路线。它既充当电解质又充当隔膜，能阻挡: Solid electrolytes mainly follow three routes: sulfides, oxides, and polymers. It serves both as electrolyte and separator, blocking lithium dendrite penetration. Challenges include cracking at the interface between solid and electrodes due to expansion and contraction during charge-discharge cycles; ionic conductivity and large-scale manufacturing costs are also barriers. "Semi-solid batteries" in between have been the first to enter vehicles.
多家车企和电池厂宣布 2027–2030 年前后小批量量产全固态电池，届时能否实: Multiple automakers and battery manufacturers announced small-scale mass production of all-solid-state batteries around 2027–2030; whether this will be realized remains to be seen.
一旦成熟，电动车续航和安全性有望再上一个台阶（见 [[lithium-ion]]: Once matured, electric vehicle range and safety are expected to advance to the next level (see [[lithium-ion]]).
用储量丰富的钠代替锂，成本低、耐低温，适合储能和低价车。: Using abundant sodium to replace lithium offers lower costs and better low-temperature performance, making it suitable for energy storage and low-cost vehicles.
钠和锂在元素周期表中同属一族，化学性质相似，也能在正负极之间来回\"摇摆\"（[: Sodium and lithium belong to the same group in the periodic table, share similar chemical properties, and can "swing back and forth" between positive and negative electrodes ([[p:redox|Redox & electrochemistry]]); sodium ions are larger and heavier, resulting in lower energy density.

Sodium is extremely abundant in seawater and the Earth's crust, is inexpensive, and is not constrained by lithium resources; its low-temperature performance and safety are good, with both positive and negative electrode current collectors capable of using cheap aluminum foil. The disadvantage is that energy density currently matches only the mid-to-low levels of lithium iron phosphate batteries.
钠离子电池的研究与锂离子几乎同时起步于 1980 年代；2021 年宁德时代发布: Research into sodium-ion batteries began almost simultaneously with lithium-ion in the 1980s; CATL released its first-generation product in 2021, and small-scale applications on electric vehicles began starting in 2023.
它被视为储能、两轮车和低价电动车的补充方案，可以缓解对锂资源的依赖（见 [[li: It is regarded as a supplementary solution for energy storage, two-wheeled vehicles, and low-cost electric vehicles, helping to alleviate dependence on lithium resources (see [[lithium-ion]], [[grid-storage]]).
把电解液存在两个大罐里泵送反应，容量只看罐子大小，适合长时储能。: Storing electrolyte in two large tanks and pumping it through the reaction chamber; capacity depends only on tank size, suitable for long-duration energy storage.
把参与氧化还原反应的物质溶在电解液里，存放在电池外面的大罐中（[[p:redox: Dissolving substances participating in redox reactions into electrolyte and storing them in large tanks outside the battery ([[p:redox|Redox & electrochemistry]]); total energy depends only on tank size, while power depends only on the size of the reaction stack; both can be designed independently.
最成熟的是**全钒液流电池**：两种不同价态的钒离子溶液分别存在两个储罐里，用泵: The most mature is the **all-vanadium flow battery**: solutions containing vanadium ions in different valence states exist separately in two tanks, pumped into a central stack separated by an ion-exchange membrane where electrons are exchanged. It does not catch fire, has a lifespan of over 20 years, and is suitable for long-duration energy storage exceeding 4 hours. Disadvantages include low energy density, large footprint, and high initial investment.
1970 年代美国航天局研究铁铬液流电池；1980 年代澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的: The US National Aeronautics and Space Administration studied iron-chromium flow batteries in the 1970s; Maria Skyllas-Kazacos of the University of New South Wales in Australia invented the all-vanadium flow battery in the 1980s.
它是长时储能的重要候选，中国已建成数十万千瓦级的示范电站（见 [[grid-st: It is an important candidate for long-duration energy storage, and China has built demonstration power stations at the scale of tens of ten-thousand kilowatts (see [[grid-storage]]).
在电网里成规模地存电放电，解决风光\"看天吃饭\"的波动。: Storing and discharging electricity on a large scale within the grid to address fluctuations caused by wind and solar power depending on weather conditions.
电网必须实时平衡（[[p:energy|能量守恒]]），而风和光\"看天吃饭\": The grid must balance in real time ([[p:energy|Conservation of energy]], while wind and solar depend on weather; energy storage acts like the grid's "reservoir," storing excess electricity and releasing it when demand is low.
电网储能按时长分工：**秒级到分钟级**用于稳定频率，电池响应最快；**几小时级: Grid-scale energy storage is divided by duration: **second-to-minute level** is used for frequency stabilization, with batteries having the fastest response; **hour-level** is used to shift midday solar power to evening peak hours, with lithium-ion batteries (especially lithium iron phosphate) and [[pumped-storage|Pumped-storage hydropower]] as main forces; **multi-day to seasonal levels** remain challenging, with candidates including [[flow-battery|Flow battery]], compressed air, hydrogen energy, etc. Energy storage also alleviates transmission line congestion and delays expensive grid upgrades.
2017 年特斯拉在南澳大利亚建成 10 万千瓦的电池储能站，展示了电池在电网中: In 2017, Tesla built a 100-kilowatt battery energy storage station in South Australia, demonstrating the value of batteries in the grid. 储能成本的快速下降，正在把风电和光伏从\"补充电源\"变成可以调度的主力电源（见: The rapid decline in energy storage costs is transforming wind and solar power from "supplementary power sources" into dispatchable main power sources (see [[lithium-ion]], [[load-balancing]]).
靠电极表面吸附离子储电，充放电极快、寿命长，但存的电少。: Storing electricity via ion adsorption on electrode surfaces; fast charging and discharging, long lifespan, but low energy storage capacity.

超级电容的充放电只是离子\"贴上\"和\"离开\"电极表面，没有化学反应，所以能: Super capacitor charging and discharging involve only ions "attaching" and "leaving" the electrode surface without chemical reactions; thus, they can be fully charged in seconds and cycle over a million times, with good low-temperature performance. 1957 年美国通用电气工程师贝克尔申请了双电层电容专利；1970 年代末日本: In 1957, GE engineer Becker in the US applied for a patent on double-layer capacitors; in the late 1970s, Japan's NEC launched them to market under the name "super capacitor".
它与电池互补，一个擅长功率、一个擅长能量（见 [[battery]]、[[cap: It complements batteries: one excels at power, the other at energy (see [[battery]], [[capacitor-resistor-inductor]]).
用管道输送煤气点灯，第一次让城市在夜晚普遍明亮。: Using pipes to transport gas for lighting first made cities universally bright at night.
煤加热隔绝空气时会分解出含氢气、甲烷和一氧化碳的可燃气体，燃烧时放出光和热（[[: When coal is heated in an air-free environment, it decomposes into combustible gases containing hydrogen, methane, and carbon monoxide; combustion releases light and heat ([[p:bond|Chemical bonds & chemical energy]]).
煤气厂把煤放进密闭的炉子里干馏，产生的\"煤气\"经净化后储存在大型储气罐中，再: Gas plants dry distill coal in sealed furnaces; the resulting "gas" is purified and stored in large gas storage tanks, then transported via underground pipelines to streets and residential areas. 煤气灯第一次让城市夜晚普遍明亮，延长了工厂的工作时间，也开创了\"用管网向千家万: Gas lamps made city nights generally bright for the first time, extended factory working hours, and pioneered the model of 'delivering energy to thousands of homes via a network,' which later power grids and water supply systems adopted (see [[incandescent-bulb]]).

任何物体被加热到足够高的温度都会发光，温度越高光越白（热辐射，[[p:heat|: Any object heated to a sufficiently high temperature emits light, becoming whiter as the temperature rises (thermal radiation, [[p:heat|Heat transfer]]); when electric current passes through a resistive wire, it generates heat ([[p:ohm|Ohm's law]]), and heating the filament to over 2000°C enables illumination.

原子里的电子只能待在特定能级上，被撞到高能级后跳回来，会放出特定波长的光（[[p: Electrons inside atoms can only occupy specific energy levels; when struck and promoted to higher energy levels, they return to lower levels, emitting light of a specific wavelength ([[p:levels|Quantized energy levels]]).

避雷针由三部分组成：屋顶上的金属接闪杆、沿外墙向下的粗导线、埋入地下的接地体。雷: Lightning rods consist of three parts: a metal air-termination rod on the roof, a thick wire running down the exterior wall, and a grounding electrode buried underground. 1750 年美国的富兰克林（Benjamin Franklin）提出用尖头金属杆: In 1750, Benjamin Franklin in the United States proposed the idea of using a pointed metal rod to attract lightning; in 1752, he conducted his famous kite experiment, proving that lightning is electricity, and installed a lightning rod in Philadelphia later that same year.
这是人类第一次用电学知识保护自己，也让\"电\"从客厅里的魔术变成了严肃的科学。: This was humanity's first use of electrical knowledge to protect itself, turning 'electricity' from a living-room magic trick into serious science. Today, skyscrapers, power lines, and aircraft all feature similar lightning protection designs (see [[grounding-safety]]).

英国物理学家汤姆孙让阴极射线穿过电场和磁场，测量它偏转的程度，算出组成射线的粒子: British physicist Thomson passed cathode rays through electric and magnetic fields, measuring their deflection to calculate that the particles composing the rays had a mass about 1800 times smaller than that of a hydrogen atom, regardless of the metal used for the cathode.
