1989 年 3 月，英国物理学家伯纳斯-李（Tim Berners-Lee）在: In March 1989, British physicist Tim Berners-Lee proposed an information management scheme at CERN; by the end of 1990, he wrote the first browser and server. In August 1991, the World Wide Web was opened to the public; in April 1993, CERN announced that World Wide Web technology would be made free for everyone to use. In 1994, he founded the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C), later receiving the Turing Award of 2016.
万维网把互联网从科研工具变成了大众的信息空间，催生了 [[search-engi: The World Wide Web transformed the Internet from a research tool into a public information space, giving birth to [[search-engine|Search engine]], [[e-commerce|E-commerce]], and [[social-media|Social media]].
伯纳斯-李没有为万维网申请专利，这被认为是它迅速普及的关键。: Tim Berners-Lee did not apply for patents on the World Wide Web; this is considered a key factor in its rapid adoption.
点击一个链接：浏览器解析 URL、经 DNS 找到服务器，用 HTTP 取回 H: Clicking a link: the browser parses the URL, finds the server via DNS, retrieves HTML using HTTP, and then renders it into a page. Web pages are interconnected through hyperlinks.
HTML 描述网页内容和结构，HTTP 规定浏览器如何向服务器请求网页。: HTML describes web page content and structure; HTTP stipulates how browsers request web pages from servers.
把\"内容是什么\"（HTML）和\"怎么取内容\"（HTTP）分开，各自标准化: Separate "what the content is" (HTML) and "how to retrieve the content" (HTTP), standardize each independently, and any browser can view any website ([[p:standard|Standardization]]).
**HTML**（超文本标记语言）用成对的标签描述网页结构，如 `<h1>` 表:
**HTML** (HyperText Markup Language) uses paired tags to describe web page structure, such as `

` for titles, `` for links, and `` for images; appearance is handled by CSS, and interaction by [[javascript|JavaScript]]. **HTTP** (HyperText Transfer Protocol) is a "question-and-answer" system: the browser sends requests like "GET /index.html," and the server returns a status code (200 indicates success, 404 indicates not found) along with content. HTTP itself does not remember who you are, so it relies on [[web-cookies|Cookies & online privacy]] to maintain login status. Newer versions of HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 allow multiple files to be transmitted simultaneously over a single connection, resulting in faster loading times.
1990–1991 年伯纳斯-李设计了 HTML 和 HTTP 的最初版本；20: Tim Berners-Lee designed the initial versions of HTML and HTTP between 1990 and 1991; in 2014, HTML5 became an official W3C recommended standard.
这两项标准让网页成为最通用的软件界面（见 [[world-wide-web]]、: These two standards make web pages the most universal software interface (see [[world-wide-web]], [[https-tls]]).
把网页渲染成图文界面的程序；Mosaic 让普通人第一次轻松上网。: A program that renders web pages into graphical interfaces; Mosaic allowed ordinary people to access the Internet for the first time with ease.
把复杂的协议、排版和代码执行都藏在一个窗口后面，用户只需点击链接（[[p:abs: Hide complex protocols, formatting, and code execution behind a single window; users only need to click links ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
浏览器取回 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 和图片后，渲染引擎把 HTM: After retrieving HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and images, the rendering engine parses HTML into a "document tree," combines it with CSS to calculate the position and style of each element, and then draws it on the screen; the JavaScript engine executes programs within web pages, enabling the page to respond to clicks and update in real time. Modern browsers also run each web page in an isolated "sandbox" to prevent malicious web pages from stealing data.
1990 年伯纳斯-李写出第一个浏览器 WorldWideWeb。1993 年美: In 1990, Tim Berners-Lee wrote the first browser, WorldWideWeb. In 1993, Marc Andreessen and others at the University of Illinois in the United States released Mosaic, which was the first time images and text were displayed on the same page; Andreessen subsequently founded Netscape. This was followed by the "browser wars" between Netscape and IE; in 2008, Google released Chrome.
浏览器成了通往互联网的主要窗口，许多软件直接以网页应用的形式运行（见 [[wor: Browsers have become the primary window to the Internet; many software applications run directly as web-based applications (see [[world-wide-web]], [[javascript]]).
在网页传输外面加一层加密和身份验证，让网购和网银变得安全。: Add a layer of encryption and authentication outside web page transmission, making online shopping and banking secure.
利用\"公开加密、私密解密\"的数学单向性，素不相识的两方能在被人窃听的网络上安: Leverage the mathematical one-way property of "public encryption, private decryption" to allow two strangers to securely negotiate a shared key on a network that can be eavesdropped ([[p:oneway|One-way functions]]).
浏览器连接网站时先进行 TLS\"握手\"：网站出示**数字证书**，证书由受信: When a browser connects to a website, it first performs a TLS 'handshake': the website presents a **digital certificate**, which is signed by a trusted Certificate Authority (CA) proving 'this public key indeed belongs to this website'; both parties negotiate a temporary session key using [[public-key-crypto|Public-key cryptography]], and all subsequent data uses this key for fast symmetric encryption, accompanied by a checksum to prevent tampering. The lock-shaped icon in the address bar indicates that the connection is encrypted.
1995 年网景公司发布 SSL 2.0（1.0 从未公开），1999 年 IE: In 1995, Netscape released SSL 2.0 (version 1.0 was never publicly released); in 1999, the IETF standardized it as TLS. In 2015, the 'Let's Encrypt' project began offering free certificates, and currently, the vast majority of web browsing is encrypted.
没有 HTTPS，就没有网购、网银和在线支付（见 [[digital-signa: Without HTTPS, there would be no online shopping, online banking, or online payments (see [[digital-signature]], [[http-html]], [[cryptography]]).
爬取全网网页、建立倒排索引并按相关性排序，让人能在海量信息中找到答案。: Crawling all web pages on the internet, building an inverted index, and ranking by relevance allows users to find answers amidst a sea of information.
网页有几十亿个，逐个查找根本不可能；预先把所有网页的词语做成一本\"倒排索引\": There are several billion webpages; searching for them one by one is fundamentally impossible. Pre-build an 'inverted index' of all webpage words—listing every webpage containing each word behind it—so that queries only need to flip through a few pages of the index ([[p:complexity|complexity]]). Among thousands or tens of thousands of matching results, use inter-page link relationships to judge which are more credible and important ([[p:network|network]]).
搜索引擎分三步。**爬取**：\"爬虫\"程序顺着链接不断下载新网页，并定期回访: Search engines proceed in three steps. **Crawling**: 'crawler' programs follow links to continuously download new webpages and periodically revisit them. **Indexing**: Break webpages into words and build an inverted index of 'word → webpage list', like the back-of-book index pages. **Ranking**: Upon receiving a query, find webpages containing these words from the index, then score and rank them based on hundreds of signals including keyword position, webpage quality, links (see [[pagerank]]), freshness, etc., returning results within fractions of a second.
近年来，搜索引擎越来越多地借助 [[machine-learning|机器学习]: In recent years, search engines have increasingly relied on [[machine-learning|Machine learning]] to understand the meaning of queries rather than just matching literal text; since 2024, companies like Google have begun placing summary-style answers generated by [[llm|Large language model (LLM)]] at the top of results.
1990 年加拿大的 Archie 是最早的搜索工具；1994–1995 年雅虎: Archie from Canada in 1990 was the earliest search tool; Yahoo, Lycos, and AltaVista appeared successively between 1994–1995. In 1998, Larry Page and Sergey Brin from Stanford University founded Google; in 2000, Li Yanhong founded Baidu.
搜索引擎成为人们获取信息的第一入口，搜索广告也成为互联网最赚钱的生意之一（见 [: Search engines have become the primary entry point for people to obtain information, and search advertising has also become one of the most profitable businesses on the internet (see [[online-advertising]]). Websites perform 'search engine optimization' (SEO) to achieve higher rankings.
搜索引擎三步走：爬虫顺着链接下载网页，建立\"词→网页\"倒排索引，查询时取出匹: The three steps of search engines are: crawlers follow links to download webpages, build an inverted index of 'word → webpage', and upon querying, extract matching webpages and rank them.
把链接当投票，被重要网页链接的网页更重要，奠定了谷歌的排名算法。: Treat links as votes; webpages linked by important webpages become more important, establishing Google's ranking algorithm.
一个网页被链接，就像得到一票；来自重要网页的票分量更重。这是一个\"随机浏览者\: A webpage being linked is like receiving a vote; votes from important webpages carry greater weight. This is a 'random surfer' model: following links and randomly clicking down, the probability of stopping increases with importance ([[p:probability|probability]]).
每个网页的得分平均分给它链接出去的网页，反复迭代直到各网页得分稳定。为避免陷入死: Each webpage's score is averaged out to its outgoing linked webpages, iterated repeatedly until each webpage's score stabilizes. To avoid infinite loops, the model assumes surfers occasionally randomly jump to any webpage. Mathematically, this is equivalent to finding the eigenvector of a massive matrix.
1998 年佩奇和布林发表论文提出 PageRank，名字既指\"网页\"（pa: In 1998, Page and Brin published a paper proposing PageRank; the name refers both to 'webpage' (page) and takes its surname from Page.
PageRank 让谷歌的结果明显优于对手，助其崛起（见 [[search-en: PageRank made Google's results significantly superior to competitors, helping it rise (see [[search-engine]]). Today, it is merely one of many ranking signals.
在网上浏览、下单和支付商品，配合物流重塑了零售业。: Browsing online, placing orders, and paying for goods, combined with logistics reshaping the retail industry.
网上的\"货架\"无限长、全天开放，搜索和推荐能把小众商品送到真正需要的人面前（: The 'shelf' on the internet is infinitely long and open 24/7; search and recommendation can deliver niche products to those who truly need them ([[p:scale|scale]]); more buyers attract more sellers, and more sellers attract even more buyers ([[p:network|Network effects]]).
电子商务由几部分组成：商品展示与搜索、[[recommender-system|: E-commerce consists of several parts: product display and search, [[recommender-system|Recommender system]], shopping cart and checkout, [[online-payment|Online payment gateways]], warehouse and logistics delivery, as well as review and after-sales systems. Platform models (such as Taobao) only facilitate buyers and sellers while charging commissions and advertising fees; self-operated models (such as JD.com) handle their own procurement, warehousing, and delivery. New forms like live-streamed commerce and social e-commerce continue to emerge.
1994 年贝索斯（Jeff Bezos）创办亚马逊，1995 年 7 月上线卖: Jeff Bezos founded Amazon in 1994, launched selling books in July 1995; eBay was established in 1995. Jack Ma founded Alibaba in 1999, launching Taobao in 2003.
电子商务重塑了零售业和物流业，\"双十一\"等购物节的单日交易额以千亿元计（见: E-commerce reshaped the retail and logistics industries; daily transaction volumes of shopping festivals like 'Double 11' reach into the trillions of yuan (see [[logistics-automation]]).
按关键词、人群和点击精准投放的广告，是许多免费互联网服务的主要收入。: Ads targeted precisely by keywords, demographics, and clicks constitute the primary revenue for many free internet services.
免费服务的成本由广告主承担；平台掌握的用户数据越多，广告越精准，每次展示越值钱（: The costs of free services are borne by advertisers; the more user data platforms control, the more precise the ads become, and the more valuable each impression ([[p:incentives|incentives]]).
广告按展示次数、点击次数或实际成交计费。搜索广告按关键词竞价；展示广告在你打开网: Ads are charged based on impressions, clicks, or actual transactions. Search ads compete by keywords; display ads, within fractions of a second when you open a webpage, are auctioned via 'real-time bidding' to the highest bidder, based on interest profiles recorded in [[web-cookies|Cookies & online privacy]] and similar data.
1994 年 10 月 27 日 HotWired 网站刊登了公认的第一个横幅广: On October 27, 1994, HotWired website published the first recognized banner ad, with a click-through rate as high as approximately 44%. In 2000, Google launched AdWords keyword advertising.
广告养活了大量免费互联网服务，也引发了隐私和\"注意力经济\"的争议（见 [[s: Advertising sustains a large number of free internet services, but it has also sparked controversy over privacy and the "attention economy" (see [[search-engine]], [[social-media]]).
网站存在浏览器里的小文件，用来记住登录状态，也被用来跨站追踪用户。: Websites contain small files stored in browsers to remember login status; these are also used for cross-site user tracking.
HTTP 每次请求都是独立的，服务器记不住你是谁；让浏览器保存一小段标识信息，每: Each HTTP request is independent; the server cannot remember who you are. By having the browser save a small piece of identifier information and attach it on every visit, the server can "recognize" you ([[p:info|information]]).
网站第一次响应时让浏览器存下一个 Cookie，如\"会话编号 = 12345\: On the website's first response, the browser stores the next Cookie, such as "session number = 12345"; thereafter, each time the browser visits that website, it automatically attaches it to maintain login and remember shopping carts. If an advertiser's code is embedded in the webpage, the advertiser's "third-party Cookie" can track your browsing trajectory across websites.
1994 年网景公司的蒙图利（Lou Montulli）发明 Cookie，用于: In 1994, Lou Montulli of Netscape invented Cookies to implement shopping carts.
Cookie 让网站能\"记住\"用户，也成为在线追踪的主要工具。欧盟《通用数据: Cookies enable websites to "remember" users and have become a primary tool for online tracking. Regulations such as the EU's General Data Protection Regulation therefore require websites to obtain user consent (see [[online-advertising]], [[web-browser]]).
让每个人都能发布内容、关注他人、形成社交关系网的平台。: Platforms that allow everyone to publish content, follow others, and form social networks.
每个人既是读者也是作者，内容沿着人际关系网传播；用户越多，内容和关系越丰富，平台: Everyone is both a reader and an author; content spreads along interpersonal networks. The more users there are, the richer the content and relationships become, making the platform harder to replace ([[p:network|Network effects]]).
用户建立个人主页，关注朋友或感兴趣的人，发布文字、图片和视频，并通过点赞、评论、: Users establish personal homepages, follow friends or people of interest, publish text, images, and videos, and interact through likes, comments, and shares. Early platforms displayed followers' updates in chronological order; today, most are selected by [[recommender-system|recommendation algorithms]] based on your interaction behavior, aiming to keep you engaged longer. Hot content can be shared globally within hours.
2004 年扎克伯格（Mark Zuckerberg）在哈佛创办脸书（Faceb: In 2004, Mark Zuckerberg founded Facebook at Harvard; Twitter launched in 2006; Sina Weibo launched in 2009; Tencent launched WeChat in 2011.
社交媒体改变了新闻传播、商业营销和政治动员，也带来信息茧房、虚假信息和青少年心理: Social media has transformed news dissemination, commercial marketing, and political mobilization, but it has also brought issues such as information cocoons, misinformation, and adolescent mental health (see [[web-2-0]], [[short-video]]).
网络从\"只读\"变为\"可读写\"，博客、维基、视频网站让用户成为内容生产者。: The internet shifted from "read-only" to "read-write," with blogs, wikis, and video websites enabling users to become content producers.
让用户自己生产内容，平台只提供工具，内容规模就会随用户数增长（[[p:netwo: By allowing users to produce their own content, platforms provide only tools; the scale of content grows with the number of users ([[p:network|Network effects]]).
早期网站是\"只读\"的，由站长发布、网民浏览；Web 2.0 网站是\"可读写: Early websites were "read-only," managed by site owners for browsing by netizens. Web 2.0 websites are "read-write": blogs, wikis, video sharing, and social sites allow ordinary people to upload, comment, and collaboratively edit. Technologies like AJAX enable webpage updates without refreshing, making them feel like desktop software.
这个词因奥莱利（Tim O'Reilly）2004 年举办的 Web 2.0 大: This term became popular due to Tim O'Reilly's 2004 Web 2.0 conference; YouTube launched in 2005.
用户生成内容成为互联网的主体（见 [[social-media]]、[[wiki: User-generated content has become the mainstay of the internet (see [[social-media]], [[wikipedia]]).
任何人都能编辑的免费百科全书，证明了大规模志愿协作的力量。: A free encyclopedia open to anyone for editing, demonstrating the power of large-scale voluntary collaboration.
只要编辑足够方便、修改历史可追溯，大量志愿者的小贡献和互相纠错就能汇成可靠的知识: As long as editing is convenient and modification history is traceable, the small contributions of many volunteers and mutual corrections can combine into a reliable knowledge base ([[p:incentives|incentives and cooperation]]).
任何人都能编辑条目，每次修改都留有记录，可一键回退。内容要求中立、可查证，必须引: Anyone can edit entries; each modification is recorded and can be rolled back with one click. Content must remain neutral and verifiable, requiring citations from reliable sources; controversial entries are protected, with discussion pages used for negotiation. The site is operated by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation, sustained by donations without advertising.
2001 年 1 月 15 日由威尔士（Jimmy Wales）和桑格（Larr: Founded on January 15, 2001, by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger.
维基百科成为全球访问量最大的网站之一，其开放内容也被大量用于训练 [[llm|大: Wikipedia has become one of the most visited websites globally; its open content has also been extensively used to train [[llm|Large language model (LLM)]] (see [[web-2-0]], [[open-source]]).
不依赖中心服务器、每台电脑既下载也上传的网络，BitTorrent 是代表。: BitTorrent represents networks that do not rely on central servers, where each computer both downloads and uploads.
不要中心服务器，每台电脑既下载也上传，用户越多总带宽越大，而且没有单点故障（[[: Without a central server, each computer both downloads and uploads; the more users there are, the greater the total bandwidth, and there is no single point of failure ([[p:redundancy|redundancy]]).
BitTorrent 把文件切成许多小块，你从多个用户那里同时下载不同的块，下载: BitTorrent cuts files into many small blocks; you download different blocks simultaneously from multiple users, and the blocks you receive are immediately shared with others. The system encourages sharing by rewarding those who share more.
1999 年美国大学生范宁（Shawn Fanning）推出音乐分享软件 Nap: In 1999, American college student Shawn Fanning launched the music-sharing software Napster. Service was suspended in 2001 due to copyright litigation; Bram Cohen invented BitTorrent in 2001.
P2P 冲击了唱片业，后来被用于软件分发和[[blockchain|区块链]]（: P2P technology impacted the record industry and was later used for software distribution and [[blockchain|Blockchain]] (see [[distributed-system]]).
实时文字聊天，从 ICQ、QQ 到微信，后者发展成集支付、小程序于一体的超级应用: Real-time text chat evolved from ICQ, QQ to WeChat, which developed into a super application integrating payments and mini-programs.
只要双方都在线，消息就能立即送达；好友关系一旦建立，迁移的成本就很高（[[p:n: Messages can be delivered immediately as long as both parties are online; once a friend relationship is established, the cost of migration becomes very high ([[p:network|Network effects]]).
客户端与服务器保持长连接，服务器知道谁在线，收到消息就实时推送给对方；对方离线时: The client maintains a long connection with the server; the server knows who is online and pushes messages to the counterpart in real time upon receiving them. When the counterpart is offline, messages are stored first and delivered after they come back online. Modern applications also support group chats, voice calls, video calls, and end-to-end encryption.
1996 年以色列公司推出 ICQ；1999 年腾讯推出 OICQ（后改名 QQ: ICQ was launched by an Israeli company in 1996; Tencent launched OICQ (later renamed QQ) in 1999; WhatsApp was released in 2009; WeChat was released in 2011.
即时通讯取代了大部分 [[sms|短信]]，微信更发展成集支付、小程序于一体的\: Instant messaging replaced most [[sms|Short Message Service (SMS)]], and WeChat further developed into a "super application" integrating payments and mini-programs (see [[mobile-payment]], [[mobile-internet]]).
把语音切成数据包走互联网，让长途和国际通话几乎免费。: Voice is cut into packets to travel over the internet, making long-distance and international calls almost free.
声音数字化后就是一串数据，可以像其他数据一样切成包走互联网，不必再占用一条专门的: Once sound is digitized, it becomes a stream of data that can be cut into packets like other data to travel over the internet without needing a dedicated telephone line ([[p:sampling|Sampling & digitization]]).
通话双方先把语音采样、压缩，每 20 毫秒左右打成一个包，用 UDP 发送；接收: Both parties in the call first sample and compress the voice, creating one packet approximately every 20 milliseconds, sent via UDP. The receiver uses a buffer to reorder packets and compensate for jitter; if a packet is occasionally lost, an algorithm guesses and fills it in. Since billing is no longer based on distance, international calls are almost free.
1995 年以色列公司 VocalTec 推出最早的商用互联网电话软件；2003: VocalTec, an Israeli company, launched the earliest commercial internet telephone software in 1995; Skype was released in 2003.
VoIP 终结了昂贵的长途电话，今天的手机通话（VoLTE）也走分组网络（见 [: VoIP ended expensive long-distance calls; today's mobile calls (VoLTE) also travel over packet-switched networks (see [[packet-switching]], [[video-conferencing]]).
实时传输多方的音视频，疫情期间成为远程办公和上课的基础设施。: Real-time transmission of multi-party audio and video became the infrastructure for remote work and online classes during the pandemic.
把画面和声音实时压缩成数据流，延迟控制在几百毫秒内，就能\"面对面\"交谈（[[: By compressing video and audio into data streams in real time and controlling latency within a few hundred milliseconds, one can "face-to-face" converse ([[p:sampling|Sampling & digitization]]).
每个参与者的视频先由 [[video-codec|视频编码器]] 压缩，经服务器: Each participant's video is first compressed by [[video-codec|video encoder]], forwarded through the server to others; the server adjusts clarity based on each person's network speed. Echo cancellation and noise reduction algorithms make multi-party conversations clearer.
1964 年 AT&T 在纽约世博会展示可视电话 Picturephone，因昂: AT&T displayed the Picturephone visual telephone at the New York World's Fair in 1964, which failed due to high cost. Software like Zoom, founded in 2011, made video conferencing widespread.
新冠疫情期间视频会议成为远程办公和网课的基础设施，改变了人们对工作地点的观念（见: Video conferencing became the infrastructure for remote work and online classes during the pandemic, changing people's concepts of workplace location (see [[voip]]).
边下边播的音视频服务，按网速动态调整清晰度。: Audio-video services that stream while downloading; clarity is dynamically adjusted based on network speed.
不必先下载完整文件，播放器只要比播放进度领先几秒就能边下边播；再根据网速随时切换: It is not necessary to download a complete file first; the player can start streaming as soon as it is ahead of the playback progress by a few seconds, and switch clarity levels at any time based on network speed to minimize buffering ([[p:feedback|feedback regulation]]).
服务器把一部影片预先编码成多种清晰度，每种都切成几秒长的小片段。播放器先下载一份: The server pre-encodes a film into multiple clarity levels, with each level cut into short segments lasting a few seconds. The player first downloads a "directory," then selects appropriate clarity levels for each segment based on measured network speed: when network speed is fast, switch to high definition; when network speed slows down, automatically downgrade to standard definition. This is called "adaptive bitrate." Popular content is distributed locally by [[cdn|Content delivery network (CDN)]], and [[recommender-system|Recommender system]] determines what you see.
1995 年 RealNetworks 推出 RealAudio，实现网上边下边: RealNetworks launched RealAudio in 1995, achieving online streaming while downloading; YouTube went online in 2005; Netflix launched its online playback service in 2007.
流媒体取代了唱片、录像带和 DVD，视频已占互联网下行流量的大部分（见 [[vi: Streaming media replaced records, videotapes, and DVDs; video now accounts for the majority of internet downstream traffic (see [[video-codec]], [[short-video]]).
以几十秒竖屏视频为主、由推荐算法而非关注关系决定内容的平台，如抖音和 TikTo: Platforms dominated by short vertical videos lasting tens of seconds, where content is determined by recommendation algorithms rather than follower relationships, such as Douyin and TikTok.
内容极短，用户每几十秒就产生一次\"看完/划走\"的反馈，推荐算法能飞快学到每个: Content is extremely short; users generate feedback approximately every few tens of seconds (such as "finished watching" or "swiped past"); recommendation algorithms can rapidly learn individual preferences ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
与传统社交媒体按\"关注谁\"分发不同，短视频平台主要由 [[recommend: Unlike traditional social media that distributes content based on 'who you follow', short video platforms are primarily determined by [[recommender-system|recommendation algorithms]] to decide what you watch next: new videos are first pushed to a small group for testing; if the completion rate, likes, and shares are high, they are pushed to more people. Ordinary people may also become overnight stars.
2016 年 9 月字节跳动推出抖音，2017 年推出国际版 TikTok。: In September 2016, ByteDance launched Douyin, and in 2017, it launched the international version TikTok.
短视频成为最主要的娱乐和带货形式之一，也引发了沉迷和未成年人保护的讨论（见 [[: Short videos have become one of the main forms of entertainment and e-commerce sales, and they have also sparked discussions about addiction and protection for minors (see [[social-media]], [[streaming-media]]).
智能手机加 3G/4G 让上网从书桌搬到口袋，催生了网约车、外卖和移动支付。: The combination of smartphones and 3G/4G networks moved internet access from desks to pockets, giving rise to ride-hailing services, food delivery, and mobile payments.
上网设备从书桌上的电脑变成随身携带的手机，可连接的人数和使用时间都大增（[[p:: Internet access devices have shifted from desktop computers to portable phones; the number of connected users and usage time have both increased significantly ([[p:network|Network effects]]); the adoption of new technologies often follows a pattern of slow initial growth, rapid acceleration, and eventual saturation ([[p:scurve|S-curve]]).
移动互联网由三样东西共同推动：[[smartphone|智能手机]]（触摸屏、定: Mobile internet is driven by three key elements: [[smartphone|Smartphone]] (touch screens, location services, cameras), sufficiently fast mobile networks ([[4g-lte|4G LTE]]), and [[app-store|App store]]. Phones now know where you are and allow instant photo payments, thus creating services that did not exist in the desktop era: ride-hailing, food delivery, shared bicycles, mobile payments, and short videos.
2007 年 iPhone 发布、2008 年应用商店上线常被视为移动互联网时代: The launch of the iPhone in 2007 and the introduction of app stores around 2008 are often considered the beginning of the mobile internet era. Around 2014, the number of Chinese mobile internet users surpassed that of computer internet users.
手机成为大多数人上网的主要方式，许多发展中国家的人第一次上网就是用手机（见 [[: Mobile phones have become the primary way for most people to access the internet; many people in developing countries accessed the internet for the first time using a phone (see [[ride-hailing]], [[mobile-payment]]).
连接买卖双方或多方的数字平台，依靠网络效应快速扩张，也带来垄断争议。: Digital platforms that connect buyers and sellers or multiple parties expand rapidly through network effects but also bring controversies regarding monopoly.
平台连接两类或多类用户，一边越多越吸引另一边，赢家往往通吃（[[p:networ: Platforms connect two or more classes of users; one side attracts the other as it grows larger, and winners often dominate everything ([[p:network|Network effects]]).
平台本身不生产商品，而是撮合交易和互动：电商平台连接买家和卖家，网约车平台连接乘: Platforms themselves do not produce goods; they facilitate transactions and interactions: e-commerce platforms connect buyers and sellers, ride-hailing platforms connect passengers and drivers, app stores connect users and developers. Platforms earn money through commissions, advertising, and data; they also set rules, handle disputes, and wield significant power.
经济学家罗歇（Jean-Charles Rochet）和梯若尔（Jean Tir: Economists Jean-Charles Rochet and Jean Tirole proposed the theory of 'two-sided markets' in the early 2000s; Tirole received the 2014 Nobel Prize in Economics.
平台企业成为全球市值最高的公司之一，也面临垄断和劳动者权益的监管（见 [[e-c: Platform companies have become among the highest-valued companies globally, but they also face regulation regarding monopoly and labor rights (see [[e-commerce]], [[ride-hailing]]).
让各种物品联网，自动感知、上报数据并接受远程控制。: Connect various items to a network so they can automatically sense conditions, report data, and accept remote control.
给物品装上传感器和通信模块，物理世界的状态就能变成数据实时上传，再根据数据自动控: By installing sensors and communication modules on objects, the status of the physical world becomes data that is uploaded in real time; devices can then be automatically controlled based on this data ([[p:feedback|feedback control]]); the more devices connected, the greater the value of data and coordination ([[p:network|network]]).
物联网分三层：**感知层**是各种 [[sensors|传感器]]，测量温度、位: The Internet of Things is divided into three layers: the **Perception Layer** consists of various [[sensors|Sensors]], measuring temperature, location, vibration, battery level, etc.; the **Network Layer** uses Wi-Fi, [[bluetooth|Bluetooth]], cellular networks, or dedicated low-power wide-area networks to transmit data; the **Application Layer** stores and analyzes data in the cloud and sends down instructions. Examples include smart electricity meters, shared bicycle locks, factory equipment monitoring, and soil moisture monitoring in farmland. While the number of devices is huge, security protection is often weak, making them vulnerable to hacker control.
1999 年英国的阿什顿（Kevin Ashton）在宝洁公司做报告时提出\"物: In 1999, Kevin Ashton at Procter & Gamble presented a report that introduced the term 'Internet of Things'.
物联网让城市、工厂和家庭变得可感知、可远程控制（见 [[5g]]、[[smart: The Internet of Things makes cities, factories, and homes perceivable and remotely controllable (see [[5g]], [[smart-home]], [[ddos]]).
联网的灯、门锁、空调和音箱，可远程或用语音控制。: Connected lights, door locks, air conditioners, and speakers can be controlled remotely or via voice commands.
让家里的设备感知环境并按规则自动调节，就是一个家庭版的反馈控制系统（[[p:fe: Allowing home devices to sense the environment and automatically adjust according to rules constitutes a household version of a feedback control system ([[p:feedback|feedback]]).
联网的灯、门锁、空调、摄像头、扫地机器人等通过 Wi-Fi、蓝牙或 Zigbee: Connected lights, door locks, air conditioners, cameras, and robot vacuums connect to gateways and mobile apps via Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or Zigbee; they can be remotely controlled, and linkage rules such as 'automatically turn off lights when leaving home' or 'turn on air conditioning when temperature exceeds 28°C' can be set; smart speakers receive commands using [[speech-recognition|Speech recognition]]. The Matter standard released in 2022 attempts to enable interoperability between devices from different brands.
2014 年亚马逊推出智能音箱 Echo，带动了语音控制的家居设备。: Amazon launched the Echo smart speaker in 2014, driving the growth of voice-controlled home devices.
智能家居让生活更方便，也带来隐私和安全的担忧（见 [[iot]]）。: Smart homes make life more convenient but also raise concerns about privacy and security (see [[iot]]).
主张网络运营商应平等对待所有数据流量，不得按内容或来源区别对待。: Advocates argue that network operators should treat all data traffic equally and not discriminate based on content or source.
如果运营商可以对不同网站收不同的\"过路费\"，就有动机偏袒付钱或自家的服务，新: If an operator can charge different 'tolls' for different websites, it has a motive to favor those that pay or its own services, making it difficult for new companies to compete ([[p:incentives|incentives]]).
网络中立原则主张：运营商应平等对待所有数据，不得按内容、来源或应用屏蔽、限速或收: The principle of net neutrality advocates that operators should treat all data equally and must not block, throttle, or charge preferential treatment based on content, source, or application. Opponents argue that moderate traffic management and differential pricing favor investment in the network.
2003 年美国法学家吴修铭（Tim Wu）提出\"网络中立\"一词。美国的规则: In 2003, American legal scholar Tim Wu coined the term 'net neutrality'. US rules have fluctuated: established in 2015, abolished in 2017, restored in 2024, and overturned by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit in January 2025.
网络中立是互联网治理的核心争论之一（见 [[isp]]、[[internet]]: Net neutrality is one of the core debates in Internet governance (see [[isp]], [[internet]]).
把用户接入互联网的公司，如电信运营商。: Companies that provide user access to the Internet, such as telecommunications operators.
把用户接入互联网需要铺设线路、建设机房，前期投入巨大，用户越多每户成本越低（[[: Providing user access to the Internet requires laying lines and building data centers; early-stage investment is huge, with lower cost per household as more users join ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]).
互联网服务提供商（ISP）把家庭和企业的线路（光纤、铜线、无线）汇聚到自己的网络: An Internet service provider (ISP) aggregates home and enterprise lines (fiber, copper, wireless) into its own network, then connects to the entire Internet through 'peering' with other operators or purchasing 'transit' from upstream operators. It also allocates IP addresses for users and provides DNS services.
1989 年美国的 The World 成为最早向公众提供拨号上网的商业 ISP: In 1989, The World in the United States became one of the earliest commercial ISPs offering dial-up access to the public. China's main ISPs are China Telecom, China Mobile, and China Unicom.
ISP 是互联网的\"最后一公里\"，其覆盖和价格决定了谁能上网（见 [[bro: The ISP is the 'last mile' of the Internet; its coverage and pricing determine who can go online (see [[broadband]], [[net-neutrality]]).
用数学运算对数字化的声音、图像和无线信号进行滤波、压缩和增强。: Filtering, compressing, and enhancing digital sounds, images, and wireless signals using mathematical operations.
信号一旦变成数字，就能用数学运算任意处理：滤波、压缩、增强，结果可以精确重复，不: Once a signal becomes digital, it can be processed arbitrarily using mathematical operations: filtering, compression, enhancement; results can be precisely repeated without drifting like analog circuits due to temperature or aging ([[p:sampling|Sampling & digitization]]).
先由 [[adc|模数转换器]] 把声音、图像或无线电信号采样成一串数字，再用专: First, [[adc|analog-to-digital converter]] samples sounds, images, or wireless signals into a stream of numbers; then dedicated digital signal processors or general-purpose chips perform calculations. The core tool is the 'Fast Fourier Transform' (FFT), which decomposes a signal into different frequency components, like splitting a chord into individual notes: thus, certain frequency noise can be filtered out, or only parts sensitive to human hearing retained to compress data. Noise-canceling headphones, [[mp3|MP3 & audio compression]], mobile phone photography, Wi-Fi, and 4G/5G modulation and demodulation all rely on it.
1965 年库利（James Cooley）和图基（John Tukey）发表: FFT algorithm published by James Cooley and John Tukey in 1965; single-chip digital signal processors launched by Intel, AT&T, Texas Instruments, etc., between 1979–1983.
数字信号处理让通信、音视频和医学成像全面数字化（见 [[modulation]]: Digital signal processing enabled comprehensive digitization of communications, audio/video, and medical imaging (see [[modulation]], [[jpeg]]).
拨号公告板和新闻组是最早的网络社区，后来演变为论坛和贴吧。: Bulletin board systems and newsgroups were the earliest network communities; later evolved into forums and tieba.
一个所有人都能留言、都能看到的公共空间，就能聚起一群有共同兴趣的陌生人（[[p:: A public space where everyone can leave messages and see them all can gather a group of strangers with shared interests ([[p:network|network]]).
早期 BBS（电子公告板）是一台连着电话线的电脑，用户用 [[modem|调制解: Early BBS (electronic bulletin boards) were computers connected to telephone lines; users entered via [[modem|Modem]], leaving messages and downloading files; only a few could be online at once. Later evolved into web-based forums and tieba, organized by topic with posts arranged by reply count.
1978 年美国芝加哥的克里斯滕森（Ward Christensen）和休斯（R: In 1978, Ward Christensen and Randy Suess in Chicago, USA, established the first BBS (CBBS); Tsinghua University's 'Shuimu Qinghua' BBS opened in 1995.
BBS 和论坛是最早的网络社区，孕育了网络文化与网络用语（见 [[social-: BBS and forums were the earliest network communities, nurturing Internet culture and terminology (see [[social-media]], [[email]]).
把音频节目做成可订阅的文件，新节目自动推送到听众设备上，任何人都能当\"电台主播: Converting audio programs into subscribable files; new programs are automatically pushed to listener devices, allowing anyone to become a 'radio host' ([[p:network|network]]).
创作者把节目音频上传到服务器，并发布一个 RSS 订阅源；听众在播客应用里订阅后: Creators upload program audio to servers and publish an RSS feed; listeners subscribe via podcast apps; new programs download or play online automatically, with pause and speed control available at any time.
2004 年英国记者哈默斯利（Ben Hammersley）在文章中首次使用\": In 2004, British journalist Ben Hammersley first used the term 'podcast' in an article, derived from iPod and broadcast; in 2005, Apple added podcast directories to iTunes.
播客让长篇谈话节目重新流行（见 [[streaming-media]]、[[mp: Podcasts brought long-form talk shows back into popularity (see [[streaming-media]], [[mp3]]).
日本手机上诞生的小图标，被纳入 Unicode 后成为全球通用的\"图画文字\": Small icons born on Japanese mobile phones were incorporated into Unicode and became globally universal "pictographs."
图片比文字更快传达情绪；只有把每个图标编码成全球统一的字符，不同手机之间才能显示: Images convey emotions faster than text; only by encoding each icon into a globally unified character can different phones display the same symbol ([[p:standard|Standardization]]).
每个 emoji 在 [[unicode|Unicode]] 中有一个编号，比如: Each emoji has an identifier in [[unicode|Character encoding & Unicode]], such as "cry laughing" being U+1F602; after receiving the number, phones draw the pattern using their own fonts, so the appearance of the same emoji varies slightly across different brands. Skin tones and combined emojis are achieved by combining several numbers.
1999 年日本 NTT DoCoMo 的栗田穰崇设计了一套 176 个 12×: In 1999, Masayuki Takaoka of NTT DoCoMo in Japan designed a set of 176 expression icons at 12×12 pixels; in 2010, emojis were incorporated into Unicode 6.0.
卫星导航 + 实时路况 + 路径算法，让手机成为人人可用的导航仪。: Satellite navigation plus real-time traffic conditions plus path algorithms make mobile phones usable as navigators for everyone.
把道路抽象成由节点和边组成的图，求最短或最快路线就是一道可以用算法高效求解的数学: Roads are abstracted into graphs composed of nodes and edges; finding the shortest or fastest route becomes a mathematical problem that can be efficiently solved using algorithms ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
数字地图由卫星影像、街景车采集和用户反馈构成，再结合 [[gnss|卫星导航]]: Digital maps consist of satellite imagery, street view data collected by cars, and user feedback, combined with [[gnss|Global navigation satellite systems (GPS, BeiDou)]] to locate your position, use [[graph-algorithms|graph algorithms]] to plan routes; anonymous reports from countless phones on speed form real-time traffic conditions, enabling navigation to predict congestion and dynamically reroute.
2005 年 2 月谷歌地图上线；2007 年起谷歌推出街景。: Google Maps launched in February 2005; starting in 2007, Google launched Street View.
手机导航取代了纸质地图，也支撑了网约车和外卖的调度（见 [[ride-haili: Mobile navigation replaced paper maps and also supported ride-hailing and food delivery dispatching (see [[ride-hailing]]).
让机器完成通常需要人类智能的任务；1956 年达特茅斯会议正式提出这个名字。: Enabling machines to complete tasks that typically require human intelligence; the term was formally proposed at the Dartmouth Conference in 1956.
1950 年图灵提出\"机器能思考吗\"（见 [[turing-test]]）。: In 1950, Turing proposed "Can machines think?" (see [[turing-test]]). In the summer of 1956, the Dartmouth symposium initiated by McCarthy (John McCarthy), Minsky (Marvin Minsky), and others formally used the term "artificial intelligence." Subsequently, it faced two periods of cold reception (see [[ai-winter]]); in 2012, deep learning breakthroughs occurred; in 2022, [[chatgpt]] brought AI into daily life. In 2024, the Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to neural network pioneers Hopfield and Hinton (Geoffrey Hinton), and half of the Chemistry Prize was awarded to Hassabis and Jumper for AlphaFold.
到 2026 年，AI 已能对话、写代码、看图、解竞赛数学题、操作电脑，每周有十: By 2026, AI can converse, write code, view images, solve competition math problems, and operate computers; over a billion people use chat assistants weekly; it also brings new challenges regarding employment, copyright, disinformation, and safety (see [[ai-alignment]]).
AI 的三条路线与几次起落：从人写规则，到机器从数据中学，再到深度学习与大模型。: The three routes of AI and several ups and downs: from humans writing rules, to machines learning from data, to deep learning and large models.
如果人通过文字对话分辨不出对方是人还是机器，就可以说机器在\"思考\"。: If a human cannot distinguish whether the other party is human or machine through text dialogue, one can say the machine is "thinking."
与其争论\"思考\"该如何定义，不如换成可操作的检验：只看外在行为。把模糊的哲学: Rather than arguing how "thinking" should be defined, it is better to replace it with an actionable test: only observe external behavior. Transforming vague philosophical problems into measurable experiments ([[p:computability|Computability]]).
图灵称之为\"模仿游戏\"：评判者通过文字同时和一个人、一台机器聊天，若多轮对话: Turing called this the "imitation game": evaluators chat simultaneously with a human and a machine via text; if after multiple rounds of conversation one still cannot tell who is the machine, it is considered that the machine has passed. The test only examines language performance, regardless of internal implementation.
1950 年图灵在哲学期刊《心灵》（Mind）发表论文提出。1980 年哲学家塞: In 1950, Turing proposed this in the philosophical journal Mind. In 1980, philosopher John Searle used the "Chinese Room" to refute: a person manipulating Chinese symbols according to rules does not understand Chinese. In 2025, a preprint study from the University of California San Diego found that GPT-4.5 with persona prompts was judged as "human" by evaluators at a rate of 73%, higher than real humans.
图灵测试长期是 AI 的通俗目标；大模型时代它更像历史坐标，研究者转而用 [[a: The Turing test has long been the popular goal of AI; in the era of large models, it is more like a historical coordinate, and researchers have turned to using [[ai-benchmarks|AI benchmarks]] and real-world work to measure capabilities.
用人写的规则和逻辑符号表示知识并推理，早期 AI 的主流路线。: Representing knowledge and reasoning using rules and logical symbols written by humans was the mainstream route of early AI.
如果知识能写成符号和规则（\"人都会死；苏格拉底是人\"），推理就是机械地套规则: If knowledge can be written as symbols and rules ("All humans die; Socrates is a human"), reasoning becomes mechanically applying rules, and [[p:boolean|Logical Operations]] is precisely the strength of computers; breaking down big problems into sub-problems layer by layer ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]) allows machines to "think" further.
知识工程师把领域知识写成逻辑表达式和规则，推理引擎做演绎或在可能的结论中搜索。代: Knowledge engineers write domain knowledge as logical expressions and rules, while reasoning engines perform deduction or search among possible conclusions. Representative works include the "Logic Theorist" that proves theorems, general problem solvers, and numerous planning systems written using [[lisp]].
1956 年纽厄尔（Allen Newell）、西蒙（Herbert Simon: In 1956, Newell (Allen Newell), Simon (Herbert Simon), and Shoshan demonstrated the "Logic Theorist," proving dozens of theorems in Principles of Mathematics. The two received the Turing Award in 1975 and proposed the "Physical Symbol System Hypothesis": symbol manipulation is a necessary and sufficient condition for intelligence.
符号主义留下了搜索、规划和 [[knowledge-graph|知识表示]]等工: Symbolism left behind tools such as search, planning, and [[knowledge-graph|knowledge representation]]. Its bottleneck is that there are too many common senses and they are too vague to write down completely. The current "neuro-symbolic" method allows large models to call theorem provers or code interpreters, using symbol systems to ensure correctness in every step of reasoning.
把领域专家的经验写成成百上千条\"如果……就……\"规则，曾在医疗诊断和化学分析: Converting the experience of domain experts into hundreds or thousands of "if... then..." rules has been applied in medical diagnosis and chemical analysis.
在狭窄领域里，专家的判断大多能写成\"如果……就……\"规则（[[p:boole: In narrow fields, most expert judgments can be written as "if... then..." rules ([[p:boolean|Boolean logic]]); chaining hundreds of such rules for inference yields suggestions close to those of an expert.
专家系统由\"知识库\"（规则）和\"推理机\"（链式推导）组成，还能解释\"为: Expert systems consist of a "knowledge base" (rules) and an "inference engine" (chain-based derivation), and they can also explain "why this judgment was made".
1960 年代中期，斯坦福的费根鲍姆（Edward Feigenbaum）等人开: In the mid-1960s, Edward Feigenbaum and others at Stanford began developing DENDRAL to infer molecular structures from mass spectrometry data; MYCIN in the 1970s diagnosed blood infections. In the 1980s, DEC's XCON automatically configured computer orders, estimated to save about $25 million annually each year, sparking a wave of corporate investment.
规则难维护、遇到例外就出错，热潮在 1980 年代末退去（见 [[ai-wint: Rules are difficult to maintain and fail when exceptions occur; the boom ended in the late 1980s (see [[ai-winter]]). However, "rule engines" continue to work today in bank risk control and insurance audits.
在所有可能的步骤组成的\"树\"中聪明地找到最优路径，用于导航、游戏和机器人。: Smartly finding the optimal path within a "tree" composed of all possible steps is used for navigation, games, and robotics.
很多问题都能看成在\"状态图\"里找路，每走一步换一个状态。可能的路径数随步数指: Many problems can be viewed as finding a path in a "state graph," where each step changes the state. The number of possible paths explodes exponentially with the number of steps ([[p:complexity|Computational complexity]]); the key to intelligence is avoiding detours.
A* 算法在每个岔路口估算\"已走的代价 + 到终点大约还要多少\"，优先展开最: The A* algorithm estimates at each fork point the "cost already incurred + approximately how much more to reach the goal" and prioritizes expanding the most promising direction; as long as the estimate never overestimates, it guarantees finding the shortest path. Chess programs use game-tree search with pruning, while planning systems decompose goals into a sequence of actions.
1968 年斯坦福研究所的哈特、尼尔森和拉斐尔为移动机器人 Shakey 提出: In 1968, Hart, Nilsson, and Raphael at Stanford Research Institute proposed A* for the mobile robot Shakey; STRIPS, a planner from 1971, was also developed for Shakey.
搜索是导航、游戏 AI 和物流调度的基础，[[deep-blue]] 和 [[a: Search is foundational for navigation, game AI, and logistics scheduling; the core of [[deep-blue]] and [[alphago]] is also search. When large models "think," they essentially explore multiple lines of reasoning (see [[chain-of-thought]]).
过高期望落空后资金和兴趣骤降的时期，历史上出现过两次。: The period after overly high expectations failed, causing a sudden drop in funding and interest has occurred twice in history.
研究经费也受 [[p:incentives|激励]] 驱动：承诺过度、成果跟不上: Research funding is also driven by [[p:incentives|incentives]]: when promises are excessive and results fail to keep pace, funders collectively withdraw, forming a boom-bust cycle.
剧本大同小异：演示惊艳 → 有人预言\"十年内实现\" → 算力、数据、知识获取: The script is largely the same: a stunning demonstration → someone predicts "realization within ten years" → real challenges in computing power, data, and knowledge acquisition are exposed → funding cuts and talent loss.
第一次寒冬约在 1974–1980 年：1973 年英国《莱特希尔报告》批评 A: The first winter was approximately 1974–1980: the 1973 UK "Wright Report" criticized AI for failing to deliver on promises, leading the US and UK to tighten funding; earlier in 1969, Minsky and Perceptron's "Perceptron" pointed out limitations of single-layer networks. The second winter was approximately 1987–1993: the market for Lisp-specific machines collapsed, [[expert-system|Expert system]] maintenance costs were high, and Japan's "Fifth Generation Computer" plan failed to meet its goals.
寒冬让\"AI\"一度不受待见，研究者改称\"机器学习\"。今天的大模型投资热是: The winter made "AI" once unfavored; researchers renamed it "machine learning." Whether today's large model investment heat is overheated remains debated.
从只会模式匹配的 ELIZA 到能真正对话的大模型助手。: From ELIZA, which could only match patterns, to large model assistants that can truly converse.
对话可以看作\"根据上文预测合适的下一句\"。早期靠关键词和模板，今天靠从海量对: Conversation can be viewed as "predicting the appropriate next sentence based on context." Early systems relied on keywords and templates; today they rely on [[p:probability|probability]] models learned from vast amounts of dialogue.
ELIZA 只是在用户的话里找关键词，套模板改写成反问（\"你说你很难过，能多讲: ELIZA merely searched for keywords in user input, applied templates to rewrite them into questions ("You say you're sad; can you tell me more?"), yet led many to believe it understood them. Later customer service robots used retrieval and rules; after 2022, assistants based on [[llm|Large language model (LLM)]] could converse freely and reason.
1966 年麻省理工学院的魏森鲍姆（Joseph Weizenbaum）发表 E: In 1966, Joseph Weizenbaum at MIT published ELIZA; he later felt deeply concerned about people confiding in programs, a phenomenon known as the "ELIZA effect." Microsoft's Xiaoice launched in China in 2014; [[chatgpt]] was released in November 2022.
聊天机器人成为人与 AI 的主要接口，也带来情感依赖和\"讨好用户\"等新问题。: Chatbots have become the primary interface between humans and AI, but they also bring new problems such as emotional dependence and "pleasing users".
不写规则，而是给机器大量例子，让它自己从数据中总结规律。: Instead of writing rules, provide machines with large amounts of examples so that it can summarize patterns from data itself.
1959 年 IBM 的塞缪尔（Arthur Samuel）发表跳棋程序论文，使: In 1959, Arthur Samuel at IBM published a paper on the chess program, using the term "machine learning": the program improved through self-play. In the 1990s, statistical learning rose; [[svm|Support vector machine (SVM)]] and random forests became mainstream; in the 2010s, deep learning took over.
机器学习进入了垃圾邮件过滤、信用评分、推荐、翻译、医学影像等几乎所有数据丰富的领: Machine learning has entered almost all data-rich fields such as spam filtering, credit scoring, recommendations, translation, and medical imaging. Software development gained a new paradigm: not "writing programs," but "preparing data and training models".
传统编程是\"规则 + 数据 → 答案\"；机器学习反过来，用\"数据 + 答案: Traditional programming is "rules + data → answer"; machine learning works in reverse, using "data + answer" to train rules.
用带\"标准答案\"的例子训练模型，学会从输入预测输出，如看图识猫。: Train models using examples with "ground truth" answers, teaching them to predict outputs from inputs, such as identifying cats in images.
给模型看成千上万道\"带答案的例题\"，每做错一道就沿着减小错误的方向调参数（[: Show the model thousands or tens of thousands of "labeled example problems"; every time it makes a mistake, adjust parameters along the direction that reduces the error ([[p:optimization|optimization]]), and it gradually learns to map inputs to outputs.
训练数据是一对对（输入，标签）：图片—\"猫\"，邮件—\"垃圾\"，面积和地段: Training data consists of pairs (input, label): image—"cat", email—"spam", area and location—housing price. The model first guesses blindly, [[loss-function|Loss function]] calculates the gap, then adjusts parameters, repeating millions of times. Predicting a category is called classification; predicting a value is called regression (see [[regression-classification]]).
思想可追溯到最小二乘法（勒让德 1805 年发表）和 1958 年的 [[per: The ideas trace back to the method of least squares (published by Legendre in 1805) and the 1958 [[perceptron|Perceptron]]. Starting in 2009, large-scale labeled datasets such as [[imagenet]] have driven its breakthroughs in the visual domain.
人脸解锁、医学读片、语音转写等多数实用 AI 的核心都是监督学习。最大的成本是标: The core of most practical AI applications—face unlocking, medical imaging reading, speech transcription—is supervised learning. The biggest cost is labeling (see [[data-labeling]]), which has driven the development of [[self-supervised-learning|Self-supervised learning]] that do not require human labels.
没有标签，让模型自己在数据中找结构，如把用户自动分群。: Without labels, let the model find structure within the data itself, such as automatically clustering users.
数据自带结构：相似的东西会扎堆，复杂数据往往由少数隐藏因素决定。不给答案，模型也: Data carries its own structure: similar things tend to cluster together, and complex data is often determined by a few hidden factors. Without answers, the model can still use [[p:probability|statistics]] methods to uncover patterns.
最常见的是**聚类**，如 k 均值：把每个点分给最近的\"中心\"，再把中心挪: The most common are **clustering**, such as k-means: assign each point to the nearest "center," then move the centers to the average position within groups, repeating until stability; and **dimensionality reduction**, such as principal component analysis (PCA), compressing hundreds of features into two or three main directions. Finding transactions that "do not look like most" is also unsupervised.
PCA 由皮尔逊（Karl Pearson）1901 年提出；k 均值由贝尔实验: PCA was proposed by Karl Pearson in 1901; k-means was proposed by Lloyd at Bell Labs in 1957 and formally published in 1982.
用于用户分群、基因分析和反欺诈。它和 [[self-supervised-lea: Used for user segmentation, gene analysis, and fraud detection. Its boundary with [[self-supervised-learning|Self-supervised learning]] is not absolute: the latter also uses unlabeled data but will "create problems" for itself.
从数据本身造题目（如遮住一个词让模型猜），无需人工标注就能学习海量数据。: Create problems from the data itself (such as covering a word to let the model guess); without human labeling, it can learn from massive amounts of data.
无标签数据里藏着答案：遮住一个词，原句就是答案；挖掉一块图，原图就是答案。让模型: Answers are hidden in unlabeled data: cover a word, and the original sentence is the answer; remove a patch of an image, and the original image is the answer. Letting the model perform "fill-in-the-blank" allows learning from massive raw data via [[p:probability|probability]] prediction.
语言模型\"预测下一个词\"（GPT）或\"预测被遮住的词\"（BERT）；视觉: Language models "predict the next word" (GPT) or "predict the covered word" (BERT); visual models cover image patches and restore them, or let two crops of the same image become close in feature space (contrastive learning). The learned general representations are then [[pretraining-finetuning|fine-tuning]] to specific tasks.
2018 年谷歌的 BERT 和 OpenAI 的 GPT 让自监督预训练成为语: BERT from Google and GPT from OpenAI in 2018 made self-supervised pretraining the standard practice for language processing. Yann LeCun, a Turing Award winner, has long advocated it, comparing it to the main body of an intelligent "cake".
它解决了\"标签不够用\"的问题，让模型能吃下整个互联网的文字、图片和视频——这: It solves the problem of "insufficient labels," allowing models to consume the entire internet's text, images, and videos—this is the prerequisite for the emergence of [[llm|Large model]].
让智能体在环境中试错，做对了给奖励，逐渐学会最大化长期回报的策略。: Let agents try and fail in environments; give rewards for correct actions, gradually learning strategies that maximize long-term returns.
智能体在环境里行动，得到奖励或惩罚，再调整策略，让长期累计奖励最大。这是\"试错: Agents act in an environment, receive rewards or penalties, then adjust strategies to maximize cumulative long-term rewards. This is "trial-and-error + [[p:feedback|feedback]]" driven [[p:optimization|optimization]], similar to training a puppy.
每一步：观察状态 → 选动作 → 得到奖励和新状态。难点是奖励常常来得很晚（下完: Each step: observe state → select action → receive reward and new state. The difficulty is that rewards often come late (knowing the winner only after finishing a game of chess), so one must learn to estimate "how much this step contributes to future value" (value function), and make trade-offs between "using known good moves" and "exploring new moves." Deep reinforcement learning uses neural networks to represent policies and values.
萨顿（Richard Sutton）与巴托（Andrew Barto）1980: Sutton (Richard Sutton) and Barto (Andrew Barto) laid the foundations for temporal difference learning in the 1980s, receiving the Turing Award in 2024. In 2013, DeepMind's DQN learned to play Atari games directly from pixels; in 2016, [[alphago]] defeated Lee Sedol; starting in 2024, reinforcement learning has been used to train large models to "think several steps ahead" (see [[chain-of-thought]]).
它从游戏走向机器人控制、芯片布局和大模型对齐（见 [[rlhf]]）。风险是\": It has moved from games to robot control, chip layout, and large model alignment (see [[rlhf]]). The risk is "exploiting loopholes": if reward design has flaws, the agent will find unexpected cheating methods.
强化学习的循环：行动 → 环境给出新状态和奖励 → 调整策略，再行动。: The reinforcement learning loop: action → environment gives new state and reward → adjust strategy, then act again.
机器学习的两类基本任务：预测一个数值（房价）或判断属于哪一类（垃圾邮件）。: Two basic tasks of machine learning: predict a value (housing price) or judge which category it belongs to (spam email).
几乎所有预测问题都可归为两种：猜一个数（回归）或选一个类别（分类）。两者都是找一: Almost all prediction problems can be reduced to two types: guess a number (regression) or select a category (classification). Both seek a "most suitable" line or boundary that minimizes error ([[p:optimization|optimization]], [[p:probability|probability]]).
线性回归找一条直线，让所有点到直线的竖直距离平方和最小（最小二乘法）。逻辑回归把: Linear regression finds a straight line that minimizes the sum of squared vertical distances from all points to the line (method of least squares). Logistic regression compresses weighted sums into the range 0 to 1, treating them as "probabilities of belonging to a class," and classifies as that class if it exceeds 0.5.
最小二乘法由勒让德（1805 年）和高斯发表。\"回归\"一词来自高尔顿（Fra: The method of least squares was published by Legendre (1805) and Gauss. The term "regression" comes from Galton's (Francis Galton) research in the 1880s on the hereditary inheritance of height: children of exceptionally tall parents tend to "regress" toward the average.
这两类任务覆盖了房价预测、疾病诊断、垃圾邮件识别等大量应用。大模型预测下一个 t: These two categories of tasks cover a wide range of applications, including housing price prediction, disease diagnosis, and spam email identification. Predicting the next token with large models is essentially also a classification problem involving over 100,000 classes.
用一连串是非问题做判断；把许多棵树的投票合起来就是随机森林。: Using a series of yes-or-no questions for judgment; combining the votes from many trees results in a random forest.
一连串\"是或否\"的问题就能把情况分门别类；每次挑最能把数据分\"纯\"的问题: A series of "yes or no" questions can categorize situations; each time selecting the question that best splits the data into "pure" groups (information gain on [[p:probability|probability]]). Many biased trees voting together cause errors to cancel out.
决策树像流程图：\"年收入超过 10 万？→ 有没有逾期记录？→ ……\"，人能: Decision trees look like flowcharts: "Is annual income over 100,000? → Is there a delinquency record? → ……", which humans can read directly. A single tree is prone to [[overfitting|Overfitting & generalization]]; random forests let each tree look at only partial data and features, then have hundreds of trees vote; gradient boosting trees (such as XGBoost) let each new tree specifically correct the errors of the previous ones.
1984 年布雷曼（Leo Breiman）等人提出 CART；1986 年昆兰: In 1984, Breiman (Leo Breiman) et al. proposed CART; in 1986, Quinlan published ID3; in 2001, Breiman proposed random forests; in 2014, Chen Tianqi released XGBoost.
在银行、保险、电商的表格数据上，树模型至今常常比深度学习更准、更快、更好解释。: On tabular data in banks, insurance, and e-commerce, tree models continue to often be more accurate, faster, and better explained than deep learning.
寻找能把两类数据分得最开的那条边界，深度学习兴起前的明星算法。: Finding the boundary that separates two classes of data most clearly was a star algorithm before the rise of deep learning.
两类数据之间可以画很多条分界线，最稳妥的是离两边最近的点都尽量远的那条：间隔越大: Many separating boundaries can be drawn between two classes of data; the most reliable is the one where the points closest to both sides are as far apart as possible: the larger the margin, the less likely new data will be misclassified ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
SVM 只看贴近边界的少数关键样本（\"支持向量\"），其余点不影响结果。边界弯: SVM only looks at the minority key samples close to the boundary ("support vectors"); other points do not affect the result. When the boundary is curved, a "kernel trick" implicitly maps the data into a high-dimensional space, where it is sliced with one straight cut; returning to the original space results in a curved boundary.
1992 年博泽尔、居永与瓦普尼克（Vladimir Vapnik）引入核方法；: In 1992, Boser, Guyon, and Vapnik (Vladimir Vapnik) introduced kernel methods; in 1995, Cortes and Vapnik proposed an "soft margin" version allowing for a small number of errors.
1990 年代末到 2012 年前后，SVM 是文本分类、手写识别和生物信息学的: From the late 1990s to around 2012, SVM was the main force in text classification, handwriting recognition, and bioinformatics. After data and computing power surged, it gave way to deep learning, but the idea of "maximum margin" has had a profound influence.
用新证据不断更新对事物概率的判断，垃圾邮件过滤就是经典应用。: Using new evidence to continuously update judgments about probabilities; spam email filtering is a classic application.
贝叶斯定理讲的是如何用新证据更新判断：新判断 ∝ 原判断 × 证据在该判断下出现: Bayes' theorem explains how to use new evidence to update judgments: New Judgment ∝ Original Judgment × Probability of Evidence Appearing Given That Judgment. The more evidence, the closer the judgment gets to the truth ([[p:probability|probabilistic inference]]).
以垃圾邮件过滤为例：先验是\"平时有多少比例是垃圾邮件\"；每个词都是证据，\": Taking spam email filtering as an example: the prior is "what proportion of emails are normally spam"; each word is evidence, "subject" pushes probability up, "meeting minutes" pushes it down. Naive Bayes assumes words are independent and calculates extremely fast; Bayesian networks can represent dependencies between many variables.
贝叶斯（Thomas Bayes）的论文在他去世后于 1763 年发表，拉普拉斯: Bayes' (Thomas Bayes) paper was published after his death in 1763; Laplace independently promoted this method. In 2002, Graham's (Paul Graham) article made Bayesian spam email filtering widely popular.
用于反垃圾邮件、医学检测解读、搜救定位和 A/B 测试。它提醒我们：罕见病检测呈: Used for anti-spam, medical diagnosis interpretation, search and rescue positioning, and A/B testing. It reminds us: if a rare disease test is positive, the actual probability of having the disease may not be high.
模型把训练数据\"背\"得太熟反而不会举一反三；目标是在没见过的数据上表现好。: Models that "memorize" training data too well will fail to generalize; the goal is to perform well on unseen data.
训练数据只是真实世界的一个样本，里面既有规律也有偶然噪声。模型太灵活，就会连噪声: Training data is merely a sample of the real world, containing both patterns and accidental noise. If a model is too flexible, it will remember the noise along with the patterns, causing errors on new data; a good model must strike a balance between "fitting the sample" and "maintaining simplicity" ([[p:probability|statistical inference]]).
典型症状是训练误差一路下降，验证误差却先降后升。对策有：更多数据、更简单的模型、: Typical symptoms are that training error drops continuously while validation error first decreases then increases. Countermeasures include: more data, simpler models, regularization (penalizing large parameters), randomly turning off neurons during training (dropout), early stopping, and using independent data for testing (see [[train-test-split]]). Conversely, if a model is too simple and fails to even grasp patterns, it is called "underfitting".
统计学早就知道\"参数越多越容易拟合噪声\"，奥卡姆剃刀是它的哲学版本。2019: Statistics has long known that "the more parameters, the easier it is to fit noise"; Occam's Razor is its philosophical version. Around 2019, researchers discovered "double descent": after a model reaches a certain size, test error will drop again, partially explaining why large models with more parameters than data can still generalize.
泛化是机器学习的核心目标；测试题混进训练数据造成的\"刷分\"，是同一问题的变体: Generalization is the core goal of machine learning; points where test questions are mixed into training data cause "score inflation" from the same problem variant (see [[ai-benchmarks]]).
训练集上 100% 正确往往不是好消息，说明模型可能在\"背答案\"。: Being 100% correct on the training set is often not good news, indicating the model may be "memorizing answers".
同一组数据点：直线太简单（欠拟合），平滑曲线刚好，穿过每个点的曲线把噪声也背下来: For the same set of data points: a straight line is too simple (underfitting), a smooth curve fits just right, and a curve passing through every point memorizes the noise as well (overfitting).
把数据分成三份：一份学习、一份调参、一份最后考试，防止自欺欺人。: Divide the data into three parts: one for learning, one for tuning hyperparameters, and one for the final exam, to prevent self-deception.
用考过的题再考一次，分数一定虚高。只有用模型从没见过的数据检验，才能诚实估计它在: Testing on problems you have already seen will inevitably yield an inflated score. Only by evaluating the model on unseen data can you honestly estimate its performance in the real world ([[p:probability|statistical inference]]).
常见做法是把数据分成训练集（学参数）、验证集（选模型、调学习率和层数等\"超参数: Common practice involves splitting data into a training set (for learning parameters), a validation set (for selecting models and tuning hyperparameters such as learning rate and layer count), and a test set (used only once for the final exam). When data is scarce, use k-fold cross-validation: rotate each part to serve as the validation set and take the average. For time series, split strictly by time; do not use 'future' data to predict 'past' events.
交叉验证在 1970 年代由斯通（Mervyn Stone）等统计学家系统化。: Cross-validation was systematized in the 1970s by statisticians such as Mervyn Stone.
这条纪律是机器学习可信的基础。大模型时代的隐患是测试题被爬进训练数据，导致分数虚: This discipline is the foundation of trustworthy machine learning. A major risk in the era of large models is that test questions are leaked into training data, causing inflated scores; this has led to evaluation methods involving non-disclosure of questions and regular rotation of test sets.
衡量模型预测离正确答案有多远的分数，训练就是让它尽量小。: Measuring how far a model's prediction deviates from the correct answer, training aims to make this value as small as possible.
机器不懂\"好坏\"，只懂数字。把\"预测离答案多远\"写成一个数，训练就变成把: Machines do not understand 'good' or 'bad'; they only understand numbers. Expressing 'how far a prediction deviates from the answer' as a single number transforms training into the [[p:optimization|optimization]] problem of minimizing this number.
预测数值常用均方误差（误差平方的平均，大错罚得更重）；分类常用交叉熵：模型给正确: For predicting numerical values, mean squared error is commonly used (the average of squared errors, where large errors are penalized more heavily); for classification, cross-entropy is used: the lower the probability assigned to the correct answer, the heavier the penalty—assigning 0.9 incurs almost no penalty, while assigning 0.01 incurs a heavy one. The loss function for large model pre-training is the negative log average of the probability it assigns to the true next word.
平方误差来自勒让德和高斯的最小二乘法；交叉熵源于香农 1948 年创立的信息论。: Squared error originates from Legendre and Gauss's method of least squares; cross-entropy stems from Shannon's information theory, founded in 1948.
选什么损失函数，就是告诉模型\"该在乎什么\"。损失和真实目标不一致，模型就会认: Choosing a loss function is telling the model 'what matters'. If the loss does not align with the true target, the model will seriously optimize the wrong thing—which is a microcosm of [[ai-alignment|the alignment problem]].
像蒙眼下山一样，每一步都沿着最陡的下坡方向调整参数，让损失越来越小。: Like walking down a mountain blindfolded, adjust parameters at each step along the steepest descent direction to make the loss smaller.
要让损失变小，就要知道每个参数往哪边动、损失降得最快——这个方向就是梯度的反方向: To reduce the loss, one must know in which direction each parameter should move and where the loss decreases fastest—this direction is opposite to the gradient. Walking step-by-step along it is like descending a mountain blindfolded by relying on foot sensation ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
每一步算出损失对每个参数的偏导数（梯度），再把参数减去\"学习率 × 梯度\"。: At each step, compute the partial derivative of the loss with respect to each parameter (the gradient), then subtract 'learning rate × gradient' from the parameters. If the learning rate is too high, the process will oscillate back and forth on both sides of the valley; if too low, progress will be extremely slow. Actual training uses Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD): estimating gradients using only a small batch of data at each step, which is fast and helps escape local minima; algorithms like Adam automatically adjust step sizes for each parameter.
1847 年法国数学家柯西（Augustin-Louis Cauchy）提出梯度: In 1847, French mathematician Augustin-Louis Cauchy proposed gradient descent; in 1951, Robbins and Monro proposed stochastic approximation, which is the theoretical source of SGD; in 2014, Diederik Kingma and Jimmy Ba proposed Adam.
从线性回归到万亿参数的大模型，几乎都靠梯度下降训练；[[backpropagat: From linear regression to trillion-parameter large models, almost all rely on gradient descent for training; [[backpropagation|Backpropagation]] enables massive gradients to be computed efficiently.
高维空间里真正的麻烦常常不是\"局部最低点\"，而是大片平坦的鞍点区；随机性和动: In high-dimensional spaces, the real trouble is often not 'local minima' but vast regions of flat saddle points; randomness and momentum help traverse them.
等高线代表损失高低，每一步都沿最陡的下坡方向走；学习率决定步子大小。: Contour lines represent loss levels; at each step, move in the steepest descent direction. The learning rate determines the size of the step.
模仿神经元的最简单学习单元：加权求和后过一个阈值，能学会线性分类。: The simplest learning unit mimicking a neuron: pass a weighted sum through a threshold to learn linear classification.
把一个神经元简化成\"输入加权求和，超过阈值就输出 1\"。每次判错就把权重往正: Simplify a neuron into 'input weighted sum, output 1 if exceeding threshold'. Each time it makes an error, push the weights slightly in the correct direction; it can then learn to separate two classes of data with a single straight line ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
学习规则极简：该输出 1 却输出 0，就把这个样本的特征加到权重上；反之就减去。: The learning rule is simple: if it should output 1 but outputs 0, add this sample's feature to the weight; otherwise subtract. As long as the two classes of data can be separated by a straight line (a plane in high dimensions), this process guarantees convergence within finite steps.
1958 年康奈尔航空实验室的罗森布拉特（Frank Rosenblatt）提出: In 1958, Frank Rosenblatt from Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory proposed the Perceptron and built Mark I hardware using 400 phototubes to 'see' images; The New York Times reported that the Navy expected it in the future to 'walk, speak, see, and write'. In 1969, Minsky and Papert proved in their book 'Perceptrons' that a single-layer perceptron cannot even learn 'XOR', causing neural network research to go cold (see [[ai-winter]]).
感知机是神经网络的\"细胞\"。把它叠成多层、把阶跃换成可导的激活函数，再用 [: The Perceptron is the 'cell' of neural networks. By stacking it into multiple layers, replacing the step function with a differentiable activation function, and training using [[backpropagation|Backpropagation]], the XOR problem was solved, opening the modern era of [[neural-network|neural networks]].
由大量\"人工神经元\"层层相连组成，通过调整连接权重学习复杂的输入—输出关系。: Composed of numerous 'artificial neurons' connected in layers, learning complex input-output relationships through adjustments to connection weights.
1943 年麦卡洛克（Warren McCulloch）与皮茨（Walter P: In 1943, Warren McCulloch and Walter Pitts proposed the first mathematical model of a neuron; in 1958, [[perceptron|Perceptron]]; in 1982, John Hopfield proposed a network capable of 'associative memory'; in 1986, [[backpropagation|Backpropagation]] became widespread; in 1989, George Cybenko proved the universal approximation theorem. Hopfield and Hinton received the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics.
神经网络从长期被冷落的想法，变成了语音识别、图像识别、机器翻译和大模型共同的底座: Neural networks have transformed from an idea long overlooked into the common foundation for speech recognition, image recognition, machine translation, and large models (see [[deep-learning]]).
一个神经元做\"加权求和 + 激活\"；许多神经元排成层，层层传递就组成网络。: A single neuron performs 'weighted sum + activation'; many neurons arranged in layers pass information sequentially to form a network.
从输出误差出发，用链式法则一层层往回算出每个权重该改多少，是训练神经网络的核心算: Starting from output error, using the chain rule to calculate backward layer by layer how much each weight should change is the core algorithm for training neural networks.
芬兰学者林纳因马（Seppo Linnainmaa）1970 年提出反向模式自动: Finnish scholar Seppo Linnainmaa proposed the reverse-mode automatic differentiation pattern in 1970; Paul Werbos's 1974 doctoral thesis proposed it for use in neural networks. In 1986, David Rumelhart, Geoffrey Hinton, and Richard Williams published a paper in 'Nature' demonstrating that it allows multi-layer networks to learn useful internal representations, making it widely known thereafter.
没有反向传播就训练不了多层网络，也就没有深度学习。层数很深时梯度会在连乘中消失或: Without backpropagation, multi-layer networks cannot be trained, and thus deep learning does not exist. When layers are very deep, gradients vanish or explode during multiplication; later this was solved by ReLU, [[resnet|residual connections]], and normalization.
前向一趟算出误差，反向一趟按链式法则把\"责任\"分摊到每个权重。: A forward pass calculates error; a backward pass distributes 'responsibility' to each weight according to the chain rule.
用很多层的神经网络从原始数据中自动学习特征；2012 年 AlexNet 在 I: Using multi-layer neural networks to automatically learn features from raw data; in 2012, AlexNet's victory on ImageNet ignited the wave.
2006 年辛顿等人用逐层预训练让深层网络可以训练，\"深度学习\"一词流行起来: In 2006, Hinton and colleagues used staged pre-training to make deep networks trainable, making the term 'deep learning' popular. In 2012, his student Alex Krizhevsky and Ilya Sutskever trained AlexNet using two GPUs, reducing the top-five error rate on ImageNet competition from about 26% to about 15%, shocking the academic community. Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, and Geoffrey Hinton received the Turing Award in 2018 for deep learning.
此后十年，语音识别、图像识别、机器翻译、围棋相继被攻克，最终走向 [[trans: In the following decade, speech recognition, image recognition, machine translation, and Go were successively conquered, ultimately leading to [[transformer-model|Transformer (neural network)]] and [[llm|Large language model (LLM)]]. AI also became a compute-intensive industry, increasing demand for [[ai-accelerator|AI chips]] and [[data-center|Data center]].
深层网络逐层提取特征，从像素到边缘、部件，再到整个物体；背后是数据、算力和算法三: Deep networks extract features layer by layer, from pixels to edges and components, then to entire objects; behind this are data, computing power, and algorithms all arriving simultaneously.
用小\"滑动窗口\"在图像上扫描提取边缘、纹理到物体的层级特征。: Using a small 'sliding window' to scan images for hierarchical features ranging from edges and textures to objects.
图像里的规律是**局部**的（边缘只涉及相邻像素），而且**哪里都一样**（猫在: Patterns in images are **local** (edges only involve adjacent pixels) and **invariant to location** (a cat is still a cat whether it's in the top-left or bottom-right corner). Therefore, it is not necessary for each neuron to connect to all pixels; instead, a small 'filter' slides across the entire image, reusing the same set of weights everywhere, reducing parameters by several orders of magnitude ([[p:locality|locality]]).
卷积层用许多 3×3 或 5×5 的小卷积核扫描图片，每个核负责检测一种图案（竖: Convolutional layers use many small 3×3 or 5×5 convolution kernels to scan images, with each kernel responsible for detecting a specific pattern (vertical lines, diagonal lines, certain colors). Pooling layers shrink the image while retaining the strongest signal, making recognition robust against small displacements. The more layers there are, the larger the range each neuron 'sees', combining from strokes gradually to objects ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
1980 年福岛邦彦提出受视觉皮层启发的\"新认知机\"。1989 年杨立昆在贝: In 1980, Hiroshi Shikano proposed a 'New Cognitive Machine' inspired by the visual cortex. In 1989, Geoffrey Hinton used backpropagation at Bell Labs to train convolutional networks for recognizing handwritten postal codes; later LeNet-5 was used for US bank check recognition. In 2012, AlexNet made CNNs the mainstream for vision.
CNN 支撑了人脸识别、医学影像和自动驾驶感知的十年。视觉 Transforme: CNNs supported facial recognition, medical imaging, and autonomous driving perception for a decade. After the rise of Vision Transformers, convolutional layers are still widely used in devices requiring high efficiency such as mobile phones.
一个 3×3 卷积核在图上滑动，每到一处做一次加权求和，得到一张\"特征图\"。: A 3×3 convolution kernel slides over an image; at each location, it performs a weighted sum to produce a 'feature map'.
带\"记忆\"的网络，按顺序处理文字和语音；LSTM 解决了长距离记忆难题。: A network with 'memory', processing text and speech sequentially; LSTM solved the long-distance memory problem.
语言和语音有先后顺序。循环网络读每个词时，把\"到目前为止的记忆\"也作为输入，: Language and speech have temporal order. When a recurrent network reads each word, it also uses 'memory so far' as input; after reading, it updates memory—using [[p:feedback|feedback]] loops to give the network temporal context.
普通 RNN 的记忆在长序列中迅速衰减（梯度消失），读到句尾就忘了句首。LSTM: Ordinary RNN memory decays rapidly in long sequences (gradient vanishing), forgetting the beginning by the time it reaches the end. LSTM uses three 'gates' to decide what to remember, what to forget, and what to output, allowing important information to be retained over long distances along a 'conveyor belt'.
1997 年霍赫赖特（Sepp Hochreiter）与施米德胡贝（Jürgen: In 1997, Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber proposed LSTM. In 2016, Google Translate switched to using LSTM.
2010 年代中期，LSTM 主导了语音识别、翻译和输入法预测。它必须逐词计算、: In the mid-2010s, LSTM dominated speech recognition, translation, and input method prediction. It must compute word by word and is difficult to parallelize; after 2017 it was largely replaced by [[transformer-model|Transformer (neural network)]]; recent state space models (such as Mamba) bring back the recurrent idea to reduce computational cost for long text.
给每层加一条\"抄近道\"的连接，让上百层的网络也能训练起来。: Adding a 'shortcut' connection to each layer allows networks with hundreds of layers to be trained.
让每几层只学\"在输入基础上要改多少\"（残差），而不是从头学整个变换。有一条直: Letting every few layers only learn 'how much to change based on input' (residual), rather than learning the entire transformation from scratch. With a direct 'shortcut', signals and gradients can pass smoothly through hundreds of layers ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
残差块的输出 = 输入 + 这几层算出的修正量。如果某几层没用，网络只要把修正量: Output of a residual block = Input + Correction calculated by these few layers. If certain layers are unused, the network only needs to learn the correction amount to be 0, effectively skipping them; thus deepening networks will at least not make things worse.
2015 年微软亚洲研究院的何恺明、张祥雨、任少卿、孙剑提出 ResNet，用: In 2015, Kai Ming Huang, Zhuang Liu, Sun Yu, and Jian Sun from Microsoft Research Asia proposed ResNet. A network with 152 layers won the ImageNet competition, achieving a top-5 error rate of approximately 3.6%, which was lower than the level of human annotators at about 5%. Statistics published in Nature magazine in 2025 show that this paper is the most-cited scientific paper of the 21st century.
残差连接几乎出现在之后所有的深度网络里，包括每一层 [[transformer-: Residual connections appear almost in all subsequent deep networks, including every layer [[transformer-model|Transformer (neural network)]].
李飞飞团队标注的千万级图像数据集；2012 年 AlexNet 用 GPU 训练: The ImageNet dataset annotated by Fei-Fei Li's team, consisting of tens of millions of images; AlexNet won a major competition in 2012 using deep networks trained on GPUs.
模型的上限常常由数据决定。李飞飞的赌注是：与其不断改算法，不如先造一个比以往大几: The upper limit of models is often determined by data. Fei-Fei Li's bet was: rather than constantly improving algorithms, create an annotated dataset several orders of magnitude larger than before—once the data scale crosses a threshold, the advantages of new methods will emerge ([[p:scale|Economies of scale]]).
ImageNet 按 WordNet 词库的名词层级组织，收录 1400 多万张: ImageNet is organized according to the noun hierarchy of WordNet, collecting over 14 million images and approximately 20,000 categories, annotated by numerous workers on the crowdsourcing platform Amazon Mechanical Turk. From 2010 to 2017, large-scale visual recognition challenges (ILSVRC) were held annually, using 1,000 categories and approximately 1.2 million training images.
李飞飞（Fei-Fei Li）2006 年前后在普林斯顿大学发起，2009 年发: Fei-Fei Li initiated the project at Princeton University around 2006, publishing it in 2009. In 2012, AlexNet from the University of Toronto won with an 8-layer network trained on two NVIDIA gaming graphics cards, achieving a top-5 error rate of approximately 15.3%, which was about 11 percentage points lower than the second place.
ImageNet 证明了\"大数据 + GPU + 深度网络\"的威力，被称为深: ImageNet demonstrated the power of 'Big Data + GPU + Deep Networks', known as the 'big bang' moment of deep learning, and 'pretraining then transfer' also became popular from here (see [[pretraining-finetuning]]). It also exposed biases and privacy issues in datasets; in 2019, certain person categories were removed.
把每个词变成一串数字，意思相近的词在空间中靠得近，\"国王−男人+女人≈女王\": Transform each word into a string of numbers; words with similar meanings are close to each other in space: 'King − Man + Woman ≈ Queen'.
一个词的意思可以从它的\"邻居\"看出来：常出现在相似上下文里的词，意思也相近。: The meaning of a word can be inferred from its 'neighbors': words that frequently appear in similar contexts also have similar meanings. Thus, assign a string of numbers (a vector) to each word, allowing words with similar contexts to be close to each other in space ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
word2vec 训练一个简单任务：用一个词预测它周围的词，或反过来。训练完每个: word2vec trains a simple task: predict the surrounding words for one word, or vice versa. After training, each word corresponds to a vector of several hundred dimensions; surprisingly, the direction of the vector carries meaning: 'King − Man + Woman' is closest to 'Queen', and 'Paris − France + Italy' is close to 'Rome'.
语言学家弗斯 1957 年写道：\"观其伴，知其义\"。2013 年谷歌的米科洛: Linguist Noam Chomsky wrote in 1957: 'Know its associates, know its meaning.' In 2013, Tomas Mikolov and others from Google published word2vec;
词向量让计算机第一次能\"计算\"词义，是 [[transformer-mode: Word vectors allowed computers to 'calculate' word meanings for the first time, serving as the precursor to the embedding layer input in [[transformer-model|Transformer (neural network)]]. Today, sentences, images, and products can also be embedded into vectors, supporting semantic search and [[rag|Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)]].
词向量会从语料中学到社会偏见，比如把某些职业和性别绑在一起（见 [[ai-bia: Word vectors learn social biases from corpora, such as linking certain professions with specific genders (see [[ai-bias]]).
