让模型在处理每个词时，动态决定该重点\"看\"输入的哪些部分。: Allow the model to dynamically decide which parts of the input to focus on when processing each word.
理解一个词时，句子里的其他词并不同样重要。让模型为每个词算一组\"关注度\"权重: When understanding a word, other words in the sentence are not equally important. Allow the model to calculate a set of 'attention' weights for each word, summing information from other words according to these weights—using learnable weighted summation instead of fixed memory ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
在\"小猫没有过马路，因为它太累了\"中，处理\"它\"时，注意力会给\"小猫\: In the sentence 'The cat did not cross the road because it was too tired', when processing 'it', attention gives a high weight to 'cat' and a lower weight to 'road'. Technically, each word generates three vectors: Query (what I am looking for), Key (what I can provide), Value (my content). The dot product of Query with all Keys yields relevance scores, converted via softmax into weights summing to 1, then used for weighted summation of Values.
2014 年本吉奥团队的巴赫达瑙（Dzmitry Bahdanau）等人把注意力: In 2014, Dzmitry Bahdanau and others from the Bengio team added attention to machine translation, solving the problem of long sentences being compressed into a single fixed vector and losing information; in 2017, it became the core of [[transformer-model|Transformer (neural network)]].
注意力让模型能在长文本中直接\"跳\"到相关位置，成为所有大模型的核心部件。代价: Attention allows models to 'jump' directly to relevant positions in long texts, becoming a core component of all large models. The cost is that computational complexity grows quadratically with length, making long contexts expensive (see [[context-window]]).
处理\"它\"时，注意力把最大的权重分给了\"小猫\"。线越粗，权重越大。: When processing 'it', attention assigns the largest weight to 'cat'. Thicker lines indicate larger weights.
完全基于注意力、可大规模并行训练的网络结构，几乎所有大模型都建立在它之上。: A network structure fully based on attention and capable of large-scale parallel training; almost all large models are built upon it.
2017 年谷歌的瓦斯瓦尼（Ashish Vaswani）、沙泽尔（Noam S: In 2017, Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, and others from Google published 'Attention Is All You Need' with 8 authors, setting new records in English-German translation while having much lower training costs.
Transformer 从翻译扩展到几乎所有领域：大语言模型、图像、语音、蛋白质: Transformer expanded from translation to almost all fields: large language models, images, speech, protein structure (AlphaFold 2), video generation, and robot control. 'One architecture dominates all' is unprecedented in AI history.
Transformer 的一层：先让每个 token\"看\"所有 token（: One layer of Transformer: first let each token 'look at' all tokens (self-attention), then process them individually (feed-forward); the same layer is stacked dozens of times.
让\"造假者\"和\"鉴定者\"两个网络互相对抗，逼出以假乱真的图像。: Let two networks, a 'forger' and an 'appraiser', compete against each other to produce images that are indistinguishable from real ones.
让两个网络玩一场 [[p:incentives|博弈]]：生成器努力造出以假乱真: Let two networks play a game of [[p:incentives|game theory]]: the generator works hard to create images that are indistinguishable from reality, while the discriminator works hard to expose fake images. Through this adversarial process, both sides improve together until the discriminator can no longer tell the difference between real and fake ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
生成器从随机噪声出发生成图片；判别器同时看真图和假图，输出\"是真图的概率\"，: The generator creates images from random noise; the discriminator simultaneously views both real and fake images, outputting "the probability that this is a real image." Its judgment is then fed back to the generator, telling it "where you got caught." The disadvantage is training instability.
2014 年古德费洛（Ian Goodfellow）在蒙特利尔大学提出。2018: In 2014, Ian Goodfellow proposed this at the University of Montreal. In 2018, NVIDIA's StyleGAN could generate faces that were almost impossible to distinguish as real or fake.
GAN 开启了\"AI 生成逼真图像\"的时代，也引发了对 [[deepfake: GANs opened the era of "AI-generated realistic images" and also sparked concerns about [[deepfake|Deepfake]]. After 2021, it was largely replaced by more stable and diverse [[diffusion-model|Diffusion model]] in image generation tasks, but it is still used for real-time tasks such as super-resolution.
先学会把噪声一步步去掉，再从纯噪声\"雕刻\"出全新的图像或视频。: First learn to remove noise step by step, then "carve" entirely new images or videos from pure noise.
把一张图一点点加噪声，最后会变成纯噪声——\"变乱\"很容易（[[p:entro: If you take an image and gradually add noise, it will eventually become pure noise—"becoming disordered" is easy ([[p:entropy|increasing entropy]]). If you train a network to learn how to "remove a bit of noise" at each step, you can reverse the process: starting from random noise, step by step "carve" out entirely new images ([[p:probability|probability]]).
训练时，随机取一张真图、加上一定量噪声，让网络预测加了什么噪声。生成时从纯噪声开: During training, randomly select a real image and add a certain amount of noise, then let the network predict what kind of noise was added. During generation, start from pure noise and repeatedly estimate and subtract part of the noise; after dozens of steps, you obtain a clear image. Text prompts guide the direction of denoising at each step through attention mechanisms; to save computational power, modern models often perform denoising in compressed "latent spaces".
2015 年索尔-迪克斯坦（Jascha Sohl-Dickstein）等人受非: In 2015, Jascha Sohl-Dickstein and others proposed the idea inspired by non-equilibrium thermodynamics; in 2020, Jonathan Ho and others' DDPM significantly improved the results. In 2022, DALL·E 2, Stable Diffusion, and Midjourney brought text-to-image generation to the masses; starting in 2024, it expanded to video.
扩散模型是今天图像、视频和音乐生成的主力，也被用来设计蛋白质和新材料。: Diffusion models are today's main force for generating images, videos, and music, and they are also used to design proteins and new materials.
训练时学\"加了什么噪声\"；生成时从纯噪声出发，一步步去噪得到图像。: During training, learn "what kind of noise was added"; during generation, start from pure noise and step by step denoise to obtain an image.
在海量文本上训练\"预测下一个词\"的超大 Transformer，涌现出对话、: Train a massive Transformer on vast amounts of text to "predict the next word," and emergent abilities in dialogue, writing, programming, and reasoning appear.
2018 年 OpenAI 的 GPT 与谷歌的 BERT 确立\"预训练 +: In 2018, OpenAI's GPT and Google's BERT established the paradigm of "pre-training + fine-tuning"; in 2020, GPT-3 with 175 billion parameters demonstrated the ability to "do tasks given a few examples"; at the end of 2022, [[chatgpt]] triggered widespread application. As of October 2026, frontier models include OpenAI's GPT-6 series, Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, Google's Gemini 4 Argon (opened to some cybersecurity defenders starting at the end of September), SpaceXAI (formerly xAI)'s Grok 4.7, and open-weight models like DeepSeek V4 (see [[open-weight-models]]).
大模型让\"用自然语言指挥计算机\"成为现实，正在改变写作、编程、客服、教育和科: Large models have made "using natural language to command computers" a reality, changing writing, programming, customer service, education, and research.
大模型三步走：海量文本预训练 → 微调与强化学习 → 逐个 token 生成回答: Large models follow a three-step path: massive text pre-training → fine-tuning and reinforcement learning → generating answers token by token.
OpenAI 的生成式预训练模型系列；GPT-3（2020）展示了规模带来的能力: OpenAI's generative pre-trained model series; GPT-3 (2020) demonstrated capability leaps brought by scale.
只用 Transformer 的解码器、只做\"预测下一个词\"这一件事，然后把: Using only the Transformer decoder, doing only "predicting the next word" this one thing, then scaling up the size tenfold, hundredfold generation after generation—abilities appear in steps ([[p:scale|Economies of scale]]).
GPT 是\"生成式预训练 Transformer\"（Generative P: GPT stands for "Generative Pre-trained Transformer." The main change in each generation is orders of magnitude in parameters, data, and computing power, as well as increasingly heavy post-training: GPT-3 could only continue writing, requiring clever prompts; InstructGPT and ChatGPT learned to follow instructions; GPT-4 can see images; o1 and GPT-5 added deep reasoning.
2018 年 GPT-1（1.17 亿参数）；2019 年 GPT-2（15 亿: In 2018, GPT-1 (117 million parameters); in 2019, GPT-2 (1.5 billion), OpenAI once delayed releasing the complete model citing "potential for abuse"; in 2020, GPT-3 (175 billion); in March 2023, GPT-4; in September 2024, the reasoning model o1; in August 2025, GPT-5; in September 2026, the GPT-6 series (Astra, Sol, Luna) were released successively.
GPT 系列证明了\"规模本身就是方法\"，把全行业带入大模型竞赛。从 GPT-: The GPT series proved that "scale itself is a method," bringing the entire industry into the large model competition. Starting from GPT-4, OpenAI no longer publicly releases parameter counts and training details.
2022 年 11 月发布的对话式 AI 产品，两个月用户破亿，让大模型进入大众: In November 2022, a conversational AI product was released; within two months, users exceeded 100 million, bringing large models into public view.
技术早已存在，决定性的一步是把它装进人人会用的对话框：零门槛加口口相传形成 [[: The technology already existed; the decisive step was putting it into chat interfaces that everyone can use: zero threshold plus word-of-mouth formed [[p:network|Network effects]], and massive user feedback allowed rapid product iteration.
ChatGPT 在 GPT-3.5 基础上做了指令微调和 [[rlhf|人类反馈: ChatGPT made instruction fine-tuning and [[rlhf|Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)]] on top of GPT-3.5, learning multi-turn dialogue, admitting errors, and refusing inappropriate requests. Subsequently, features such as web search, image reading, voice input, code writing, memory, and agent functions for task management were added one by one, with the underlying models continuously upgrading.
2022 年 11 月 30 日 OpenAI 以\"研究预览\"名义免费发布，: On November 30, 2022, OpenAI released it for free under the name "research preview"; within five days, users exceeded 1 million, and monthly active users exceeded 100 million in about two months, making it the fastest-growing consumer application at that time. According to data published by OpenAI, as of the end of September 2026, weekly users exceeded 1.2 billion.
ChatGPT 让生成式 AI 成为全民话题，迫使谷歌、百度等公司紧急跟进，触发: ChatGPT made generative AI a topic for everyone, forcing companies like Google and Baidu to urgently follow suit, triggering a global investment boom in AI, and prompting schools, publishing, and legal industries to rethink assignments, copyright, and liability.
模型越大、数据越多、算力越足，性能就按可预测的幂律变好。: The larger the model, the more data it has, and the greater its computing power, the better its performance improves according to a predictable power law.
在很大范围内，模型的损失随参数量、数据量和算力按幂律下降，在双对数坐标上是一条直: Over a large range, a model's loss decreases with the number of parameters, amount of data, and computing power following a power law; on a log-log scale, this forms a straight line. Increasing computing power by 10 times can predictably yield a certain degree of improvement ([[p:exponential|Exponential growth]], [[p:scale|Economies of scale]]).
研究者先训练一系列小模型，画出\"算力—损失\"直线，再外推大模型的表现，在花几: Researchers first train a series of small models to draw an 'computing power—loss' straight line, then extrapolate the performance of large models, roughly knowing what can be achieved before spending billions of dollars. The 2022 DeepMind Chinchilla study pointed out: given computing power, parameters and data should expand synchronously, with approximately 20 tokens per parameter; previously, many models had 'too many parameters but too little data'.
2020 年 OpenAI 的卡普兰（Jared Kaplan）等人发表《神经语: In 2020, OpenAI's Jared Kaplan et al. published 'Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models'; in 2022, Jordan Hoffmann et al. published the Chinchilla paper. Starting in 2024, the industry discovered another curve: when answering, 'thinking longer' leads to stable performance improvements with inference computing power (extended during testing).
缩放定律让 AI 研发从手艺变成可规划的工程，驱动了数千亿美元的数据中心投资。它: Scaling laws turned AI development from a craft into a plannable engineering discipline, driving data center investments of trillions of dollars. It is an empirical law rather than a physical law; whether high-quality data will run out and how long the curve can continue remain subjects of debate.
双对数坐标下，算力每增加 10 倍，损失按固定比例下降，看起来是一条直线。: On a log-log scale, every 10-fold increase in computing power results in a loss decrease by a fixed proportion, appearing as a straight line.
先在海量通用数据上学\"常识\"，再用少量专门数据教它特定任务。: First learn 'common sense' from massive general-purpose data, then teach it specific tasks using small amounts of specialized data.
通用知识只需学一次。先在海量数据上学会语言和世界的一般规律，再用少量专门数据\": General knowledge only needs to be learned once. First master the general laws of language and the world on massive data, then use small amounts of specialized data to 'point out' specifics, which is far cheaper than starting from scratch for each task (a better starting point for [[p:optimization|optimization]]).
预训练用自监督任务在数万亿 token 上训练，花费巨大。微调则在此基础上用几千: Pre-training uses self-supervised tasks trained on trillions of tokens, costing a huge amount. Fine-tuning continues training on thousands to hundreds of thousands of task data points based on this foundation: all parameters can be tuned, or only a small group of inserted parameters can be trained (such as LoRA, often less than 1% of the total), saving memory and time. For dialogue models, 'instruction fine-tuning' uses large amounts of 'instruction—ideal answer' demonstrations to teach it to obey.
视觉领域\"ImageNet 预训练 + 迁移\"在 2014 年前后已很普遍；: In the visual field, 'ImageNet pre-training + transfer' became common around 2014; in 2018, ULMFiT, GPT, and BERT brought this paradigm into the language field; in 2021, Microsoft researchers proposed LoRA.
AI 开发出现了分工：少数公司训练昂贵的基座模型，成千上万的团队在其上微调出客服: AI development has seen specialization: a few companies train expensive base models, while thousands or tens of thousands teams fine-tune them to create specialized models for customer service, law, medicine, etc. (see [[open-weight-models]]).
把文字切成模型能处理的小片段；模型的输入长度和计费都以 token 计。: Cut text into small fragments the model can process; a model's input length and billing are both calculated in tokens.
模型只能处理数字。把文字切成常见片段并编号：按整词切，词表会无限大；按单个字符切: Models can only process numbers. Cut text into common fragments and number them: cutting by whole words results in an infinitely large vocabulary; cutting by single characters results in sequences that are too long. Tokenization is a [[p:info|information]] compression compromise made between vocabulary size and sequence length.
主流方法是字节对编码（BPE）：从单个字节开始，反复把语料里最常相邻出现的两个片: The mainstream method is Byte Pair Encoding (BPE): starting from individual bytes, repeatedly merge the two most frequently adjacent fragments appearing in the corpus into new fragments until the vocabulary reaches a predetermined size (commonly 100,000 to 200,000). On average, an English token is about three-quarters of a word.
BPE 原是盖奇（Philip Gage）1994 年提出的数据压缩算法，201: BPE was originally proposed by Philip Gage in 1994 as a data compression algorithm; in 2015, Rico Sennrich et al. applied it to neural machine translation.
token 是大模型的\"计量单位\"，上下文长度、速度和价格都按 token: Tokens are the 'unit of measurement' for large models; context length, speed, and price are all calculated in tokens. It also explains some strange phenomena, such as a model not being able to count how many letter 'r's are in an English word—it sees fragments rather than letters.
模型一次能\"看到\"的文本长度，相当于它的工作记忆。: The length of text a model can 'see' at once is equivalent to its working memory.
模型一次只能\"看到\"有限长度的文本，就像人的工作记忆。窗口内的信息可以直接互: A model can only 'see' text of limited length, like a human's working memory. Information within the window can be directly referenced with each other; information outside the window cannot be seen ([[p:locality|locality]]).
窗口以 token 计，包括输入、历史对话和模型自己的输出。注意力计算量随长度平: Windows are counted in tokens, including input, historical dialogue, and the model's own output. Attention computation scales quadratically with length; long windows rely on more efficient attention algorithms, caching, and greater memory capacity. Being able to fit it does not mean remembering it well: models often ignore content in the middle of long texts.
2023 年 GPT-4 达到 3.2 万，Claude 达到 10 万；202: In 2023, GPT-4 reached 32,000, Claude reached 100,000; in 2024, Gemini 1.5 Pro supported 1 million; in April 2026, open-weight models like DeepSeek V4 also support millions of tokens.
长窗口让模型能一次读完整本书或整个代码库。超出窗口的资料，仍要靠 [[rag|检: Long windows allow models to read entire books or entire codebases at once. Materials beyond the window still rely on [[rag|Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)]] or 'memory' mechanisms for on-demand retrieval.
让人给模型回答打分，训练一个\"评分模型\"，再用强化学习让模型更有用、更安全。: Have humans rate model answers, train a 'scoring model', and then use reinforcement learning to make the model more useful and safer.
什么是\"好回答\"很难写成公式，但人很容易比较两个回答哪个更好。先用人的比较训: It is difficult to write a formula for what constitutes a 'good answer', but humans can easily compare which of two answers is better. First train a 'scoring model' using human comparisons, then use reinforcement learning to have the large model pursue high scores—human preferences become [[p:feedback|feedback]] signals ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
三步：①人写示范回答，做监督微调；②让模型对同一问题生成多个回答，由人排序，训练: Three steps: ① Humans write demonstration answers to perform supervised fine-tuning; ② The model generates multiple answers for the same question, and humans rank them to train a reward model that mimics human preferences; ③ Reinforcement learning is used to have the model generate high-scoring answers while preventing it from deviating too far from the original model.
2017 年 OpenAI 与 DeepMind 的克里斯蒂亚诺（Paul Ch: In 2017, OpenAI and DeepMind's Paul Christiano et al. proposed learning from human preferences; in 2022, OpenAI's InstructGPT applied this to language models, where a version with 1.3 billion parameters was favored by evaluators over the 175 billion parameter GPT-3.
RLHF 是 ChatGPT 好用的关键之一。副作用包括\"讨好\"（顺着用户说: RLHF is one of the key factors making ChatGPT useful. Side effects include "flattery" (agreeing with users) and "reward hacking" (exploiting loopholes in scoring models), leading to methods like "Constitutional AI" that let AIs self-evaluate based on written principles.
通过精心设计的指令和示例引导模型给出更好的回答。: Guide the model to provide better answers through carefully designed instructions and examples.
大模型会根据上文推测\"接下来最可能出现什么\"。写清角色、目标、例子和格式，就: Large models infer "what is most likely to appear next" based on preceding text. Clearly defining roles, goals, examples, and formats guides it toward the desired type of text—programming in natural language ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
常用技巧：说明背景和目的；给几个输入—输出示例（少样本提示）；要求一步步推理；规: Common techniques: state background and purpose; provide several input-output examples (few-shot prompting); require step-by-step reasoning; specify output format (tables, JSON); break large tasks into small steps.
2020 年 GPT-3 论文展示了少样本提示：不改参数，只在提示里放几个例子，: The 2020 GPT-3 paper demonstrated few-shot prompting: without changing parameters, simply placing a few examples in the prompt allows the model to perform new tasks. In 2022, "Chain-of-thought prompting" was proposed (see [[chain-of-thought]]).
提示工程一度被视为新职业。模型越来越会揣摩意图后，重心转向\"上下文工程\"：为: Prompt engineering was once considered a new profession. As models become increasingly adept at inferring intent, the focus has shifted to "context engineering": preparing documents, tools, and memory for agents. It also brings "prompt injection" attacks: malicious instructions hidden in web pages may hijack the model.
让模型先写出中间推理步骤再作答；2024 年起出现专门训练\"想得更久\"的推理: Have the model write intermediate reasoning steps before answering; since 2024, models specifically trained to "think longer" have emerged.
难题需要中间步骤。让模型把推理写出来，每一步都成为下一步的上下文，相当于给了它草: Difficult problems require intermediate steps. Have the model write out its reasoning, making each step context for the next, effectively giving it scratch paper; then use reinforcement learning to reward the final correct reasoning process, teaching the model to think longer and more carefully ([[p:optimization|optimization]], [[p:feedback|feedback]]).
最简单的做法是在提示里加一句\"让我们一步步思考\"。推理模型则在回答前先生成很: The simplest approach is to add "Let's think step by step" in the prompt. Reasoning models first generate long internal thoughts before answering: trying multiple approaches, checking errors, and revising back. The longer they think, the higher the accuracy usually.
2022 年谷歌研究者发表思维链提示论文。2024 年 9 月 OpenAI 发: Google researchers published the Chain-of-thought prompting paper in 2022. In September 2024, OpenAI released its first reasoning model, o1; in January 2025, DeepSeek-R1 publicly released weights trained with reinforcement learning for reasoning. In July 2025, Google DeepMind and OpenAI's experimental models answered questions in natural language in the International Mathematical Olympiad, achieving gold medal scores.
推理模型让 AI 在数学、编程和科学上大幅进步，也让单次回答的算力成本上升。: Reasoning models have significantly advanced AI in mathematics, programming, and science, but also increased computational costs per single response.
模型写出的推理过程不一定忠实反映它内部真正的计算。: The reasoning process written by the model does not necessarily faithfully reflect its true internal computations.
先从资料库中检索相关内容，再让模型基于它们作答，减少胡编并能引用最新信息。: First retrieve relevant content from a knowledge base, then let the model answer based on them, reducing hallucinations and allowing citations of latest information.
与其要求模型把所有知识都记在参数里，不如回答前先\"翻书\"：检索出相关资料放进: Rather than requiring the model to store all knowledge in parameters, first "flip through books" by retrieving relevant materials into context before answering—externalizing memory and accessing it locally ([[p:locality|locality]]).
先把文档切块，用嵌入模型把每块变成向量存进向量数据库；用户提问时把问题也变成向量: First slice documents into chunks, use embedding models to convert each chunk into vectors stored in a vector database; when users ask questions, convert the question into a vector as well to find the most similar chunks (often combined with keyword search), then submit them along with the question to the model and require it to cite sources.
2020 年 Facebook（现 Meta）的刘易斯（Patrick Lewi: In 2020, Patrick Lewis et al. from Facebook (now Meta) published a paper proposing the term "Retrieval-Augmented Generation". Since 2023, it has become the standard practice for enterprise knowledge base Q&A; chat assistants with web search use the same approach.
RAG 让模型能回答最新的、私有的信息并给出可核查的出处，显著减少 [[hall: RAG allows models to answer latest and private information and provide verifiable sources, significantly reducing [[hallucination|Hallucination]]. However, if retrieved materials are erroneous or irrelevant, the model will still answer incorrectly.
能自己规划步骤、调用工具、操作软件来完成多步任务的 AI 系统。: AI systems capable of planning steps themselves, calling tools, and operating software to complete multi-step tasks.
语言模型能把目标拆成步骤、决定调用什么工具、看了结果再决定下一步。把\"思考—行: Language models can break goals into steps, decide what tools to call, and determine next actions after observing results. Connecting "Think-Act-Observe" into a [[p:feedback|feedback]] loop transforms it from "answering questions" to "completing tasks" ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
智能体由大模型（规划和决策）、工具（搜索、代码执行、浏览器、各种 API）、记忆: Agents consist of large models (planning and decision-making), tools (search, code execution, browsers, various APIs), memory (progress and experience), and runtime environments, working in cycles: read task → think next step → call tool → observe result → think again, until completion or human confirmation. Since 2024, "computer operation" agents capable of viewing screens and moving mouse/keyboard have emerged. To facilitate model access to various tools, Anthropic launched the open Model Context Protocol (MCP) in November 2024 and donated it to the newly formed Agent AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation in December 2025.
\"智能体\"是 AI 教科书里的老概念。2023 年 AutoGPT 引发热潮: "Agent" is an old concept in AI textbooks. AutoGPT sparked a trend in 2023; programming and office agents began large-scale use in real work in 2025–2026.
智能体把 AI 从聊天窗口带进软件开发、数据分析和办公流程。风险也随之放大：连锁: Agents bring AI from chat windows into software development, data analysis, and office workflows. Risks are also amplified: cascading errors, hijacking by malicious instructions in web pages, executing irreversible actions; therefore, permissions are usually restricted and human confirmation retained.
同时理解和生成文字、图像、语音、视频的模型。: Models that simultaneously understand and generate text, images, audio, and video.
图像、声音和文字都能切成 token、映射进同一个向量空间，于是一个 Trans: Images, sound, and text can all be sliced into tokens and mapped into the same vector space, allowing a Transformer to treat them as the same kind of "language" for processing and correspondence ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
图片切成小块，每块经编码器变成向量；音频切成短帧；它们和文字 token 排在一: Images are cut into small blocks, each block converted into a vector by an encoder; audio is cut into short frames; they are arranged together with text tokens and fed into the model. Training relies on large paired samples, such as images with descriptive text. In 2021, OpenAI's CLIP learned image-text alignment using 400 million pairs of image-text data.
2023 年 GPT-4 支持图像输入，谷歌 Gemini 从设计之初就是原生多: In 2023, GPT-4 supported image input; Google Gemini was natively multimodal from its initial design; in 2024, GPT-4o enabled real-time voice conversation. By 2026, cutting-edge models generally can read images, view videos, listen, and speak, and directly generate images.
多模态让 AI 能看懂截图、图表、医学影像和手写作业，也是 [[embodied: Multimodality enables AI to understand screenshots, charts, medical imaging, and handwritten homework; it is also the foundation for [[embodied-ai|Embodied AI]] (Embodied AI) allowing robots to "understand" the world.
模型由许多\"专家\"子网络组成，每次只激活其中几个，参数多但计算省。: Models consist of many "expert" sub-networks; only a few are activated each time, resulting in high parameter counts but reduced computation.
不是每个问题都要动用全部知识。把网络拆成许多\"专家\"，由路由器为每个 tok: Not every problem requires all knowledge. By splitting the network into many "experts" and having routers select only a few for each token to compute, one can achieve massive total parameter counts while keeping per-token computation equivalent to that of a small model ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
在 Transformer 的前馈层位置放几十到几百个专家子网络；路由器给专家打: Place dozens to hundreds of expert sub-networks in the Transformer's feed-forward layers; routers score experts and select the highest-scoring ones to participate in computation. The challenge is preventing all tokens from crowding into a few "popular" experts.
1991 年雅各布斯、乔丹、诺兰和辛顿提出混合专家；2017 年沙泽尔等人把它用: Jacob, Jordan, Nolan, and Hinton proposed Mixture of Experts in 1991; Szell et al. applied it to ultra-large language models in 2017. At the end of 2024, DeepSeek-V3 had a total parameter count of 671 billion, activating approximately 37 billion per token; by 2026, DeepSeek V4-Pro had a total parameter count of approximately 1.6 trillion, activating approximately 49 billion.
MoE 已是前沿大模型的主流结构，大幅降低了训练和推理成本；代价是显存占用大、部: MoE has become the mainstream structure for cutting-edge large models, significantly reducing training and inference costs; the trade-off is high memory usage and more complex deployment.
公开发布模型参数供任何人下载、部署和微调，如 Llama、DeepSeek、Qw: Publicly release model parameters for anyone to download, deploy, and fine-tune, such as Llama, DeepSeek, and Qwen.
公开模型权重，任何人都能下载、部署、微调和研究；用的人越多，生态越繁荣（[[p:: Publish open model weights, allowing anyone to download, deploy, fine-tune, and research; the more users there are, the more prosperous the ecosystem becomes ([[p:incentives|incentives]]). The downside is that once published, they cannot be recalled, and misuse is difficult to prevent.
\"开放权重\"不完全等于\"开源\"：多数模型只公开权重和推理代码，不公开训练: "Open weights" do not fully equate to "open source": most models only publish weights and inference code, not training data; licenses may also restrict usage. Users can run quantized models on their own servers or even laptops (see [[model-compression]]), keeping data local.
2023 年 Meta 发布 LLaMA 和可商用的 Llama 2，法国 Mi: In 2023, Meta released LLaMA and commercially available Llama 2; French Mistral and Alibaba's Tongyi Qianwen (Qwen) followed. In January 2025, DeepSeek-R1 was released under MIT license, approaching top-tier closed-source models at much lower costs, causing a sharp drop in the US stock market's AI sector; in April 2026, DeepSeek V4 continued to be opened under MIT license.
开放权重模型让高校、初创公司和不愿上传数据的机构也能用上强大模型，尤其推动了中国: Open-weight models enable universities, startups, and institutions unwilling to upload data to use powerful models, especially promoting China's AI ecosystem; whether to open the strongest model remains a focal point of debate in the security field.
让小模型模仿大模型（蒸馏）或用更少位数存参数（量化），让模型跑得更快更省。: Let small models mimic large models (distillation) or store parameters with fewer bits (quantization), making models run faster and more efficiently.
训练好的大模型有大量冗余：参数不必用 16 位精度存，小模型也能学会大模型的大部: Trained large models have significant redundancy: parameters do not need to be stored at 16-bit precision; small models can also learn most of the large model's "intuition." Removing redundancy [[p:info|information]] allows for significant compression.
**量化**把每个参数从 16 位压到 8 位、4 位甚至更低，体积和显存需求成: **Quantization** compresses each parameter from 16-bit to 8-bit, 4-bit, or even lower, causing volume and memory requirements to drop exponentially, with precision loss usually being minimal. **Distillation** lets small "students" mimic the probability distribution or reasoning process of large "teachers," learning more than just standard answers. **Pruning** removes unimportant connections or structures.
2015 年辛顿、维尼亚尔斯和迪恩（Jeff Dean）提出知识蒸馏。4 位量化: Hinton, Vinyals, and Dean (Jeff Dean) proposed knowledge distillation in 2015. 4-bit quantization allows models with tens of billions of parameters to run on laptops; in 2025, DeepSeek used the reasoning process of R1 to distill multiple small models.
压缩让 AI 能装进手机、汽车和笔记本，降低了推理成本，也是端侧 AI 和隐私保: Compression enables AI to fit into phones, cars, and laptops, reducing inference costs and serving as the foundation for edge AI and privacy protection (see [[ai-inference]]).
训练好的模型回答每个请求都要算力；推理成本决定了 AI 能否普及。: Trained models require computing power for every request; inference costs determine whether AI can be widespread.
训练是一次性投入，推理是每次使用都要付的\"电费\"。每生成一个 token 都: Training is a one-time investment; inference is the "electricity bill" paid each time of use. Generating each token requires reading most weights from memory, so speed is often limited by memory bandwidth rather than computing power; with more users, total inference volume increases, and unit costs continuously decline according to [[p:scale|scale]] (scale) and technological progress.
服务商用批处理、KV 缓存（存下算过的中间结果）、推测解码、量化和专用芯片来降低: Service commercial batch processing, KV cache (storing computed intermediate results), speculative decoding, quantization, and dedicated chips reduce the cost per token; prices are typically charged per million input/output tokens.
按 Epoch AI 等机构的统计，达到同等能力所需的 API 价格在 2023: According to statistics from agencies like Epoch AI, API prices required to achieve equivalent capability dropped by approximately one order of magnitude or faster annually between 2023–2025. Inference models and agents may consume hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens per task, causing total demand to grow rapidly.
推理成本决定 AI 能否普及到每个应用；推理已成为 [[data-center|: Inference costs determine whether AI can be scaled to every application; inference has become a major source of growth in both computing power and electricity consumption ([[data-center|Data center]]).
模型一本正经地编造不存在的事实，因为它学的是\"像真的\"而非\"是真的\"。: Models seriously fabricate non-existent facts because they learn what is "like real" rather than what is "truly real".
语言模型学的是\"什么样的文字在统计上像真的\"（[[p:probability: Language models learn what kind of text statistically resembles reality ([[p:probability|probability]]), not what is truly true. When an answer is unknown, the most "presentable" continuation is often a seemingly reasonable fabrication.
常见表现是虚构引文、捏造人名和数据、张冠李戴。训练和评测方式也有责任：如果答错和: Common manifestations include fabricating citations, inventing names and data, and misattributing sources. Training and evaluation methods also bear responsibility: if both wrong answers and saying "I don't know" result in zero scores, models are encouraged to guess. Mitigation approaches include [[rag|retrieval augmentation]] (retrieval augmentation) with citation sourcing, training models to express uncertainty, using tools for verification, and human review.
2023 年美国一名律师用 ChatGPT 写诉状，引用了六个根本不存在的判例，: In 2023, an American lawyer used ChatGPT to draft a lawsuit citing six non-existent precedents, resulting in a court fine and becoming a famous case. In September 2025, OpenAI published a paper explaining the causes of hallucinations from the perspectives of training and evaluation incentives.
幻觉是大模型进入医疗、法律、新闻等高风险场景的主要障碍。新一代模型的幻觉率已明显: Hallucinations represent the primary barrier for large models entering high-risk scenarios such as healthcare, law, and journalism. Hallucination rates in next-generation models have declined significantly, but important facts still require verification.
能根据文字提示生成文本、图像、音乐、视频和代码的 AI。: AI capable of generating text, images, music, video, and code based on textual prompts.
模型一旦学会了数据的 [[p:probability|概率分布]]——什么样的像: Once a model learns the [[p:probability|probability distributions]] (probability distributions) — what pixel arrangements resemble cats, what word orders resemble poems — it can "sample" from them to produce unprecedented yet stylistically consistent new content.
不同模态用不同技术：文字和代码主要靠自回归的 [[llm|大语言模型]] 逐 t: Different modalities use different techniques: text and code primarily rely on autoregressive [[llm|Large language model (LLM)]] (Large language model (LLM)) token-by-token generation; images, video, and music primarily rely on [[diffusion-model|Diffusion model]] (Diffusion model) to gradually denoise from noise; early versions also used [[gan|Generative adversarial network (GAN)]] (Generative adversarial network (GAN)). Users describe requirements in natural language, and the model generates multiple candidates for selection and modification.
2022 年被称为\"生成式 AI 元年\"：DALL·E 2、Midjourn: 2022 was called the "year of generative AI": DALL·E 2, Midjourney, and Stable Diffusion were released successively, followed by ChatGPT's launch in November. In February 2024, OpenAI demonstrated the video model Sora; since then, Google's Veo, Kuaishou's Kling, and others have been launched successively, reaching the ability to generate high-definition short films with synchronized sound by 2025.
生成式 AI 降低了写作、设计、编程、配音和视频制作的门槛，改变了创意行业的分工: Generative AI has lowered thresholds for writing, design, programming, voice-over, and video production, changing the division of labor in creative industries; it has also triggered copyright lawsuits regarding training data, an information environment where truth is hard to distinguish (see [[deepfake]]), and regulatory requirements such as "AI content must be labeled".
让 AI 学会预测\"如果这样做，世界会变成什么样\"，被视为通向机器人和通用智: Teaching AI to predict "what would happen if we do this" is considered a key path toward robotics and general intelligence.
能预测\"做了这件事之后世界会变成什么样\"，才能先在脑中演练再行动。一个能预测: The ability to predict "what the world will become after doing this" allows for mental rehearsal before action. A model capable of predicting future observations is a compressed representation of environmental laws ([[p:probability|probability]]).
世界模型接收当前状态（如视频画面）和一个动作，预测下一刻的状态。智能体可以在这个: World models receive current states (such as video frames) and an action, then predict the next state. Agents can trial and error and plan within this "imagined world," reducing costly attempts in reality. Video generation models are often viewed as its prototype: to generate reasonable video, one must vaguely understand gravity and occlusion.
2018 年哈（David Ha）与施米德胡贝发表论文《世界模型》，让智能体在自: In 2018, Ha (David Ha) and Schmidhuber published the paper "World Models," enabling agents to learn driving within their own "dreamed" environments. The Genie series from DeepMind in 2024–2025 has already been able to generate interactive virtual worlds.
世界模型被视为通向 [[embodied-ai|具身智能]] 和自动驾驶的关键，: World models are considered key paths toward [[embodied-ai|Embodied AI]] (Embodied AI) and autonomous driving, and can also synthesize training data at scale.
画面逼真不等于懂物理，生成的世界里仍常见物体穿模、凭空消失。: Realistic visuals do not equal understanding of physics; generated worlds still commonly exhibit objects passing through each other or vanishing into thin air.
专门优化矩阵乘法的芯片，如英伟达 GPU 和谷歌 TPU，是大模型时代的\"电力: Chips specifically optimized for matrix multiplication, such as NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs, are the "electricity" of the large model era.
神经网络的计算绝大部分是矩阵乘法：海量、规整、彼此独立。专用芯片可以堆满乘加单元: The vast majority of neural network computation is matrix multiplication: massive, regular, and mutually independent. Specialized chips can be packed with multiply-accumulate units, remove the complex control logic of general-purpose CPUs, and switch to low-precision numbers ([[p:division|division of labor]]); surging demand has caused chips and clusters to grow larger together ([[p:scale|Economies of scale]]).
英伟达 GPU 里的\"张量核心\"一次完成一小块矩阵乘法；谷歌 TPU 用\": "Tensor cores" inside NVIDIA GPUs complete a small block of matrix multiplication in one pass; Google TPUs use "pulsar arrays" to let data flow like a heartbeat among thousands or tens of thousands of multipliers, reducing memory read/write overhead. Modern AI chips are all equipped with [[hbm|High-bandwidth memory (HBM)]] (High-bandwidth memory (HBM)), using high-speed interconnects to connect tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of chips into a single "supercomputer." Digital precision has dropped from 32-bit to 16-bit, 8-bit, and even 4-bit; the same silicon slice can perform several times more operations.
2016 年谷歌公布已在数据中心使用一年多的 TPU；2017 年英伟达 V10: In 2016, Google announced TPUs used in data centers for over a year; in 2017, NVIDIA's V100 introduced tensor cores. In 2026, NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform (equipped with HBM4) began mass production and shipment; Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Huawei, and others also have self-developed chips.
AI 芯片成为战略物资，美国自 2022 年起限制高端 AI 芯片对华出口（见: AI chips have become strategic materials; since 2022, the US has restricted high-end AI chip exports to China (see [[semiconductor-geopolitics]]), causing NVIDIA to enter the ranks of globally highest market-value companies.
由人给图片、文本、语音打上标签，为监督学习提供\"标准答案\"。: Humans provide labels for images, text, and speech, providing "standard answers" for supervised learning.
监督学习需要\"标准答案\"，而答案只能来自人的判断。把海量标注拆成简单的小任务: Supervised learning requires "standard answers," which can only come from human judgment. By breaking massive labeling tasks into simple small tasks assigned to thousands or tens of thousands of annotators, training data can be produced like in a factory ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
任务包括给图片画框、给每个像素分类、转写语音，以及为大模型写示范回答、比较回答好: Tasks include drawing bounding boxes around images, classifying each pixel, transcribing speech, and writing demonstration responses for large models while comparing the quality of answers. Increasingly, AI performs labeling first, with humans only auditing; in the era of large models, doctors, lawyers, and mathematicians are still needed to write high-difficulty data.
2005 年亚马逊推出众包平台 Mechanical Turk，[[imagen: Amazon launched the crowdsourcing platform Mechanical Turk in 2005, which helped complete tens of millions of labels using [[imagenet]]. Companies like Scale AI, founded in 2016, turned labeling into a major industry.
数据标注在肯尼亚、菲律宾、印度和中国中小城市创造了大量新岗位，也引发了对低薪和内: Data labeling created numerous new jobs in Kenya, the Philippines, India, and small-to-medium cities in China, but also raised concerns about low wages and psychological trauma caused by content moderation.
用标准题库衡量和比较模型能力；题目一旦被\"刷穿\"就需要更难的新基准。: Model capabilities are measured and compared using standardized test banks; once a set of questions is "cracked," harder new benchmarks must be created.
没有统一考试，就无法比较模型、衡量进步。但考试只是对能力的抽样（[[p:prob: Without unified exams, models cannot be compared or progress assessed. However, exams only represent a sample of ability ([[p:probability|statistics]]); once a model solves all questions perfectly, scores no longer distinguish quality—"when an indicator becomes a target, it ceases to be a good indicator" (Goodhart's Law).
常见基准有图像识别的 ImageNet、综合知识的 MMLU、编程的 SWE-b: Common benchmarks include ImageNet for image recognition, MMLU for general knowledge, SWE-bench for programming, FrontierMath for mathematics, and HLE, which is authored by nearly 1,000 experts and claimed to be "the last exam for humans"; benchmarks are often "cracked" within years or even months, forcing the creation of increasingly difficult new questions.
2018 年 GLUE、2020 年 MMLU、2023 年 SWE-bench: GLUE was launched in 2018, MMLU in 2020, SWE-bench in 2023, and HLE in early 2025. By 2026, frontier models had approached full scores on many early benchmarks, shifting evaluation focus toward long-term agent tasks and real-world work outputs.
基准塑造了研究方向。隐患是数据污染和\"应试\"优化，重要结论需要多个基准和真实: Benchmarks shape research directions. Risks include data contamination and "exam-oriented" optimization; important conclusions require cross-validation across multiple benchmarks and real-world usage.
数据留在各自手机或机构里，只上传模型更新，在保护隐私的同时联合训练。: Data remains within individual phones or institutions, with only model updates uploaded, protecting privacy while enabling joint training.
把模型送到数据那里，而不是把数据送到服务器。各方只上传参数更新，服务器把更新平均: Models are sent to the data rather than data to the server. Parties upload only parameter updates; the server averages them and sends them back ([[p:division|division of labor]]), keeping raw data always local.
每一轮，服务器把当前模型发给一批手机；每部手机用本地数据训练几步，只上传参数的变: In each round, the server sends the current model to a batch of phones; each phone trains for several steps using local data and uploads only parameter changes; the server performs weighted averaging to generate a new model. To prevent privacy inference from updates, secure aggregation and differential privacy (adding carefully controlled noise) are often used.
2016 年谷歌的麦克马汉（Brendan McMahan）等人提出\"联邦学习: Google's Brendan McMahan and others proposed "federated learning" in 2016, which was applied to Android Gboard for next-word prediction in 2017.
联邦学习用于手机输入法、医院间联合研究和银行反欺诈，是在隐私法规下利用分散数据的: Federated learning is used in mobile input methods, joint hospital research, and bank fraud detection; it is an important method for leveraging distributed data under privacy regulations (see [[ai-privacy]]).
一张图片对计算机只是几百万个数字。视觉就是从这些数字里逐层提取边缘、形状、物体和: A single image is merely several million numbers to a computer. Vision involves extracting edges, shapes, objects, and relationships layer by layer from these numbers—moving from low-level signals to high-level [[p:abstraction|abstraction]].
主要任务有：图像分类（这是什么）、目标检测（在哪里，画框）、语义分割（每个像素属: Key tasks include image classification (what is this), object detection (where, draw boxes), semantic segmentation (what each pixel belongs to), pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video understanding. Early methods relied on hand-designed features (such as SIFT); after 2012, they were dominated by [[cnn|Convolutional neural network (CNN)]]; after 2020, vision Transformers and large-scale text-image pretraining enabled models to recognize objects described in arbitrary text.
1966 年麻省理工学院的\"夏季视觉项目\"设想一个暑假解决\"让计算机看懂图: MIT's "Summer Project" in 1966 envisioned solving "letting computers understand images" over a summer break, resulting in half a century of effort. YOLO achieved real-time object detection in 2015; Meta's SAM model in 2023 can "segment everything."
视觉技术用于手机拍照、工厂质检（见 [[machine-vision]]）、医学: Vision technology is used for mobile photography, factory quality inspection (see [[machine-vision]]), medical imaging, autonomous driving, and unmanned retail, raising ethical controversies over mass surveillance (see [[face-recognition]]).
提取人脸特征并比对身份，用于手机解锁、支付和安防，也引发隐私争议。: Extracting facial features and comparing identities is used for phone unlocking, payments, security, and access control, also raising privacy controversies.
每张人脸都能被压缩成一串数字（特征向量）：同一人的不同照片彼此靠近，不同人相距较: Each face can be compressed into a string of numbers (feature vector): photos of the same person are close together, while different people are far apart. Recognition becomes comparing distances and giving [[p:probability|probability]] judgments.
四步：检测人脸 → 对齐摆正 → 用深度网络提取特征 → 与数据库比对。1:1: Four steps: detect face → align and correct posture → extract features using deep networks → compare with database. 1:1 verification (is this the person, such as facial unlock) is much easier than 1:N recognition (finding who from millions).
1960 年代布莱索（Woody Bledsoe）做了早期实验；2014 年 F: Early experiments were done by Woody Bledsoe in the 1960s; DeepFace from Facebook and DeepID from Tsinghua University's team led by Tang Xiaowu approached human accuracy on the LFW test set in 2014; iPhone X launched Face ID in 2017.
把图片中的印刷或手写文字识别成可编辑文本。: Recognizing printed or handwritten text in images as editable text.
文字由有限个字形组成，识别就是把图像中的每个形状归入最可能的字符——一个典型的: Text is composed of a finite set of character shapes. Recognition involves assigning each shape in an image to the most likely character—a typical [[p:probability|probability]] classification problem—followed by correction using linguistic patterns.
传统 OCR 先二值化，切出每行每字，再做模板匹配或特征分类；现代 OCR 用深: Traditional OCR first binarizes images, segments them into rows and characters, then performs template matching or feature-based classification; modern OCR uses deep networks to recognize entire lines directly and employs language models to correct confusions like '0' and 'O'. Today, multimodal large models can read entire pages of documents directly, converting tables and formulas together into structured text.
1950 年代已有只认特定字体的读字机。1974 年库兹韦尔（Ray Kurzw: In the 1950s, machines capable of recognizing only specific fonts existed. In 1974, Ray Kurzweil founded a company to develop "all-font" OCR capable of recognizing almost any printed font; in 1976, it was adapted for use as a reading device for the blind.
OCR 让数以千万计的纸质书（如谷歌图书）可以被搜索，也是拍照翻译、票据录入的基: OCR enables millions of physical books (such as Google Books) to be searchable and serves as the foundation for photo translation and invoice data entry.
让计算机理解和生成人类语言，包括翻译、问答、摘要、情感分析。: Enabling computers to understand and generate human language includes tasks such as translation, question answering, summarization, and sentiment analysis.
语言既有语法规则，又充满歧义和例外。实践证明，从海量文本中学习词语共现的 [[p: Language possesses both grammatical rules and is filled with ambiguity and exceptions. Practice has demonstrated that learning word co-occurrence from massive amounts of text via [[p:probability|statistical patterns]] is more effective at grasping real language than manually writing rules.
经典任务包括分词（中文尤其需要）、词性标注、句法分析、实体识别、情感分析、问答、: Classic tasks include tokenization (especially necessary for Chinese), part-of-speech tagging, syntactic analysis, named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, question answering, summarization, and [[machine-translation|translation]]. Methods have evolved through three generations: rule-based (linguists write grammar) → statistical (n-gram language models, hidden Markov models) → neural networks ([[word-embedding|Word embedding]], RNNs, then Transformers and large models). Today, most tasks are unified by a single large model via prompting.
1950 年代乔姆斯基（Noam Chomsky）的形式语法影响了早期研究。19: In the 1950s, Noam Chomsky's formal grammar influenced early research. In the late 1980s, IBM's Frederick Jelinek advanced statistical methods, leaving behind a joke: "Every time a linguist is fired, recognition rate goes up a bit."
NLP 让搜索引擎能理解查询、输入法能联想、客服能自动应答，最终以大语言模型的形: NLP enables search engines to understand queries, input methods to suggest words, and customer service systems to auto-reply, ultimately becoming the primary interface of AI in the form of large language models.
从规则翻译到统计翻译再到神经网络翻译，质量在 2016 年后大幅跃升。: Translation quality jumped significantly after 2016, moving from rule-based translation to statistical translation to neural machine translation.
翻译可以看成：在目标语言的所有可能句子中，找出既通顺、又最忠实于原文的那一句。系: Translation can be viewed as: among all possible sentences in the target language, finding the one that is both fluent and most faithful to the source text. Systems learn this correspondence from large amounts of manually translated parallel texts ([[p:probability|probability]]).
三代方法：**规则翻译**靠语言学家写词典和语法转换规则，生硬难扩展；**统计翻: Three generations of methods: **Rule-based translation** relies on linguists writing dictionaries and grammar conversion rules, which are rigid and hard to extend; **Statistical translation** statistically phrases correspondences and word order from bilingual corpora, resulting in greater naturalness; **Neural translation** uses an encoder to read entire sentences, then a decoder generates words sequentially using [[attention-mechanism|Attention]], greatly improving fluency. Today's large language models complete translation directly as instructions while preserving tone and terminology.
1954 年乔治城大学与 IBM 演示把 60 多个俄语句子自动译成英语，引发乐: In 1954, Georgetown University and IBM demonstrated automatic translation of over 60 Russian sentences into English, sparking optimistic expectations; in 1966, the US ALPAC report concluded pessimistically, leading to a sharp reduction in funding. In 2015, Baidu and in 2016, Google successively launched neural machine translation.
机器翻译让跨语言阅读、跨境电商和国际交流几乎零门槛，实时字幕和翻译耳机已经普及；: Machine translation makes cross-language reading, cross-border e-commerce, and international communication nearly barrier-free; real-time subtitles and translation earbuds have become widespread; literary, legal, and medical translations still require human oversight.
把语音转成文字，深度学习让识别率接近人类，催生了语音助手。: Converting speech to text, deep learning has brought recognition rates close to human levels, giving birth to voice assistants.
声音先被 [[p:sampling|采样]] 成数字，再变成显示各频率能量随时间: Sound is first converted into digital data via [[p:sampling|sampling]], then becomes a "spectrogram" displaying energy changes over time for each frequency; recognition involves finding the most likely sequence of characters that could produce this spectrogram ([[p:probability|probability]]).
传统系统由声学模型（声音片段像哪个音素）、发音词典和语言模型（哪种词序常见）拼成: Traditional systems were composed of acoustic models (which sound fragments resemble which phonemes), pronunciation dictionaries, and language models (which word orders are common), linked together using hidden Markov models. In the deep learning era, end-to-end architectures replaced them: a single network outputs text directly from the spectrogram. In 2022, OpenAI's Whisper used a multilingual network audio training dataset of 680,000 hours, showing robustness against accents and noise.
1952 年贝尔实验室的 Audrey 能识别一个人说的 10 个数字。1970: In 1952, Audrey at Bell Labs could recognize 10 digits spoken by a person. In the 1970–1980s, IBM and Carnegie Mellon University advanced statistical methods. After 2009, deep networks significantly reduced error rates; in 2017, Microsoft achieved an approximate 5.1% error rate in telephone conversation tests, comparable to professional stenographers.
语音识别催生了语音输入、[[virtual-assistant|语音助手]]、会: Speech recognition gave birth to voice input, [[virtual-assistant|Virtual assistant]], meeting subtitles, and in-car voice control, enabling computer use for those unable to type.
把文字转成自然的语音，如今能模仿特定人的声音。: Converting text into natural-sounding speech now allows imitation of specific individuals' voices.
声音可以拆成声带振动的\"音源\"和口腔形状决定的\"滤波\"，[[p:samp: Sound can be decomposed into a "source" determined by vocal cord vibration and a "filter" determined by oral cavity shape; after [[p:sampling|sampling]], it becomes a string of numbers. Models can "speak" simply by learning to predict this string of numbers (or its spectrum) from text.
早期要么用规则模拟发声器官，要么把真人录音切成片段再拼接，听起来机械。2016: Early systems either used rules to simulate vocal organs or cut real recordings into fragments for splicing, sounding mechanical. In 2016, DeepMind's WaveNet used neural networks to generate waveforms point-by-point via sampling, greatly improving naturalness. Modern systems first generate spectra then convert them to waveforms, or like language models, directly generate audio tokens; a few seconds of recording can clone an individual's voice.
1939 年贝尔实验室在纽约世博会展示电子发声机 Voder。: In 1939, Bell Labs demonstrated the electronic speech synthesizer Voder at the New York World's Fair.
语音合成让导航、读屏软件和有声书普及，能为失声者重建声音；声音克隆也被用于电信诈: Speech synthesis has enabled navigation, screen-reading software, and audiobooks to become widespread; it can rebuild voices for those who have lost their voice; voice cloning is also used in telecom fraud (see [[deepfake]]).
根据你和相似用户的行为猜你喜欢什么，驱动电商、视频和信息流。: Based on your behavior and that of similar users, the system predicts what you might like, driving e-commerce, video content, and information feeds.
口味相似的人会喜欢相似的东西。从你和千万用户的点击、购买、观看行为中找出相似性，: People with similar tastes tend to like similar things. By identifying similarities from your clicks, purchases, and viewing behaviors alongside those of millions of users, the system can [[p:probability|Prediction]] predict what you will like; more accurate recommendations lead to longer user retention, which generates more data for the system to further [[p:optimization|optimization]] optimize recommendations.
**协同过滤**看\"和你行为相似的人还喜欢什么\"；**基于内容**看\"和你: **Collaborative filtering** examines 'what other people with similar behavior also liked'; **content-based filtering** examines 'what else is similar to what you like'. Modern systems operate in two stages: first rapidly recalling thousands of candidates from hundreds of millions, then using deep networks for fine-grained ranking to predict click-through rates, viewing duration, and purchase probability.
1992 年施乐帕洛阿尔托研究中心的 Tapestry 系统提出协同过滤；199: The Tapestry system at Xerox Palo Alto Research Center proposed collaborative filtering in 1992; around 1998, Amazon began using 'item-to-item' collaborative filtering. In 2006, Netflix offered a $1 million prize for an algorithm that improved recommendation accuracy by 10%, which was won by an international joint team in 2009. In the late 2010s, TikTok (Douyin) achieved great success with recommendation algorithms as its core feature (see [[short-video]]).
推荐系统决定了我们在电商、视频和新闻里看到什么，是平台最重要的收入引擎之一；它也: Recommendation systems determine what users see in e-commerce, video platforms, and news, serving as one of the most important revenue engines for platforms; they have also been criticized for creating 'information cocoons' and fostering addiction, with multiple countries requiring options to disable personalized recommendations.
把实体和它们之间的关系连成一张大网，让搜索能直接回答\"谁是谁的谁\"。: Connect entities and their relationships into a large network, allowing search to directly answer questions like 'who is whose what'.
知识可以写成\"实体—关系—实体\"的三元组，如（居里夫人，出生于，华沙）。把亿: Knowledge can be written as triples in the form 'entity—relationship—entity', such as (Marie Curie, born in, Warsaw). Connecting hundreds of millions of such triples into a [[p:network|network]] network allows querying and reasoning by following relationships.
从维基百科、数据库和网页中抽取实体与关系，统一消歧（\"苹果\"是水果还是公司）: Extract entities and relationships from Wikipedia, databases, and web pages, performing unified disambiguation ('Apple' is either a fruit or a company), and store them in graph databases. When asked 'What awards did Marie Curie's daughter win?', the system can answer by traversing two steps along the 'children' and 'won award' edges.
语义网络的思想可追溯到 1960 年代；2007 年 Freebase 和 DB: The ideas behind semantic networks date back to the 1960s; open knowledge bases like Freebase and DBpedia emerged around 2007; Google launched 'Knowledge Graph' in 2012, making this term popular.
知识图谱支撑了搜索的直接答案、语音问答、电商关联和金融风控；大模型时代，它为模型: Knowledge graphs support direct answers in search, voice assistants, e-commerce cross-selling, and financial risk control; in the era of large models, they provide verifiable structured facts for models, reducing [[hallucination|Hallucination]] hallucinations.
Siri、小爱同学等用语音交互的助手，正被大模型升级为能办事的智能体。: Voice assistants like Siri and Xiao Ai Tong Xue are being upgraded into intelligent agents capable of performing actions by large models.
把语音识别、意图理解、执行动作和语音合成串成一条流水线，就能用说话操作设备；但每: By connecting speech recognition, intent understanding, action execution, and speech synthesis into a pipeline, one can operate devices via voice; however, each stage involves [[p:probability|probability]] probabilistic judgment, and errors accumulate layer by layer.
传统助手把识别出的文字归入预先定义的\"意图\"（定闹钟、查天气、放音乐），提取: Traditional assistants categorize recognized text into pre-defined 'intents' (set alarm, check weather, play music), extract parameters, and invoke corresponding functions; anything beyond preset capabilities results in the system saying 'I didn't understand'.
2011 年苹果在 iPhone 4S 上推出 Siri；2014 年亚马逊推出: Apple launched Siri on iPhone 4S in 2011; Amazon launched Alexa and Echo speakers in 2014; Xiaomi launched Xiao Ai Tong Xue in 2017. Starting in 2024, these assistants have successively integrated large models.
语音助手把智能音箱带进数以亿计的家庭，为驾车、做饭时和视障人士提供了免手操作；但: Voice assistants brought smart speakers into hundreds of millions of homes, providing hands-free operation for drivers, cooks, and visually impaired users; however, they could only handle simple instructions for a long time until the emergence of large models brought an upgrade (see [[ai-agent]]).
IBM 的国际象棋计算机击败世界冠军卡斯帕罗夫，靠的是暴力搜索加专家评估。: IBM's chess computer defeated world champion Garry Kasparov by brute-force search combined with expert evaluation.
国际象棋每步约有 30 种走法，往下看几步就是天文数字（[[p:complexi: Chess has about 30 moves per game; looking several steps ahead results in astronomical numbers ([[p:complexity|Computational complexity]]). Deep Blue's method was 'hardware brute force + expert knowledge': dedicated chips evaluated approximately 200 million positions per second, then used a master-calibrated evaluation function to judge quality.
深蓝用博弈树搜索加剪枝，通常向前看十几步，关键局面看得更深；它不会\"学习\"，: Deep Blue used game-tree search with pruning, typically looking ahead ten or more moves and going deeper in key positions; it did not 'learn', as all knowledge was written by humans.
IBM 团队（许峰雄、坎贝尔等）研发。1996 年 2 月深蓝首战世界冠军卡斯帕: The IBM team (Feng-Huey Hsu, Campbell, etc.) developed Deep Blue. In February 1996, Deep Blue's first match against world champion Garry Kasparov ended in a 2:4 loss; in May 1997, the upgraded version won 3.5:2.5, marking the first time a computer defeated a reigning world champion in an official tournament within standard time limits.
深蓝成为\"机器在智力游戏中超越人类\"的标志。此后象棋引擎远超人类，2017: Deep Blue became a symbol of 'machines surpassing humans in intellectual games'. Since then, chess engines have far exceeded human capabilities; AlphaZero in 2017 used self-play learning to refresh the face of chess AI (see [[alphago]]).
DeepMind 结合深度学习和蒙特卡洛树搜索，击败围棋世界冠军李世石。: DeepMind combined deep learning with Monte Carlo tree search to defeat Go world champion Lee Sedol.
围棋的变化比宇宙中的原子还多，暴力搜索行不通。AlphaGo 用两个深度网络提供: The number of variations in Go exceeds the number of atoms in the universe, making brute-force search impossible. AlphaGo used two deep networks to provide 'game feel': the policy network identified which moves were worth considering, and the value network judged who held the advantage; it then used Monte Carlo tree search to only deeply explore promising branches ([[p:optimization|optimization]], [[p:probability|probability]]).
它先学习人类高手的约 3000 万个局面，再通过大量自我对弈的 [[reinfo: It first learned from about 30 million positions of human grandmasters, then continued improvement through large-scale self-play via [[reinforcement-learning|Reinforcement learning]] reinforcement learning. AlphaGo Zero in 2017 completely did not use human game records, relying only on rules and self-play to surpass the version that defeated Lee Sedol within three days; AlphaZero learned Go, chess, and shogi using the same algorithm.
DeepMind 的席尔瓦（David Silver）、黄士杰、哈萨比斯等研发。: DeepMind's David Silver, Huang Shijie, Demis Hassabis, and others developed it. In October 2015, it defeated European champion Fan Hui with a score of 5:0; in March 2016, it defeated Lee Sedol in Seoul with a score of 4:1, where the 37th move in the second game astonished professional players; in May 2017, it defeated Ke Jie with a score of 3:0.
AlphaGo 比多数专家预期早了约十年，掀起全球尤其是中国的 AI 热潮，职业: AlphaGo arrived about a decade earlier than most experts expected, sparking an AI boom globally and especially in China. Professional chess players began learning new moves from the AI. This approach was later applied to protein structure determination and mathematical proofs (see [[ai-for-science]]).
用 AI 加速科学发现；AlphaFold 基本解决了蛋白质结构预测问题，获 2: AI is accelerating scientific discovery; AlphaFold essentially solved the problem of predicting protein structures and received the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
许多科学问题本质上是\"从海量可能性中找出满足约束的那一个\"——蛋白质折成什么: Many scientific problems are essentially 'finding the one that satisfies constraints from a vast number of possibilities'—what shape proteins fold into, which molecule can bind to a target, which crystal is stable. AI learns patterns from known data, reducing the search space by several orders of magnitude ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
以 AlphaFold 为例：输入一条氨基酸序列，模型利用进化上相关的序列和已知: Taking AlphaFold as an example: inputting an amino acid sequence, the model uses evolutionarily related sequences and geometric patterns learned from known structures to directly predict the three-dimensional position of each atom. In many cases, accuracy approaches experimental measurements, with time reduced from months to minutes. The same approach has been applied to weather forecasting, materials discovery (see [[materials-genome]]), nuclear fusion control, and mathematical proofs.
2020 年 DeepMind 的 AlphaFold 2 在 CASP14 结: In 2020, DeepMind's AlphaFold 2 achieved a breakthrough in the CASP14 structure prediction competition; in 2022, it was released alongside the European Bioinformatics Institute with approximately 200 million predicted protein structures. In 2023, Google's GraphCast surpassed traditional numerical models for medium-range weather forecasting. Half of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Kasparov and Jumper, and the other half to Baker (David Baker) for designing entirely new proteins.
AI 正成为继实验、理论、计算模拟之后的又一种科研范式，大幅加速了结构生物学（见: AI is becoming a fourth scientific paradigm after experiment, theory, and computational simulation, significantly accelerating structural biology (see [[protein-structure]]) and drug development (see [[drug-discovery]]).
能补全、编写、调试甚至自主修改整个代码库的 AI 工具。: AI tools capable of completing, writing, debugging, and even autonomously modifying entire codebases.
代码是高度规则化的语言，网上有海量开源代码可学；而且代码对不对可以运行测试来检验: Code is a highly rule-based language; there are vast amounts of open-source code available to learn from. Moreover, whether code is correct can be verified through execution tests, providing clear [[p:feedback|feedback]] signals for models. Humans only need to describe intentions in natural language ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
AI 编程工具经历了三代：**自动补全**（预测下一行）、**对话式编程**（描: AI programming tools have gone through three generations: **automatic completion** (predicting the next line), **conversational programming** (describing requirements, generating functions or explaining errors), and **programming agents** (understanding entire codebases, planning themselves, modifying multiple files, running tests, fixing errors, and finally submitting for human review).
2021 年 OpenAI 发布 Codex 模型，GitHub 推出 Copi: In 2021, OpenAI released the Codex model; GitHub launched Copilot. In 2025, command-line agents like Claude Code and Codex became popular, and 'vibe coding' was selected as a word of the year by Collins Dictionary. By 2026, programming agents can work continuously for hours to complete larger features.
AI 大幅加快了原型开发，让非程序员也能做简单应用；工程师的重心转向写需求、审代: AI has significantly accelerated prototype development, allowing non-programmers to create simple applications; engineers' focus shifts to writing requirements, reviewing code, and designing systems, with concerns about reduced code quality and fewer entry-level positions.
让 AI 拥有身体，在真实物理世界中感知和行动，如人形机器人。: Endowing AI with a body to perceive and act in the real physical world, such as humanoid robots.
很多智能来自身体与环境的互动：拿起杯子要看、摸、调整力度，是不断用感知修正动作的: Much intelligence comes from interaction between body and environment: picking up a cup requires seeing, touching, and adjusting force, which is a [[p:feedback|feedback]] loop of continuously using perception to correct actions. AI that only learns from text and images lacks this 'sense of touch'.
具身系统把视觉、触觉等传感器和机械臂或腿连起来，由模型把\"看到的画面 + 语言: Embodied systems connect visual, tactile, and other sensors to robotic arms or legs, with models directly mapping 'seen images + language instructions' into motor actions. The mainstream approach is the 'vision-language-action' (VLA) model: training large models with extensive robot operation data so robots can understand 'put the red cup into the sink'. Data scarcity is the biggest bottleneck.
2023 年谷歌 DeepMind 发布早期 VLA 模型 RT-2；2024–: In 2023, Google DeepMind released the early VLA model RT-2; in 2024–2026, Physical Intelligence, Figure, Tesla, and Chinese companies like AgriTech and Unitree accelerated progress.
具身智能被视为 AI 的下一个前沿，与 [[humanoid-robot|人形机: Embodied intelligence is seen as the next frontier of AI, closely related to [[humanoid-robot|Humanoid robot]] and [[world-model|World model]]; currently, robot reliability in cluttered environments remains far inferior to humans.
用模仿学习和强化学习让机器人自己学会抓取、行走等技能。: Using imitation learning and reinforcement learning for robots to learn skills like grasping and walking themselves.
手工给机器人编写每个动作，换个物体就失灵。让机器人从示范中模仿、从试错中 [[p: Manually programming each action for a robot causes it to fail when the object changes. Letting robots imitate from demonstrations, [[p:optimization|optimization]] from trial and error, accumulate experience through [[p:feedback|feedback]], enabling adaptation to ever-changing real-world environments.
**模仿学习**：人用遥控或穿戴设备示范，机器人学会把观察映射成动作。**强化学: **Imitation learning**: humans demonstrate using remote controls or wearable devices, and robots learn to map observations into actions. **Reinforcement learning**: letting thousands or tens of thousands of virtual robots simultaneously trial and error in simulators, then transferring learned skills to real machines ('simulation to reality').
2016 年谷歌用 14 台机械臂日夜练习，积累了约 80 万次抓取经验；202: In 2016, Google used 14 robotic arms practicing day and night, accumulating approximately 800,000 grasping experiences; in 2023, dozens of institutions jointly released the Open X-Embodiment dataset, collecting data from over 20 types of robots.
四足和人形机器人因此能在复杂地形上稳定行走，机械臂学会叠衣服等柔性操作。: Quadruped and humanoid robots can thus stably walk on complex terrains, while robotic arms learn to fold clothes and perform other flexible operations.
用 AI 换脸、仿声生成以假乱真的音视频，带来诈骗和虚假信息风险。: Using AI for face swapping and voice cloning creates fake audio-visual content that is indistinguishable from reality, bringing risks of fraud and misinformation.
生成模型学会了人脸和声音的 [[p:probability|概率分布]]，就能合: Generative models have learned the [[p:probability|probability distributions]] of faces and voices; they can synthesize new images and sounds 'like someone'; the stronger the generative capability, the harder it is to distinguish truth from falsehood with the naked eye.
早期换脸用自编码器：同一个编码器学两个人的表情，再用 B 的解码器还原 A 的表: Early face swapping used autoencoders: one encoder learns two people's expressions, then decoder B reconstructs A's expression. Today's [[diffusion-model|Diffusion model]] and voice cloning require only seconds of material to generate 'fake humans' in real-time during video calls. Defensive measures include detecting generation traces, adding watermarks at the source, and using digital signatures.
让机器从图像和视频中识别物体、理解场景，应用于安防、医疗影像和自动驾驶。: Machines identify objects and understand scenes from images and video, applications including security surveillance, medical imaging, and autonomous driving.
人脸识别普及到解锁、支付、门禁和通关，也被用于大规模监控。欧盟 AI 法原则上禁: Facial recognition has become widespread for unlocking devices, payments, access control, and border crossings, and is also used for mass surveillance. The EU AI Act generally prohibits law enforcement agencies from remotely identifying faces in real time in public spaces.
2017 年 Reddit 上一个名为\"deepfakes\"的用户发布换脸视: In 2017, a user named "deepfakes" on Reddit posted a face-swap video, giving the term its origin. In 2024, employees of a Hong Kong multinational corporation transferred approximately 200 million Hong Kong dollars after an "executive" video conference, where all other participants were forged.
深度伪造被用于诈骗、色情报复和政治虚假信息。中国自 2025 年 9 月起要求对: Deepfakes are used for fraud, pornography reproduction, and political disinformation. China has required labeling for AI-generated content since September 2025; the transparency obligations under the EU AI Act apply from August 2026.
AI 读片、辅助诊断和药物发现；2018 年美国首次批准可自主给出诊断结论的 A: AI reads medical images, assists in diagnosis, and aids drug discovery; in 2018, the US first approved an AI device capable of independently issuing diagnostic conclusions.
医学影像和病历里的模式（肿瘤形状、视网膜病变、心电异常）可以从大量标注病例中学到: Patterns in medical imaging and records (such as tumor shapes, retinal lesions, and cardiac abnormalities) can be learned from large volumes of labeled cases to provide judgments in the form of [[p:probability|probability]], with speed and consistency surpassing fatigued human eyes.
最成熟的是影像 AI：在 X 光、CT、眼底照片和病理切片上标出可疑区域、给出风: The most mature application is imaging AI: marking suspicious areas on X-rays, CT scans, fundus photographs, and pathology slides and providing risk scores to assist doctors in screening. Medical AI must be approved like medical devices and validated across data from different hospitals.
2018 年 4 月，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准 IDx-DR，这是首: In April 2018, the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved IDx-DR, the first AI device capable of independently issuing conclusions for diabetic retinopathy screening without doctor interpretation. As of 2025, the FDA has listed more than 1000 approved AI medical devices, about three-quarters of which belong to radiology imaging.
AI 帮助缺少专科医生的地区开展筛查，减轻放射科的负担；难点是换个人群性能可能下: AI helps regions lacking specialist doctors conduct screenings and reduces the burden on radiology departments; challenges include performance degradation when applied to different populations and issues regarding liability attribution.
确保 AI 系统的目标和行为符合人类意图和价值观，能力越强越重要。: Ensure that the goals and behaviors of AI systems align with human intentions and values; this becomes increasingly important as capability grows.
AI 会优化我们交给它的目标，而不是我们\"心里真正想要的\"目标；两者之间的缝: AI will optimize the goals we give it rather than the goals we "truly want" in our hearts; the gap between the two will be amplified by powerful optimizers ([[p:incentives|incentives]]). The stronger the capability, the greater the consequences of bias, so continuous supervision and [[p:feedback|feedback]] correction are required.
主要方向有：**训练方法**——[[rlhf|RLHF]]、按书面原则自我改进的: Key directions include: **Training methods** — [[rlhf|Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)]], "Constitutional AI" that self-improves according to written principles; **Evaluation and red teaming** — testing models before release to see if they can assist in creating biological weapons, launching cyberattacks, or deceiving users; **Explainability** — opening the black box to see what the model is "thinking" (see [[explainable-ai]]); **Control** — restricting agent permissions and monitoring their behavior. Major AI companies have all released security frameworks that strengthen protection based on capability thresholds.
1960 年控制论之父维纳（Norbert Wiener）就警告：如果用一台无法: In 1960, Norbert Wiener, the father of cybernetics, warned: if a machine cannot effectively intervene to achieve its purpose, it is best to ensure that the goal placed inside it is exactly what we truly want. In 2014, Bostrom's "Superintelligence" sparked widespread discussion; in 2023, the UK held its first AI safety summit, followed by the establishment of AI safety research institutions in countries such as the UK and the US.
AI 安全从小众哲学话题变成实验室工程、政府机构和国际协调的议题。专家对风险大小: AI safety has evolved from a niche philosophical topic into an issue involving laboratory engineering, government agencies, and international coordination. Experts disagree greatly on the magnitude and urgency of risks, but generally agree that better testing is needed before deployment.
训练数据中的偏见会被模型继承甚至放大，影响招聘、信贷、司法等决定。: Biases in training data are inherited and even amplified by models, affecting decisions in hiring, credit granting, and judicial processes.
模型从历史数据中学 [[p:probability|统计规律]]；如果历史本身有: Models learn [[p:probability|statistical patterns]] from historical data; if history itself contains discrimination, the model will learn to treat discrimination as "regularity" and replicate it on a large scale in an apparently objective manner.
偏见可能来自：某些群体样本少（如人脸库中深色皮肤少）；标签反映了过去的不公（如以: Biases may originate from: certain groups having few samples (such as dark skin being underrepresented in facial databases); labels reflecting past injustices (such as previous hiring decisions); or using biased proxy indicators (such as using "medical expenditure" instead of "severity of illness"). Countermeasures include balancing data and auditing error rates by group.
2016 年 ProPublica 报道美国累犯风险评估软件 COMPAS 更常: In 2016, ProPublica reported that the US recidivism risk assessment software COMPAS more frequently misclassified Black defendants as "high risk"; in 2018, Joy Buolamwini and Timnit Gebru found that commercial facial analysis had error rates far higher for dark-skinned women than for light-skinned men.
算法公平成为 AI 伦理的核心议题，欧盟 AI 法把招聘、信贷等列为高风险用途，: Algorithmic fairness has become a core issue of AI ethics; the EU AI Act lists hiring, credit granting, etc., as high-risk uses, requiring data governance and human oversight.
弄清模型为什么做出某个判断，对医疗、金融等高风险场景尤为重要。: Understanding why a model makes a certain judgment is especially important for high-risk scenarios such as medicine and finance.
深度网络的\"知识\"分散在数十亿个参数里，没有人写下过规则，中间的 [[p:a: The "knowledge" of deep networks is dispersed across billions of parameters; no one has written down rules, and the intermediate [[p:abstraction|abstraction]] layers are too numerous. Explainability research must translate these numbers back into concepts humans can understand to discover errors and malicious intentions.
两类方法：**事后解释**——用热力图标出对判断贡献最大的像素，或估算每个特征的: Two types of methods: **Post-hoc explanation** — using heatmaps to show pixels contributing most to a judgment, or estimating contributions of each feature (such as SHAP values); **Mechanistic interpretability** — studying what neurons and "circuits" inside the network represent, for example by using sparse autoencoders to separate millions of interpretable "features" from large models, where amplifying a certain feature can change model behavior.
2024 年 Anthropic 从 Claude 3 Sonnet 中提取出数: In 2024, Anthropic extracted millions of features from Claude 3 Sonnet. After amplifying the "Golden Gate Bridge" feature, the model claimed to be the Golden Gate Bridge itself.
可解释性有助于医疗、金融决策的问责，也被寄望于发现模型的欺骗，但离\"看懂\"大: Explainability aids accountability in medical and financial decision-making and is hoped to help detect model deception, but it remains far from being able to "understand" large models.
模型训练需要大量数据，如何在使用数据和保护个人隐私之间平衡。: Model training requires vast amounts of data; how to balance using data with protecting personal privacy.
模型会从训练数据中\"记住\"一部分 [[p:info|信息]]，可能包括个人隐: The model will "remember" a portion of [[p:info|information]] from training data, which may include personal privacy information; aggregating data for training itself also increases the risk of leaks and misuse.
风险有三类：训练数据中的个人信息被模型原样复述；用户在聊天中输入的敏感内容被存储: There are three types of risks: personal information in training data being verbatim restated by the model; sensitive content input by users being stored or used for training; AI inferring private attributes from scattered public information (such as inferring an address from a photo). Protection measures include de-identification, differential privacy, [[federated-learning|Federated learning]], running models on local devices, and allowing users to opt out of training.
2018 年欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）生效；2021 年中国《个人信息: The EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) took effect in 2018; China's Personal Information Protection Law was implemented in 2021; Italy briefly halted ChatGPT in 2023. In the same year, researchers induced ChatGPT to output original training data text.
隐私合规成为 AI 产品的硬约束，推动了端侧 AI 和\"数据不出域\"的企业部: Privacy compliance has become a hard constraint for AI products, driving edge AI and enterprise deployments where "data does not leave the domain".
各国开始为 AI 立规，欧盟《人工智能法》2024 年生效，按风险等级分类管理。: Countries are beginning to establish regulations for AI; the EU's Artificial Intelligence Act took effect in 2024, managing by risk level.
技术的收益归开发者，风险却可能由社会承担。监管用规则和罚款改变 [[p:ince: The benefits of technology accrue to developers, but risks may be borne by society. Regulation uses rules and fines to change [[p:incentives|incentives]], making developers factor risks into costs.
欧盟《人工智能法》按风险分级：社会评分等\"不可接受\"的用途被禁止；招聘、信贷: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act classifies by risk level: uses such as social scoring deemed "unacceptable" are prohibited; high-risk systems like recruitment, credit, and medical devices require risk management and human oversight; chatbots and deepfakes must inform users; general large models must provide technical documentation.
欧盟《人工智能法》2024 年 8 月 1 日生效，禁止条款 2025 年 2: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act took effect on August 1, 2024; prohibition clauses apply from February 2025; obligations for general models apply from August 2025; transparency obligations apply from August 2026; an amendment effective July 2026 delays high-risk obligations until December 2027 (with embedded product obligations delayed until August 2028). China implemented Generative AI Management Measures in 2023. As of October 2026, the United States still has no comprehensive federal AI law, relying primarily on executive orders and state laws.
AI 合规成为企业的新成本，也引发\"监管是否扼杀创新\"的争论。: AI compliance has become a new cost for enterprises, also sparking debate over whether "regulation stifles innovation".
在几乎所有认知任务上达到或超过人类水平的 AI，何时实现、如何定义仍有争议。: There is still controversy over when and how to define AI that reaches or exceeds human levels on almost all cognitive tasks.
如果智能本质上可以计算，而 AI 能力随算力投入持续增长（[[p:exponen: If intelligence is essentially computable, and AI capabilities grow continuously with computing power investment ([[p:exponential|Exponential growth]]), machines catching up to humans on almost all cognitive tasks seems like a matter of time—this is the reasoning of AGI optimists, whose premises remain controversial.
AGI 没有公认定义。常见说法有\"能完成大多数有经济价值的工作\"（OpenA: AGI has no universally accepted definition. Common statements include "able to complete most economically valuable work" (OpenAI charter), or grading by generality and autonomy. Measurement also remains controversial: high exam scores do not equal the ability to reliably complete long-term real-world work.
\"通用人工智能\"一词在 2000 年代由格策尔（Ben Goertzel）、: The term "General Artificial Intelligence" was promoted in the 2000s by Goertzel (Ben Goertzel), Legg (Shane Legg), and others. DeepMind (2010) and OpenAI (2015) were both founded with AGI as their mission. Leaders of multiple AI companies predicted it would emerge around 2030, while many researchers believe fundamental breakthroughs are still needed.
